tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 295)babs pas bod du chos dar ba'i rten 'grel 'grig zer/de nas rgyal rabs lnga nang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/gangs can ri yi na
295)babs pas bod du chos dar ba'i rten 'grel 'grig zer/de nas rgyal rabs lnga nang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/gangs can ri yi na

tei:div.tei:p: 295) babs pas bod du chos dar ba'i rten 'grel 'grig zer/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga nang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ li tsa byi rnams rigs su byung*/ zhes dang*/ 'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang*/ lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson zhes sogs lung du mar bstan pa bzhin/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos chos blon thu mi sam+bho ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs te bod du yi ge med pa la 'bri klog gi bsrol gtod/ 'o skol gyi ston pa dgung lo brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhal kyin gdan 'dren pa'i ched 'jig rten mthun 'jug ti tshul du khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal mo khri btsun dang*/ sgrol ma'i rnam sprul rgya mo bza' kong 296)jo zhes mtsho nang gi pad+mar grags pa gnyis khab tu bsus/ 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang brtsigs par mi mi ma yin gyis 'tsho ba la brten brtsig tu ma ster bas/ rgyal po yab yuka gsum sku mtshams mdzad nas yi dam gyi lha bsgrubs pas 'grub ste/ lung bstan pa ltar bod srin mo gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i sa gnad rnams su mtha'a'adum yang 'dul rgyu gnon gyi gtsug lag khag rnams brtsigs pa ste ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi rgyal po'i rnam thar le'u nyer gcig pa'i nang gi le'u bcu gsum par/ srin mo gan rkyal du bskyel ba 'dra ba'i dpung pa yon pa byams pa mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang khra 'brug brtsigs/ bod kyi lha khang la snga ba de yin no/ de'ang rgyal pos sprul pa bkye nas zhag bdun la brtsigs so/ dpung pa g.yas pa la dbu ru ka tshal gyi lha khang brtsigs/ dpyi g.yas pa la g.yas ru gtsang 297)'gram brtsigs/ g.yon pa la ru lag grom pa rgyang bzhengs so/ de rnams shin tu non chen po bzhi yin te/ rgyal po sprul pa kye nas zhag re la brtsigs/

yang mtha' 'dul bzhi btul/ srin mo lta bu'i gru mo g.yas par kong po bu chu/ g.yon pa la mkho mthing lha khang*/ pus mo g.yon du gung thang*/ g.yas su byang sra dun rtse brtsigs/ de nas nying lag bzhi mnan te/ lag mthil g.yas su mdo khams klong thang sgron ma/ g.yon du byang tshangs sa klu non gyi lha khang brtsigs so/ rkang mthil g.yas su mang yul byams sprin/ g.yon du spa gro skyer chu lha khang bzhengs so/ de thams cad rgyal pos sprul pa bkye nas zhag re la bzhengs so/ zhes bshad do/ bu ston chos 'byung du gzhan 'dra ba las/ pus mo g.yas la ska brag 298)g.yon la sra dum rtse/ lag mthil g.yas la byang tshal klu gnon/ g.yon la klong thang sgrol ma/ rkang mthil g.yon la mon bum thang bzhengs bshad/ gang ltar yang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul sogs dang 'phrul snang ra mo che'i rten brten par bcas pa rnams bzhengs/ chos kyi rgyal po 'di'i ring la rgya gar nas slob dpon ku sa rang dang*/ bram ze shang ka ra/ bal po'i slob dpon shrī la mañdzu/ rgya nag gi slob dpon ha shang ma hā yā na la sogs pa spyan drangs nas sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud kyi cha lag mang rab bsgyur zhing bstan pa'i bsrol gtod/ dngos su 'chad nyan ma byung yang rgyal po rang gis skal ldan mang por skog chos su thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i gdams pa phog ste nyang bran pha bong khar thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i ral pa can brgya phrag tsam rgyun du byung bar bshad/ dus der gsungs pa rnams phyogs gcig 299)tu bsdoms pa gter kha gsum du byas pa/ grub thob dngos grub/ mnga' bdag nyang*/ shāka 'od gsum gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i deng sang ma ṇi bka' 'bum zhes gsang sngags rnying ma'i zab chos su grags pa 'di yin/ de nas rgyal rab na rje btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan ni mes srong bcan gyis/ da lte gdung rabs lnga na nga'i dbon sras rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i lung bstan zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas rje'i phyag sbal du bcug pa'i don thog tu phebs te dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung nas za hor gyi mkhan po shan+ta rak+shi spyan drangs/

dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad kyi chos gsung pas bod kyi lha srin gdu pa can rnams khros te bar chad sna tshogs kyis tho mtshams par brten/ sngon gyi smon 300)lam gyi 'brel yod tshul gyis lung bstan pa ltar o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ sku rten du zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang brten par bcas pa bzhengs te/ ji skad du/ sku rten gtsug lag khang zhig 'grub lags kyang*/ gsung rten dam chos bod du ma bsgyur na/ 'dus byas dge bas sangs rgyas mi 'thob 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhan chen zhi ba mtsho dang*/ bri kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang nas thams cad yod smra'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te kha skong dang bcas pa sba gsal snang*/ rba khri bzher gyi bu sang shi ta/ sa gor he 'dod kyi bu bai ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma a tswa ra rin chen mchog lam gsum rgyal ba byang chub/ rba rat+na dngan bdun no/ mi bdun rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i gzhi 301)btsugs/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tras thog drangs rgya gar mkhas pa mang po dang*/ lo tsā ba pa gor bai ro tsa na/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ gtsang legs grub/ ska cog zhang gsum gyis mtshon skad gnyis smra ba stong rtsa brgyad sogs mtha' dag bsags te theg pa gong 'og gi chos rnams bsgyur ba'i bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ slob dpon chen pos rje 'bangs nyer lngas gcos snod ldan mang por bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag sogs theg dgu'i chos kyis smin grol la bkod de mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ slar yang sad na legs mjing yon gyi sras phyag rdor gyi rnam sprul ral pa can nam khri lde gtsug bsnyan gyis skyid smad 'on cang rdo'i lha khang khyad mtshar ba bzhengs te rgya gar nas su raṇ+ḍa bo dhi/

shrī len+d+ran bo dhi/ dā na shī la sogs paṇ+ḍi ta mang po spyan drangs/ bod kyi mkhan po 302)rat+na rakī ta dang dharma ta shī la lo tsā ba dzñā se na la sogs pas sngon yab mes kyi dus lo paṇa rnams kyis chos bsgyur ba'i tshe bod skad la ma grags pa'i ming btags pa'i khrod nas chos kyi gzhung dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun pa dang go dka' ba rnams skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal nas kyang bsnan te theg pa che chung gi gzhung dang mthun par bsgyur bcos bgyis zhes bka' bstsal ba ltar phan yul ka ba na mo cher yum rgyas pa la 'gyur bcos byas nas dum bu bcu drug tu mdzad des mtshon yab mes kyis bsgyur ba'i gsung rabs phal cher skad gsar gcad kyis gtan la phab/ gsang sngags nang gi rgyud sde rnams bka' gnyan pas snod ldan ma gtogs snod min byings kyis spyod yul du ma gyur pa rang babs su bzhag glang dar mas bstan pa ma bsnubs pa yan chod kyi bshad sgrub mtha' dag gi sngags phyogs yongs la gang dar rnams 303)gsang sngags rnying ma dang*/ mdo lugs kyang bstan pa snga dar gyi khongs su bsdu zhing*/ de nas yum brtan dang 'od srungs nas rgyal rabs gsum gyi rin lo bdun bcu'i bar bod dbus gtsang la rab byung gi gzugs brnyan yang med cing chos la 'chad nyan lta zhog nad pa'i rim gro la yang klog 'don byed par 'di dmar po 'di nag po zhes pa las med pa'i skabs der/ stod lung pa rma shākya mu ne/ bo dog pa g.yo dge 'byung*/ bzhad kyi gtsang rab gsal gsum gyis 'dul mngon sogs dpe cha drel rgyab gcig khyer gsang thabs kyis mnga' ris su bros/ de nas byang lam brgyud de mar khams su phebs nas bstan pa'i mi ro smad nas slang ba ni/ skye ba snga ma rgyal po'i chos blon 'bro stag snang khri gsum rje zhes pa zhig gis so so lnga pa la smon lam btab nas tshe 'phos pa yin yang zer

304)don la byang chub sems dpa'am smon lam gyi mthu can zhig chu pho byi ba'i lo la yul btsong kha bde khams su 'khrungs/ mtshan mu zu gsal 'bar du btags/ chung ngu nas rigs pad de non 'jam dpal las bzlas layangs blangs/ khang rin chen rdo rje las byang chub tu sems bskyed/ skyi las dbu tshad dang*/ nam dga' ldan las yo ga gsan nas mkhyen par mdzad/ nam zhig rma chu kha'i phyugs rdzis rma g.yo gtsang gsum dan tig na bzhugs pa mthong nas/ 'di ltar 'dug ces mi rnams la smras pas thos te/ mu zu gsal 'bar gyis bltar phyin pas mthong ba tsam gyi dad nas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal nas thar pa yi/ bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi byed pa'i/ bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ dang por bdag gis rab tu byung bar bya/ snyam du dgongs te/ rab dbyung bar gsol bas/ 'dul ba'i pu sti zhig 305)gtad nas/ 'di la ltos la dad na rab tu dbyung bar bya'o gsung*/ bltas pas ches dad de mchi ma phyung nas zhus pas/ der gtsang gis mkhan po dang*/ g.yos slob dpon byas te dge tshul du sgrub shing*/ mkhan slob kyi mtshan las gras te dge ba rab gsal du gtags/ phyis thugs rab ches gsal bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags skad/ de nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi 'ong gsung ba la/ sngar lha lung dpal rdor can gsum klong thang na 'dug pa mthong nas 'tshol du phyin pas rnyed de/ 'byon par zhus pas/ dpal gyi rdo rje'i gsung nas/ ngas rgyal po sdig can bsad pas kha skong mi 'ong gi/ ngas btsam la btang gis gsung ste/ rgya nag gi dge glong ke wa dang gyin ban bya ba gnyis 'bad pas btsal bas brnyed de btang ngo*/ de nas sngar gyi mkhan slob gnyis 306)kyis mkhan po dang las slob/ dmar gyis gsang ston/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis kyis kha skong byas nas bsnyen par rdzogs te ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa chen por gyur/

'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len la mkhas par sbyangs/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga lon pa'i tshe dbus gtsang gi mi bcus mdo khanas su phyin nas gtsang la gtsang bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas/ nga rgas nas mkhan po mi 'khyongs pas bla chen po la zhugs shig gsungs ba ltar zhus pas/ ngas bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mi gtub gsungs ba la/ gtsang gi zhal nas/ dmigs gsal la gang zag khyad par can gyis gtub pas kyis gsungs te/ bla chen pos mkhan po mdzad nas thams cad chig rdzogs mdzad do/ de la nus pa can gyi mi bcu ni/ dbus nas krugs pa lam pa klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ gnyal nas 307)'bring ye shes yon tan/ g.yo ru ba rba tshul khrims blo gros/ rak+shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga'o/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba mo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lnga pa tshong btsun shes rab seng ge/ mnga' ris pa 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dngo pa u pa de dkar dang lnga'o/ de nas bla chen po'i zhal nas/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong dge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring bskos la mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung*/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan bsrung gis/ zhes gsungs so/ de nas skabs shig slob ma rnams kyi mthong snang la/ brgya shin la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing chos nyan pa mthong bas/ bla chen po ni sprul pa lags sam/ zhus pas/ lan du/ dang po bud med sgog 'tshong ma/ bar du stag snang khir gsum rje/ da lta mu zu dge 308)ba gsal/ zhes kyang gsungs so/ mthar de ltar dgra med zhi ba'i nags tshal der/ sdom brtson ldan pa brtse ldan slob ma'i tshogs/ de la 'grogs nas bde ba de dag dang*/ lhan cig dge ba'i phyogs la brtson bar gnas/ zhes gsungs nas dgung lo brgya bcu rtsa bzhi pa shing phag gi lo la sku gshegs khar/ 'phags pa thogs med dag mche ba'i sde gnyis kyi yum gyi dgongs pa mi 'dra bar bkral ba de kho bos byams mgon la dri dgos te/

slob dpon de gnyis kyang da lta dga' ldan na bzhugs/ zhes gsungs/ yang kho bos byams pa mgon po 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ma byon gyi bar du 'di dag tu skye ba brgyad tsam len dgos gsungs nas dga' ldan du gshegs so/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu'i nang nas mkhan po mnga' gsol ba klu mes tshul khrims shes rab kyis/ bla chen po la/ kho cag dbus su 'gro bas mchod gnas 309)zhig zhu byas par/ dbu zhwa bzhes 'phro de phud nas 'di gyon la rjes su dran par gyis shig gsungs dbu la bskon no yar byon te bsam yas na btsan po khri bya ba bzhugs pa la sna gtad nas der phyag phab pas/ btsan pos kyang sna len byas te/ khyed rnams kyi dpon gang yin zer bas la klu mes yin zhes smras pas dbu rtse'i lde mig gtad/ der dkor mdzod kyis gang bar gzigs nas 'don mi thub pa'i ca ga mdzad/ nga mkhan por mngags pas mkhan po dkor la 'bags pa mi rigs pas 'di mi 'dzin zhes btsan po la lde mig gtad/ de nas khams gsum phul bas kyang ma bzhes/ ka bcu phul bas g.yo ru'i lam rgyas bya yis gsung zhing bzhes/ phyis klu mes kyis yo byad mang po rta gon mdzad de dbu rtse gso bar bzhed pa nas/ 310)sba rag gnyis kyis bzung bas gsor ma bcug der btsan pos bar byas te/ klu mes kyis gsos tshar rjes sba rag la gtod par byas te legs par gsos/ gzhan yang la mi ra sgyel/ yer pa ba ring*/ tshong 'dus gnas sogs mtha' yas pa brtsigs pas sa steng thams cad klu mes dpon slob kyis gnas gzhis khyab pa ltar gyur/ sngags 'chang jo sras rnams kyis sngon 'gyur ba'i bka' bstan gyi glegs bam chud ma zos par sbas te bzung ba rnams de dag tu spyan drangs/ dad pa can mang po mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba ltar 'dus nas nyin te bzhin yang rab tu byung bas dge 'dun gyi sde mang du 'phel te/ de'ang gtso bor gru mer dang sna snam sogs ka ba bzhi/

gdung brgyad/ cham so gnyis/ dral ma grangs las rgal ba byung bar grags/ klu mes kyi slob ma yam shud rgyal ba bod kyi slob ma dge bangases grwa pas kyang gnas gzhi brgya 311)dang rtsa brgyad gting bar grags/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ tshong btsun shes rab seng ge gnyis kyis gtsang du dge 'dun gyi sde mang du spel bas lo tshong stod smad gnyis su mched med/ rak+shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis khams su 'dul ba bskyangs/ sba tshul khrims blo gros kyis bu tshal/ 'bring ye shes yon tan gyis khams gsum bzung*/ klu mes kyis ka bcu la sogs pa bzung nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa mdzad pas/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ glan ye shes rab/ sna snam rdo rje dbang phyug ste slob ma che ba bzhi byung*/ gru med gyi slob ma gra phyi phu'i rlung legs pa'i shes rab/ gra phyi pa'i skyogs shes rab 'byung*/ gzus rdo rje rgyan mtshan gsum las/ rlung skyogs gnyis kyis lo tsā slob tu phyin/ gzus kyis klu mes 312)la gtugs te rgya cher 'grel bam po lnga bcu pa sogs la sbyangs/ gzus la bu chen bzhi byung ste/ 'dzims pa dang sne po gnyis gtsang gi bu chen/ glan tshul khrims byang chub dang*/ sbo chung tshul khrims 'byung gnas gnyis dbus kyis bu chen du grags/ de dag gi slob ma gtso che ba rgya 'dul 'dzin gyis dga' ba gdong gi gnas gzhi bzung nas bstan pa spel lo/ klu mes kyi ka ba bzhir grags pa las/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sprul par grags pa sna snam rdo rje dbang phyug ni/ yab sna snam jo sras/ yum zhang lcam sgrol ma'i sras su me pho byi ba la yul nyam dga' mor 'khrungs/ khong gi lo gsum bzhes pa sa pho stag la 'dul ba'i bstan pa khams nas dbus su byung*/ rang lo bco brgyad pa chu mo bya la klu mes las rab tu byung*/ de rjes dang 313)por ra tshag gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/

phyis so bdun bzhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo la rgyal lhas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs te lo 'di la rje mar pa yang 'khrungs/ rgyal lha khang btab nas lo drug song ba dang*/ gyis klu mes la zhus nas sol nag thang po che'i gtsug lag khang btab/ sna snam rdo rje dbang phyug rang lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa lcags pho byi ba la gshegs/ glan tshul khrim byang chub shing pho 'brug la 'khrungs lnga bcu rtsa bdun sa byi ba'i lo rgyal lha khang gi gdan sar phebs/ de rjes nas kyang gdan rabs dang tshogs pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba grags/ klu mes mkhan bu dge bshes yam shud kyis khrab ma kha'i dgon te btab/ phug mo che bzung ste khrab la kha'i 'dabs yin/ der byung ba'i mkhan 314)rgyud ni/ yam shud rgyal ba 'od/ grwa pa mngon shes/ dgyer chen dgon rgyab pa/ dgyer mo che pa/ mkhan chen ngur pa chen po/ des snyan brgyud rdo rje zam par thugs dam mdzad de rim par brgyud cing dar bar mdzad do/ dge bshes grwa pa mngon shes ni/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi blon po mchims rdo rje spre chung zhes bya ba shes rab che zhing smra mkhas pas rgyal po dgyes pa zhig byung*/ des bsam yas mchod rten sngon po dang byung chub gling gong bzhengs/ de la bu gsum las 'bring po lha rjes grwa'i skyid rgyu bzung*/ de nas brgyud pa lnga'i bar mtshims su 'bod/ lnga pa zhang se tsha logs brtan nas zhang du 'bod/ de la bu bzhi byung ba 'bring po zhang stag dkar la bu bzhi byung ba'i che ba zhang stag tshab chu bo byi ba la 'khrungs/ rdze mar pa dang lo snyam yin/ rigs sad de mkhan po yam shud las rab tu byung ba'i 315)mtshan shes rab rgyal bar btags/ khu bo zhang ston chos 'bar la chos mang du gsan/ zhang 'on gyi sgrub thabs blangs pa tsam gyis zhal gzigs/ chos thams cad cung zad re nyan pas shes te mkhyen pa'i phul du byung*/ g.yer po nas brtsams te phyogs thams cad du gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs/

khu bo gshegs nas dgon pa ri phug gi gdan sar bzhugs ma 'dod nas glag gi gnas mo che'i gza' mi byas/ rgyud 'grel mang po gsungs/ slob ma gcig gis yar klung du spyan drangs/ sku bsod skyes des grangs zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ dam pa sangs rgyas la zhi byed kyang gsan/ dgung lo bdun bcu bzhes pa lcags mo bya la gra thang gi rmang gting*/ rang lo bdun bcu rtsa dgu par mkhan bu gcig gis snying thur rgyab pa thal ches pas zhi bar gshegs tshe phal 316)cher grub pa la/ lhag ma cung zad dgos pa rnams dbon 'byung shes dang 'byung tshul gnyis kyis legs par tshar bar byas so/ grwa pa gshegs nas grwa thang gi gdan sa chos skyabs don stengs par grags pa des mdzad/ de rjes des grwa pas btab pa'i spyan g.yas kyi mkhan pa'ang mdzad nas gnas brtan dar ma bkra shis sogs mkhan rabs mang du byung bar grags so/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab ni/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po rngog chen po zhes bya ba/ btsan pos rgya yul du dmag drangs pa'i tshe rgyal pos ri di'u gcig gi khar bzhugs/ dmag rnams yul gzhan 'joms su btang ba na/ rgyal pos sku la bod ba'i rgya'i gyen pa 'ga' zhig byung bas/ blon po rngog gis 'ga' zhig bsad/ 'ga' zhig 'bros su bcug de nas rgya zho hab kyis btab/ rgya phrug brag la brdabs zer ba de'i brgyud pa 317)yar 'brog do'i phyi rol gyi mtsho chen po'i 'gram du grong chags pa'i sngags rnying ma'i dge bshes rdo rje gzhon nu zhes bya ba la sras lnga byung ba'i che ba rngog legs pa'i shes rab yin/ gnyis pa klu khri/ gsum pa klu byang*/ bzhi pa chos skyabs/ lnga pa thub pa rnams las/ che ba rngog legs pa'i shes rab 'bring ye shes yon tan las rab tu 'byung*/ sde snod bslab pa'i phyir khams su byon nas jo bo se btsun gyi slob ma mdzad/ chos mang du mkhyen nas khu ston g.yung tshul khrims sogs dang 'grogs nas dbus su phebs/

bshad pa'i grwa gtsugs nas slob ma mang du byung*/ jo bo snye thang du bzhugs par chos mang du gsan dang por brag nag gi rtsar dgon pa zhig mdzad pa las/ phyis jo bos lung bstan pa bzhin chu mo glang gi lo la gsang ne'u gcug 318)lag khang chen po btab/ de dus 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skya'i dgon pa'ang btab pa yin/ jo bo'i chos la gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/ de'i dbon po rngog blo ldan shes rab yin pa chos skyabs kyi sras su sa mo phag gi lo la 'khrungs/ khu bo dang gzus kyi slob ma sbo chung tshul khrims shes rab sogs la gsan pa mang du mdzad/ shes rab phul du byung ba yin pas khu bo mnyes nas lo bcun bzhes pa'i tshe kha cher bslab gnyer la brdzangs/ de'i tshe rwa lo/ gnyan lo/ khyung po chos brtson/ gtsan kha bo che rnams dang lhan cig 'grogs te byon pas/ mnga' bdag rtse ldes dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa rags pa rnams spyan drang nas/ me pho 'brug gi lo'i chos 'khor mdzad pa dang thug rtse lde'i sras po dbang phyug ldes yon bdag bya bar 'chad nas kha cher byon/ paṇ+ḍi 319)ta sadz+dza na dang*/ ba ra he ra bha tra la sogs pa drug tsam brten mkhas par sbyangs/ dbang sdes gser mang po bskur nas tshad ma rgyan bsgyur cig bya ba'i yi ge byung bas/ paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan rgyal po dang rngog gnyis kyis legs par bsgyur/ kha cher lo bcun du yang dag par sbyangs te slar bod du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang*/ su ma ti kit+tiḥganyis la chos gsan zhing bal por yug cig byon nas a ru l+ya badz+ra dang*/ ba ran+d+ra ru ci la sogs pa la la sngags kyi gsan pa'ang mdzad/ slar bod du phebs 'gyur mang po mdzad pa rnams shin tu bzang zhing pul du gyur pas/ gro lung pas/ dam chos bsgyur ma mnga' brnyes pa'i/ rgyal yul gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhungs/ 'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum/ stong phrag bdun ni lhag bcas bsgyur

320)zhes gsungs/ de yang lha sa dang*/ bsam yas dang myu gu sna dang*/ gnyal sgang thog dang*/ gtsang rgyang mkhar la sogs par bshad pa mdzad pa'i grangs ni/ mkhas btsun grwa sa rim pa bzhin/ khri tsho gnyis dang sum stong dang*/ zhes bya ba dang*/ zur chos 'chad pa'i grangs kyang*/ rgyan dang chos mchog 'chad mkhan lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ rnam nges 'chad pa nyis brgya dang brgyad bcu/ lung chos smra ba stong dang brgyad brgya ste/ chos smra ba nyis stong chig brgya sum bcu tsam zhig 'dus/ tshad ma dang byams chos dang dbu ma la sogs pa'i rnams bshad kyang mang du mdzad nas mthar dgung lo nga gcig bzhes pa'i tshe bsam yas dang nye ba'i lam du sku gshegs so/ slob ma'i tshogs mtha' yas pa de dag nang nas zhang zhe spong chos kyi bla ma/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ khyung rin chen grags/ 'dre shem 'bar bzhi la sras kyi mthu bo bzhi zer 321)bar grogs so/ de yang spyir srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs nas lo nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis 'das pa lcags mo glang gi lo la rgyal po ral pa can gyis rgya dang 'dums mdzad/ rdo ring btsugs chu stag de nas lo bco lnga pa me pho 'brug la ral pa can rgyal po dar mas dkrongs nas/ lo de nyid nas lcags mo bya'i bar dar mas rgyal po byas/ rab tu byung ba'i bstan pa bsnubs/ bar dor lo bcun tsam zhig dbus gtsang du bstan pa'i srol nub/ de nas stod gnyis nas mnga' ris nas dar ba ni/ chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi gdung brgyud btsan po srong nges rgyal srid gcung 'khor re la gtad nas rab tu byung*/ mtshan lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces grags/ des lo tsā rin chen bzang po sogs 322)khyi'u nyer gcig rgya gar du brdzangs/ de rjes paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dang jo bo rje a ti sha gha ya dha ra/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ 'brog mi mar mal 'gos/ rwa gnyal pa rngog shong dpang sogs kyis bsgyur bshad kyis bstan pa spel bas phyi dar zhes grags pa rnams las/

grags che ba rags rim zhig gi lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas lo brgya dang bzhi bcu 'das rjes kyi/ chu pho rta la jo bo bod du phebs/ de'i tshe rje mar pas lo so gcig lon/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos lo dgu lon/ dus skabs der gzus dang grwa pa mngon shes gnyis kyis kyang mkhan po'i bya ba byed/ grwa pa'i slob ma gtsan kha bo ches nyi shu rtsa gsum lon/ gzus kyi bu chen rnams kyang dus der yod/ jo bos 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa bskyangs pa'i gnas gtso che ba ske thang*/ lha sa/ yer 323)phan yul lan rnams su chos mang du gsungs/ shing pho rta'i lo ston zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu la jo bo dga' ldan du gshegs/ slob ma yang bgrang ba las brgal yang rags rim rna ba thos pa'i yi ge las/ lha btsun byang chub 'od khu dbon/ lo chen rin bzang*/ 'brong ston/ shar pa ba/ po to ba/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ gung thang sgom patshul khrims/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ sum pa/ sna snam/ rgya brtson seng*/ shākya blo gros/ tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ yol chos dbang mched gsum la sogs pa'o/ de paṇ+ḍi ta bdun bcu tsam brten nas chos mang du gsan/ lha lde btsan gyi dbu'i mchod gnas su gyur/ gnas gzhi dang gtsug lag khang mchod rten la sogs pa mang du bzhengs 324)gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i slob ma mkhas grub mang du thon/ zhus chen pher ba'i lo tsā ba bcu lhag tsam byung*/ mtshan brjod sam skri ri'i skad du 'bum phrag gcig bod skad du 'bum phrag gcig gzhan la yin byin te 'bum phrag gcig bton/ mthar jo bos sgrub pa la btsud de/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol na sgo sum rim du yod pa la/ tshe 'di'i rnam rtog dang*/ rang don yid byed kyi rnams rtog dang*/ tha malas gyi rnam rtog rnams skad cig re skyes na/ bstan bsrungs rnams kyis kho bo'i mgo bo khos shig ces pa'i sgo yig sbyar nas/

rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad pa shing mo lug gi lo la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan no/ 'brong ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ gdung rus 325)yang zher/ yab rta gsum shu bzher/ yum khu lto gza' lan gcig ma gnyis kyi sras su shing mo sbrul lo la stod lung phur 'khrungs/ rgya gar du phebs pa'i lam khar jo bo skye rong du phebs pa dang 'jal/ chos mang du gsan slar dbus su phebs nas ra sgreng gi gtsug lag khang btab/ jo bo rje gshegs skabs/ 'brom la nga'i bstan pa khyod la gtod pas bzung gsung na la/ spyir bdag 'khos chung*/ khyad par rten dge bsnyen du song bas bya ba chen po sgrub mi nus zhus pas/ nga rang gis slob ma bstan pa la bya ba nus pa mang po byung zhing*/ mchog tu gyur pa dge spyan snga ba/ phu 326)chung ba gsum byung ba rnams la sku mched rnam pa gsum du grags/ po to ba la gdams pa bstan pa tsam gyi ji lta ba bzhin thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ spyan mnga' ba la khyod rang stong pa nyid kho na legs par sgoms dang gsungs/ jo bo'i man ngag mang po yang khong la gnad bas spyan mnga' bar mtshan thogs/ phu chung pa la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi las brtsams te chos bstan nas thams cad bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' ma lus pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam du khyer dgos par dgongs nas nyams len mdzad pas de rnams nas bka' gdams pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ de nas 'brom ston mya ngan las 'da' khar/ po to ba la/ ngas khyed rnams kyi brten sa gzhan ma mthong bas/ slob dpon mdo sde la tshol/ zhes sogs 327)zhal gdams gnang bas dgung lo drug cu pa shing po 'brug la mya ngan las 'das/ de nas phu chung pas ni sha gzug rang za gsungs nas tshogs pa ma brkyangs/ po to bas 'brom gshegs nas rang lo lnga bcu'i bar du thugs dam 'ba' zhig mdzad/

lnga bcu rtsa gcig nas gzhan don mdzad de bzhugs pa mkhan brag dang*/ sgro lag dgon dang*/ mthar thog dang*/ stag lung la sogs pa gnas nges med du bzhugs/ tshogs pa'ang rgyun du rjes su 'breng ba srong phrag lhag pa re 'dus/ gzhan gyas gnod pa byed pa byung na yang spyir dge slong khas nyen/ bye brag byang chub sems dpa' khas nyen gsungs nas gnod lan ye mi mdzad/ chos ni lam sgron/ mdo sde rgyan/ byang pa/ bslab pa kun las btus/ skyes rabs dang ched du brjod pa'i 328)tshom la nan tan du gsung bas bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags/ sku tshe'i smad la po to dgon btab/ kho rang gis 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung du yang zhal gyis bzhes/ slob ma yang*/ dol nas rog dmar zhur ba/ kha rag sgom chung*/ dre'u lhas pa/ glang ri thang pa/ shar pa la sogs pa mang du byung*/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga sa shing mo bya la mya ngan las 'das/ de las rab rgya mtsho ni/ dol sa dmar zhur bar grags pa de yin/ rab tu byung nas rog mngon pa ba dang rgya 'dul 'dzin gnyis la mngon par dang 'dul ba gsan/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ 'gro mgon 'phags gru par yang chos 'brel gsan par grags so/ gla shing po rta la 'khrungs nas chu mo yos kyi bar lo bdun bcu bzhugs nas po to ba'i mdzad pa bzhin bskyangs 329)lan gcig tshe rabs thams cad du dge slong gi dngos po dang mi 'bral ba'i dam bca' mdzad pas/ dpal lha mo dre'u skad lhang gis de'i bar du ngas khyod kyi grogs bya'o gsungs/ khams nas dbyug rgyal mchan zhes pa zhig byung nas jo bor chos mang du gsan/ jo bo'i mchod gnas kyang mdzad pa zhig gis 'gro don mdzad pa'i slob ma mang du byung ba'i gtso bor sne'u zur pa yin/ de la phyis glang thang pas kyang chos mang du gsan/ tshogs pa nyis stong tsam 'dus par grags/ de nas slob ma rnams gtugs par grags so/

dge bshes shar pa na po ni/ byang gi rom por 'brog pa zhig gi sras su lcags pho khyi la 'khrungs/ gzhon 330)pa'i dus su pham mas bag ma blangs pa la ma chags par/ po to ba'i spyan sngar byon nas rab tu byung zhing gdams pa gsan/ thugs rab shin tu che bas bka' 'gyur ro cog thugs la bzhugs par grags/ po to ba gshegs pa'i rjes su po ro ba'i slob ma phal cher khong la 'dus/ bshad pa phal cher gzhung che ba kho na la mdzad/ chogs pa sum stong drug brgya tshogs pa'i nang nas pradzña dz+wa la/ nags shod dpe ston/ ldan gyi ban chen skyes bi/ gzhon shes rab rdo rje snar thang pa gtum ston/ bya grags pa seṅge/ 'jing pa dgye lung pa la stod pa byang chub grags/ myang smad kyi rtsed pa/ shangs kyi rgyu bug pa/ gtsang gad gnyos pa/ khung le'i kha mo zen ston/ myang stod 'od dkar/ myang rong ba/ bya rgyus pa/ myang stod kyi jo sras/ shar pa blo gros grags/ gtsang pa rgya ston/ bo dong pa zhar chos/ gnyal 331)pa dge 'dun skyabs/ gnyal gyi gnyos ston gnyal pa dar rin/ jo sras kong po/ lho pa dar ma grags bya ston 'chad kha ba la sogs pa mang du byung zhing 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i ngang nas lcags mo bya'i lo bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa la gshegs so/ shar pa'i slob ma gastum ston blo gros pa la bla mas khyod kyis dge slong bzhi dang 'grogs shig ces gdams pa ltar lcags mo byas nas chu pho spre'u'i bar snar thang dang nye ba'i gnas ci ris su thugs dam mdzad/ de nas chu mo bya la snar thang gi dgon pa btab long bcu bzhi bzhugs nas de sting la stod du thebs/ nyid kyi gdan par rngo ston shes rab grags pa bskos nas des gdan sa lo nyi shu mdzad/ de rjes zhang btsun rdo rje 'od kyi lo brgyad/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags kyis lo sum cu rtsa dgu/ zhang ston chos kyi bla mas lo bcu/ sangs rgyas sgom 332)pa seṅge skyabs kyi lo bcu/

mchims nam mkha' grags kyis sum cu rtsa drug skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims skyis lo bco lnga/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis lo bdun/ ze'u pa brtson 'grus grags kyis lo bcu gnyis/ khong gi bcung po grags pa shes rab kyis lo bcu gnyis/ mkhan chen blo bzang grags pas lo bzhi bcu/ 'di yan lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum song*/ de steng shing mo yos la mkhan chen rgyal ba bskos/ shing yos de nas me mo bya'i bar lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang*/ de'i dbon po mkhan chen rin po che grub pa shes rab pas gdan sa mdzad pa yin no/ de yang sngon jo bo rjes snar thang gi sa'i thad 'dir phyag mdzub gtad de/ sa pha gir gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'byon zhes lung bstan pa ltar gdan rabs de rnams ni gnas brtan gyi sprul pa 'ba' zhig yin 333)par gsungs so/ ༈ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab kyi slob ma gtso bo bzhi'i ya gyal 'dre shes rab 'bar ba ni/ sne po grags pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ rngog legs shes dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yu drung gnyis dang sdebs khams su byon te/ jo bo se btsun la chos mang du gsan/ phyis rngog lo chen po la sher phyin bslabs te sher phyin mdo bstan gnyis ka la bshad pa rgya cher mdzad/ chos 'chad pa'i tshe lha rnams kyang 'ong bar grags/ rngog mo'i thugs sras dam par gyur nas slob ma yang ar byang chub ye shes sogs bstan pa'i bdag po mtha' yas pa 'thon no/ rgya 'dul 'dzin nas slob brgyud/ 'dar 'dul 'dzin mtha' bzhi brtson 'grus 'bar/ jo bstan nag po dar tshul/ sha mi ba/ ka ba dar seng*/ thag ma rdor gzhon/ rnal 'byor byang seng*/ sbas 334)te jo sras/ byang seng gis phyis phan yul grongs dgon btab/ sbas ris brang ra mo che bzung nas skyor mo lung btab/ rgya 'dul 'dzin gyi slob ma ka ba bzhi'i nang gi rma tsho byang chub rdo rjes rgya'i grwa pa lnga brgya tsam khrid nas dbus su 'chad nyan mdzad/

rma tsho'i slob ma byang 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar ni/ gtsang rong g.yung du lcags lug la 'khrungs/ 'dre chen po las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ zul phur bshad gra gtsugs nas bstan pa bskyangs/ dpe har gyis btsun chung du sprul nas zhabs tog byas par grags/ slob ma 'gro phan nus pa bdun bcu rtsa drug byung*/ slob ma'i gtso bo rtsis 'dul 'dzin gzhon nus seṅge ni/ bya 'dul las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'dul ba'i sde snod la sbyangs pas shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ slob ma yang zul phul gdan pa rogo sa seng sogs 335)bshes gnyen mang du thon no/ rtsis 'dul 'dzin gyi slob ma dpal ldan grwa mo che ba ni/ bya'i lo chu sgor 'khrungs/ gdung rus gro rtsis 'dul 'dzin las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs 'dul ba'i sde snod la sbyangs/ mtshan bdud rtsi grags/ rdo ston dang zhang btsun las sha ba pa'i gdams pa rnams nos shing*/ chu mig pa shir grags/ mu sman pa/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ lha spyil bu ba/ ra sa ba dar rgyas/ grang phu lung pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ dre'u lhas pa/ 'gos ring*/ chu nag pa/ rma shag seng gtsang nag pa sogs la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ sangs rgyas so lnga rje btsun ma sgrol ma sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs snar thang gi gdan sar phebs/ gdan rabs bzhi pa yin lo sum cu so dgu'i bar 'phris bskyangs/ dgung lo brgyad bcu pa la gshegs 336)so/ mchis chen nam mkha' grags ni/ nyang stod stags tshal du rta'i lo ma 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas dpal ldan gro las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ sde snod kyi gnas rnams la mkhas par sbyangs/ mdzod kyi ṭīka chen sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ dpal ldan gro zhang ston/ mchims blo bstan/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa bzhi la bka' gdams kyi skor dang*/ bkra shis sgang pa la byang sems zla rgyal ba'i dbu ma'i gdams pa rnams gsan/

chu mig chos 'khor gyi gral gyi gtso bo yang mdzad/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs che dgu thams cad kyis bkur/ lhag pa'i lha du ma'i zhal gzigs/ snar thang gi gdan sa bdun sar phebs lo sum cu so drug gi bar du tshogs pa bskyangs nas byi ba'i lo la sku gshegs so/ grags pa shes rab nyang stod du lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ gdung zera'u ste/ mkhan chen 337)'dul 'dzin grags brtson 'grus kyi gcung po yin/ mchims chen po las rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po gcen las gzhung bshad dang gdams pa mtha' chod pa gsan/ gcen 'dul 'dzin gyi rjes su snar thang gi mkhan sar bzhugs nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar gdan sa bskyangs gdan rab bcu gcig pa yin no/ mchims ston blo bzang grags pa ni nyang stod smin gro'i phu kha'ur 'khrungs/ gdung rus mtshims ze'u pa grags shes rab las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ ze'u pa sku mched dang*/ rgyang ro byang 'bum sogs bla mar bsten/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung gdams ngag ma lugs pa la mkhyen rtogs rgyas/ grags shes pas gdan pas gtad nas lo so dgu'i bar du bshad sgrub kyis bstan pa bskyangs nas yos lo la sku gshegs so/ mkhan po kun 338)dga' rgyan mtshan ni/ chu sgo'i lung par stag gi lo la 'khrungs/ gdung rus gro/ mchims blo bzang grags pa las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas gzhung gdams ngag thams cad dang*/ bka' bcu gzhon seng sogs las kyag chos mang du gsan mkhan po gshegs pa'i lo de dag la snar thang gi gdan ser phebs nas lo nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar bskyang bslab btus kyi ṭīka ka sogs mdzad nas sbrul lo la gshegs/ ༈ rin po grub pa shes ni/ snar thang gi nye 'khor rong gu zhes par mi bya la 'khrungs/ gdung rus dpang yin/ dgung lo bcu pa la kun rgyal ba las rab tu byung zhing mtshan grub pa shes rab tu btags/ nyi shu pa la mkhan po de nyid dang*/

slob dpon grags pa sogs dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob gnyis dang*/ yon tan 'od/ slob dpon skal bzang pa sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas 339)mdo sngags kyi gzhug lugs gdams ngag dang bcas thugs su chud par mdzad/ dgung lo so gnyis pa la snar thang gi gdan sar phebs nas lo sum bcu bskyangs/ de steng nyid kyi dbon po bsod nams mchog grub pa la gdan pa gtad nas lo lnga zur bzhugs mdzad nas re bdun pa la sku gshegs so/ 'phags spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul paṇa chen rgyu lag gi sa cha gur ma'i rgyu bar lcags lug la 'khrungs/ gung lo bco lnga pa la snar thang gi mkhan po grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung mtshan dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po zhes btags/ gung lo nyi shu pa la sngar gyi mkhan po las bsnyen par rdzogs/ thugs sbyong mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi gtso bo mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ snar thang pa shes rab 340)seṅge/ las smon gyi 'brel ba'i rje rin po che yab sras/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen rong ston/ bo dong paṇa chen/ sems dpa'am thugs rje dpal ba sam gha shrī/ gro sa'i dmar ston khu dbon/ thang chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ a bha ya/ don yod pas lung bstan pa'i bla ma 'chad dka'i lha rin po che dang*/ sgrol chen bsam 'grub rdo rje la sogs te bshes gnyen lnga bcu tsam brten nas mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la sbyangs stobs kyi mkhyen pa rgyas shing rig pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pas/ bo dong paṇa chen gyis thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan gsol/ snar thag byang chen du sgrub pa mdzad pas nyams rtogs kyang mthar phyin pa brnyes/ 'jigs byed dang sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ 'dod khams ma bran du 'khol/ phyis rje'i grub mtha' 'dzin par mdzad kyang*/ sde dang grub mtha'i phyogs ris mi mdzad par 341)kun la dag snang sbyong*/ gzhung lugs mang por dgongs 'brel brtsams/

bkra shis lhun po'i gtsug lag khang dang lha chen bzhengs shing dge 'dun mang du bsdus te/ sku tshe hril mo 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa bskyangs nas dgung lo brgya lnga pa shing rta la dga' ldan du gshegs so/ gnas rnying pa sngon slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa'i dngos slob rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'i gdung rabs brgyad bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdung gi brgyud las nyang stod du 'khrungs/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa las rab tu byung zhig bsnyen par rdzogs mtshan kun dga' bde legs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por brtsal/ mkhan po'i drung du gzhung lugs gdams ngag dang bcas pa la mkhas par sbyangs/ 342)'bras spung dang 'ol dga' sogs su yang phebs/ nyang stod du blo gsal mang po'i don mdzad do/ ༈ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni/ rta nag rdo rje gdan du kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu pa la paṇa chen lung rig rgya mtshor gtsug phud payal/ mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho zhes brtsal/ lo de nyid kyi nang du kun dga' bde legs kyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ tshigs snga phyi'i mkhan slob rnams dang*/ paṇa chen nor bzang rgya mtsho/ yab kun dga' rgyal ba/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ thon yon sogs bshes gnyen mang bsten te/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rab byams la sbyangs pas tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud/ rgyal me tog thang gi chos grwa btab/ ser 'bras bkra shis lhun po rnams 343)kyi khrir phebs nas 'chad rtsod brtsom gsum gyi bya bas gdul bya bskyangs/ dgung lo re brgyad sa chu stag nag zla'i tshes brgyad la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ ༈ bde ba can pa dge legs dpal bzang ni/ yul 'ol dga' gyang gsar du shing glang la 'khrungs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/

bsam gtan gling*/ ser ra smad/ rgyud stod smad rnams su gzhung lugs rab 'byams la sbyangs/ rgyud stod dang shar rtse'i gdan sa mdzad nas dgung lo nga bzhi pa la dga' ldan khrir phebs thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bsnyen rdzogs bzhes pa'i mkhan po yang yin/ drug bcu pa la bde ba can du zur bzhugs mdzad re gsum pa la sku gshegs so/ ༈ rgyal khang rtse pa 344)dpal 'byor rgya mtsho ni/ yul stod lung ram pa'i gad pa khar me khyi la 'khrungs/ bde ba can pa las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ skyor mo lung*/ ra ba stod/ rgyud stod smad rnams kyi grwa par gzhung lugs la sbyangs pas 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa thob/ ra ba stod kyi 'chad nyan rgyud stod dang shar rtse sbrel ba'i bla ma mdzad/ nga dbu pa la dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs re bzhi pa la rgyal khag rtsir zur bzhugs mdzad de 'phris rnam par dkar ba'i ngang nas dgung lo don bzhin pa la gshes so/ ༈ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel ni/ gra byams pa gling gi dgon gzhalo du chu bya la 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas dwags po grwa tshang du gsan sbyongs la phebs/ dwags po grwa tshang gi slob dpon blo bzang chos 'phel las rab tu byung mtshan dkon mchog chos 345)'phel du btags/ de rjes ra ba stod dang rgyud sogs klog pa'i grwa sa mang por byon te mkhas nyan mdzad pas gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la rgyal khang rtse las bsnyen par rdzogs/ ra ba stod dang rgyud stod/ blo gsal gling rnams kyi 'chad nyan/ gsang phur gling smad kyi khri sha rtse dang dga' ldan gyi khri rnams su phebs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal mchog lnga pas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs rnams gsan nas ti shrir bkur/ 'chad mkhas shig thugs dgongs bzang bas zhal slob dge bshes mang du thon/ dgung lo don bzhi pa dbur stod gsang sngags mkhar du me khyi la sku gshegs so/

༈ mchog bstan 'dzin ni/ chu mo phag gi lo dbu ru kha rag tu 'khrungs/ 346)'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ sku na phra mo grwa par bzhugs dus nas bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na mtho ba dus dbang gis 'byung nye ba rnams kyis kyang ma gos pas btsun gcig mar grags/ ra ba dang blo gsal gling sogs su phebs nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs rnams la mkhas par sbyangs/ rje rgyal mchog lnga pa dang rang gi mkhan po khri rin po che sogs bshes gnyen du ma las gzhung gdams ngag ma lus pa gsar nas thugs su chud par mdzad/ gnyal sde drug gi mkhan po lo bco lnga bskor dang*/ de rjes nyang stod dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan por phebs nas grub mtha'i phyogs cha dang bral bar yun ring du bskyangs pas sa zhal dge gsum gyi gra pa thams cad kyis spyi mi ltar bkur 347)zhing mngags/ de nas gdan sa yar stod pa ngag dbang phrin las la gtad de gsang sngags mkhar du lo shas thugs dam la bzhugs nas dgung lo re gnyis pa shing po byi ba la sku gshigs so/ ༈ mtshan mchog gi dngos grub bsnyes pa ye shes kyi sku can rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa gter chen chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ sdom brtson mkhas pa chen po rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma gnyis kyi rigs kyi gcung du grwa dar rgyas chos sding su me rta la 'khrungs/ gcen rnams gnyis kyi bka' drin gyis chung ngu nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo dpyid 'bring nag zla'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu gsum gyi phyi dro'i nyi ma 348)brgyad cha lus pa grib tshod skyes bu gcig dang rkang pa gnyis kyi dus su/ mkhan slob bsgrags ma mkhan chen dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ gsang ston rab 'byams pa blo bzang skyes mchog

dus go ba rab 'byams pa phun tshogs legs 'byor/ grogs dan dge slong blo bzang dkun dga'/ kha skongs pa dge slog ngag dbang chos 'dzin sde dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po po ta lar tshigs gsum dus gcig la bar ma chad pa'i cho gas bsnyen par rdzogs/ sngon nas 'dul ba'i brda chad dang lag len gcen rgyal ba'i sras po dang gung thang paṇa chen gnyis las mkhyen par mdzad cing*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i phyi lo de la/ lung mang po grub rdo rje la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi phran 'ga' dang bcas pa/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba sangs rgyas 349)chos dar la mdo rtsal dang lung rig gter mdzod sdom brtson kun dga' dar rgyas la me tog phreng rgyus dang sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'phrin las las kun mkhyen bu'i las chog sogs gsan te mkhas pa chen por gyur te mdo sngags rigs gnas dang bcas pa la bstan bcos mtha' yas pa mdzad do/ de sang gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir 'dul ba 'dzin pa thams cad sde pa gzhi thams cad yod pa smra ba'i lugs gcig po yin zhing*/ de lta na'ang sgom rgyun rim pa gsum byung ba ste/ sngar smos pa rnams mkhan chen zhi ba mcho'i sdom rgyun bstan pa'i nyi ma bla chen po la rgyud pa smad 'dul ba'i lugs so/ rim pa gnyis pa ni/ shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la nas/ pā dhu pā la/ pradzñā pā la/ gu ṇa pā la ste pā la rnams gsum sogs las brgyud 350)pa stod 'dul ba'i lugs te de'i rgyun da lta yod par mi snang ngo*/ rim pa gsum pa ni/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī nas byang rdor sag gsum la brgyud pa kha che'i lugs te/ khro bu lo tsā bas shing pho byi ba'i lor kha che paṇa chen bod du spyan drangs nas/ chu mo bya'i bar lo bcu bzhugs te/ dbus gtsang thams cad chos kyi 'phrin las bskyangs/ khro phur byams pa'i sku brnyan gyi rten khyad par can bzhengs rab tu gnas pa sogs mdzad/

shing pho khyi'i lo la bod nas kha cher phebs te lo bcu gnyis gzhan don mdzad/ dgung lo dug bcu rtsa dgu pa shing mo bya la zhi bar gshegs so/ paṇa chen de nid kyis chu shul dkrog ma dgon par mi bcu gcig bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i nang nas lho brag pa byang chub dpal ba dang*/ gtsang pa dpal ba gnyis mkhan po'i gtso bor gyur/ byang chub dpa' yis dge 'dun sgang dang*/ rdo rje dpal gyis snye mo tshal mig gtsugs/ de 351)gnyis kyi slob ma dbu mdzad bsod nams dang*/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gnyis byung ste/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis byi rdzing tshogs pa gtsug dbu mdzad bsod nams kyis chos lung tshogs pa gtsugs te tshogs sde bzhir grags/ de rnams las 'phel te paṇa chen sdom rgyun da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad pa 'di'o/ de'i sdom rgyun 'dzin pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa shar gtsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos chen po 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog nye bar 'khor du gyur pa dang*/ de rjes paṇ+ḍi ta mang por sku'i skye ba bzung nas 'phags yul du bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa dang*/ bod 'dir mdo khams stod smad gnyis las smad gtsong kha'i yul grur mal gyi rigs dpa' zhing brtul phod pa dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i yab da ra 352)kha che klu 'bum dge zhes bya ba dang*/ yum a chos zhes bya ba'i rigs rgyus phun sum tshogs pa'i sras su ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong chig brgya dgu bcu 'das par rab byung drug pa'i me bya lor sku bltams/ dgung lo gsum par karma rol pa'i rdo rjes dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhes mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol/ dgung lo bdun pa'i steng chos rje don 'grub rin chen pa'i drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes mtshan blo bzang grags pa'i dpal du gsol/ 'jig byed dang bde mchog sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste rdo rje theg pa'i sgor smin par mdzad/

dgung lo bcu drug pa la mdo khams nas bteg ste dbus gtsang du phebs/ 'bri khung du spyan snga dang*/ sa skyar bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rnar thang mkhas mchog lo tsā ba don bzang*/ snar thang mkhan po kun dga' rgyal 353)mtshan/ skyor lung mkhan po blo gsal/ gdan sa thil spyan snga chos grags pa/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje sogs de dus kyi mkhas grub yod do cog la 'dul mngon phar tshad dbu ma sogs dang*/ sa snying dgas shangs/ gsar ma'i chos skor rags rim rnams gsan sbyongs mdzad/ khyad par du'ang chos rje don 'grub rin chen pa dang*/ ring mo mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros gnyis gtso bor brten nas dbu tshad 'dul mngon sogs dpyis phyin pa'i gsan pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ yar klungs tshogs pa'i mkhan po bka' bzhi sa tshul rin pas mkhan po dang*/ byi rdzing tshogs pa'i mkhan po shar mgon pas slob dpon/ byi rdzing pa'i dbu mdzad bsod nams rdo rjes gsang ston/ tshogs pa gnyis kyi kha skong dang bcas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs 354)par mdzad nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad nas bka' rtsom yang gsung 'bum pod chen bco brgyad tsam bzhugs par grags/ dgung lo nga gsum par rgyal bstan dar rgyas kyi ched dang rigs drug gi 'gro ba rnams bde ba can du 'dren pa'i dmig phug te dge 'dun khrir nye bar bsnyen bkur gyis lha sa smon lam chen po ji srid bar par mdzad/ bu slob 'khor tshogs rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa ltar dgon gnas zhig 'ding bar dgos/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje la lung bstan zhus par/ bdag gi yi dam la zhu'o gsungs/ dbang bskur ri yi ldebs dag tu/ btsun mo sdings kyi ngos phyogs su/ dge 'dun dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ ri ni gang yin 'jam dpal mched/ dbus gtsang mdo khams rgya yul gyi/

mchod gnas dam pa tshogs gsog rten/ mnga' ris byang khams kun gyi skyabs 355)phyogs bcur sde dgon rgyas pa 'byung*/ zhes gsung ba 'dug ste/ dgon pa'i ming la rten 'brel gyi sgra don yod pas/ khyed rang 'di nas dga' ldan du byams pa'i drung du 'byon zhing der bzhugs pas dgon ming yang dga' ldan la gras pa btags na khyed rang bzhugs pa dang 'dra ba'i rten 'brel yod/ ces gsungs pa ltar smon lam grol nas zhabs kyis bcags te 'brog dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi sa gzhi brtag pa sogs 'dul ba dang gtsug lag khang gi don ltar sa glang lo btab/ bde mchog rdor dbyings sogs kyi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs rnams rin po che 'ba' zhig la bzhengs nas sgrub pa'i mchod pa'ang gtsugs/ de ltar chos kyi 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs nas re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i skal ba rdzogs par gzigs te nga gong nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 356)'dun grub pa dang bkra shis rdo khar 'jal dus dgyes pa'i mdzum mdangs dang bcas na bza' thang gos bzhes 'phror gnang ste don gyis bstan pa yongs su gtad/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen la nam bza' paṇa zhu dang ber thul zhig gtad de don gyi gdan sar bgo bar mdzad nas dgung lo re gnyis pa sa phag smin drug zla ba'am 'dul ba'i mgo zla dgun zla ra ba hor zla bcu pa'i mar ngo'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang nyer lnga la gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas dga' ldan dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ phyi nang thams cad mar me'i rgyun bzang pos gtams pa'i lnga mchod chen mo'i dus mchod kyang gtsug sku gdung rim por dngul gyi mchod rten bum pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i dngul gdung mthong ba don ldan du grags so/ rje 'di nyid kyi sras kyi mthu bor gyur pa/ paṇa chen dge 357)'dun grub pa/ rgyal tshab rin po che/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba dang gsum mo/

༈ gdan pas gnyis pa rgyal tshab rin po che ni/ gtsang stod du shing 'brug la 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug bcu par dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs/ chos 'khor dpag med skor zhing bstan bcos kyang mtha' yas par snang*/ dgung lo re dgu pa chu khyi lor gshegs/ gdung rus dang ring bsrel sogs nang du bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung rnam rgyal mchod rten dngul gdung chen mo'i g.yas su bzhugs/ ༈ gsum pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal gtsang stod mdog gzhung du shing glang la 'khrungs/ zhes bdun par dga' ldan khrir phebs/ lo brgyad kyi bar bstan pa'i bya ba mtha' yas pa mdzad/ bstan bcos kyang mang bar snang*/ nga bzhi pa sa rta la gshegs so/ gdung zhugs 358)su phul ba'i gdung rus sogs nang rten du bzhugs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa gtso bo'i g.yon du bzhugs so/ bzhi pa chos rje zhwa lungs legs pa rgyal mtshan gtsang du shig yos la 'khrungs/ re bzhi pa sa rta la dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs/ don drug pa lcags rtar gshegs dngul gdung rnam rgyal mchod rten gtso bo'i g.yas gsum par bzhugs/ ༈ lnga pa chos rje blo gros chos skyong gtsang g.yag sder sa sbrul la 'khrungs/ re gnyis pa lcags rta la khrir phebs/ don lnga pa chu lugs la gshegs so/ ༈ drug pa chos rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas drug rje'i gcung por chu rtar 'khrungs/ re gnyis pa chu lug khrir phebs/ don gnyis pa chu sbrul la gshegs/ dngul gdung rnam rgyal mchod rten gtso bo'i yon gnyis par bzhugs/ 359)bdun pa mkhas mchog blo gros brtan pa gtsang gi shags mgron khang du chu rtar 'khrungs/ re bdun pa lcags khyir khrir phebs/ de'i phyi lo 'bras spungs kyi khri yang bsgrags/ don bdun la gshegs/ dben 'du mas mchod rten gtso bo'i g.yon bzhi par 'khod do/ ༈ brgyad pa smon lam dpal ba g.yas ru byang du shing rtar 'khrungs/

don gnyis pa chu sbrul la khrir phebs/ don brgyad pa lcags phag la gshegs/ 'di yan bdun por 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud ces grags so/ de nas dgu pa blo bzang nyi ma/ bcu pa chos rje ye shes bzang po/ bcu gcig pa 'dar ston blo bzang grags pa/ bcu gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu gsum pa chos rje chos kyi bshes gnyen/ bcu bzhi pa chos rje rin chen 'od zer/ bco lnga pa paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ bcu drug 360)pa chos rje chos skyong rgya mtsho/ bcu bdun pa chos rje rdo rje bzang po/ bco brgyad pa chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang po/ bcu dgu pa chos rje ngag dbang chos grags/ nyi shu pa chos rje chos grags bzang po/ nyer gcig pa dge legs dpal bzang*/ nyer gnyis pa dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas/ nyer gsum pa chos rje tshe brtan rgya mtsho/ nyer bzhi pa byams pa rgya mtsho/ nyer lnga pa chos rje dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ nyer drug pa chos rje dam chos dpal 'bar/ nyer bdun pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ nyer brgyad pa chos rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ nyer dgu pa chos rje bshes gnyen grags pa/ sum bcu pa chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ so gcig pa chos rje dam chos dpal/ so gnyis pa chos rje tshul khrims chos 'phel/ so gsum pa chos rje grags pa rgya mtsho/ so bzhi pa chos rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan so lnga pa chos rje 'jam 361)dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel/ so drug pa kong po bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ so bdun pa chos rje dge 'dun rin chen/ so brgyad pa chos rje bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ so dgu pa dkon mchog chos bzang*/ bzhi bcu pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ zhe gcig pa blo bzag rgyal mtshan/ zhe gnyis pa blo bzang don yod/ zhi gsum pa byams pa bkra shis/ zhe bzhi pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ zhe lnga pa co ni 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dar rgyas/ zhe drug pa bsam blo sbyin pa rgya mtsho/

zhe bdun pa chos rje blo bzang chos 'phel rnams so/ ༈ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs ni/ rje'i dngos slob 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal 362)ldan du grags pa de sa lug bsam yas su 'khrungs/ brtse thang du rab tu byung zhing gral 'dzin mdzad/ smyos rgyal balha nang gi skye bar mkha' 'gros lung bstan/ skabs zhig gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig dpon blon gyis/ sa yul bstan nas 'dir dgon pa zhig thob/ ngas btsun pa stong phrag lnga ster zer ba dang*/ dan 'bag mdar longs spyod kyi chu yin zer rdzing bu mang po dag*/ glang chen ri gdung du 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs te 'di rnams thos bsam gyi rdzing bu yin pas 'thung gsung ba sogs kyi gzigs ltas khyad par can byung ba dang*/ 'jam mgon blang mas kyang dgon ste zhig gyis gsung ba dus 'grigs pas/ me spre lor bsil ldan gyi rgyan gcig 'phags yul dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang gnyis su med pa'i rig grol gyi sde chen po'i rmang 'ding ba'i lto phyi'i 363)thig sogs 'jam mgon bla mas zhal bkod gnang zhing*/ 'gog pa ri nas gter du bzhes pa'i mchod du khyad par tsan rtsal ste/ dgon ma bas bu lhag pa 'ong sogs kyi lung bstan/ gtsug lag khang dbus mar dus gsum sangs rgyas la nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ rje sku nang gzungs khyad par can sprul pa'i bzo bos bzhengs pa'i sku rgyan dang zhabs sogs sa la ma reg par bar snang na bzhugs par grags pa rje nyid kyis rab gnas ma bod yul du 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rten khyad par can mchod pa'i sprin gtibs pa dang bcas bzhengs/ der grwa tshang blo gsal gling*/ thos bsam glig ngam shag skor ba dang 'dul ba pa/ bde yangs pa/ gsang 'jigs gtsor ston gyi zab mo sngags kyi theg pa'i don nyams su len pa'i sngags pa grwa tshang ste 364)bdun gtsugs pa'i so sor slob dpon re yang bsko bzhag mdzad do/

gdan sa 'di'i khri thogs gnyis pa dpal ldan seṅge gtsang rong thon du 'khrungs/ gsum pa rin chen byang chub mdo khams su 'khrungs/ bzhi pa rje blo bzang nyi ma gtsong kha'i yul du 'khrungs/ lnga pa blo bzang grags pa mdo smad rong por 'khrungs/ drug pa shākaya rin chen phan yul du 'khrungs/ bdun pa smon lam dpal legs/ brgyad pa legs pa chos 'byor tshal du 'khrungs/ dgu pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho gtsang smad du thon pa'i zhal ngor 'khrungs/ bcu pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni/ gtsang rta nag rdo rje gdan du yab rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ rje dge 'dun grub pa'i sngon rabs gsal ba gsungs/ sa sbrul lor bal yul dkar mo ljongs sus chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang gi chos grwa btab gtsug lag khang rten brten 365)par bcas pa bzhengs/ zhe gsum par 'bras spungs kyi khrir phebs/ re brgyad pa chu stag la gshegs/ bcu gcig pa paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ bcu gnyis pa thams mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho ni/ stong lung mda' rtse dga' khang gsar du 'khrungs/ sa phag phan bde legs bshad gling 'dzugs pa gnang*/ al than chos kyi rgyal po'i tshe sgrub la rnam rgyal ma gtsug pas ming der thogs/ al than chos rgyal gyi dbu blar gyur te/ mi rigs mi gcig pa du ma'i dbus su yo byad kyi dngos po 'gang che ba du ma dang*/ tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra zhes khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis las ka phul/ 'jangs pa tham rgyal pos sbyin bdag mdzad de/ thub bstan byams chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi chos ste btab/ dgung lo zhe drug pa sa byir dag zhing du gshegs/ 366)dngul gdug 'bras spungs su bzhugs/ bcu gsum pa bde chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rje yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ hir jing gir gyi rgyal brgyud yab se chen chos khur dang*/ yum bā khen s+thu la gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/

thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nasam rgya mtsho'i sngon rabs gsal bar gsung*/ dgung lo nyer brgyad me 'brug las gshegs/ thum ljags spyan gsum dang gdung ring bsrel la sogs pa bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung 'bras spungs su bzhugs/ bcu bzhi pa paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ gtsang gi rong chen lhan du 'khrungs/ me sbrul la ser 'bras gnyis kyi khrir phebs/ go gsum pa chu stag la gshegs/ gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung rin chen bkra shis lhun po na bzhugs khri thogs bcu lnga pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs kun 'phags rgyal po snang tshul du byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 367)gyis bod 'dir ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa zam ma chad pa bdun 'byon pa'i lnga pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde 'di nyid ni/ rat+na'i spyi lung las/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dbus nas 'byung*/ blo gros stob ldan bzhag po'i 'od zer can/ sna tshogs thams kyis 'gro ba'i kha lo bsgyur/ chos kyi rgyal po dpung dang bcas pa 'byung*/ 'bri yi ra co phag gi mjug ma can/ gung gi 'tshang 'cha' sa yi zas za zhing*/ mig bzhi gyen 'thur dag la blta bar byed/ lce gnyis bden rdzub gnyis kyi shan 'byed pa/ dbus gtsang thams cad sku yi chab 'og 'dus/ rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan bstan pa'i bdag po 'byung*/ lha sa dmar po ri dang chu bo ri/ has po ri dang dbus ri de gsum la/ pho brang bcas nas dbus g.yor mtha' 368)gsum bsdud/ gtsang gi ngam ru ri dag ri bo che/ la stod rdo rje'i ri dang de gsum la/ pho brang byas nas gtsang gi ru gnyis dang*/ mnga' ris bal po'i bar rnams dbang du sdud/ dbus gtsang rnams su chos grwa bcu gsum 'cha'/ zhes dang*/ yang 'phros las/ dbu ltum mdo yi brtan pa dar zhing rgyas/ lcang lo sngags pa'i bstan pas grub thob khengs/

rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing lci la sbram/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa dar las 'jam/ nad tshon mu ge'i sdug bsngal gang yang med/ bde skyid lha yul lta bur kun yang 'tsho/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ za hor gyi gdung gi rigs las yab hor bdud 'dul rab brtan dang*/ yum khri lcam kun dga' lha mdzes kyi sras su rab byung bcu pa'i me sbrul hor zla dgu pa'i lha babs kyi nyin phyi ma skar ma rgyal la sku bltams/ rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i sngon rabs gsal bar 369)gsungs pas/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ dgung lo drug pa chu khyi hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su spyan drangs/ lo dus su smad 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dang*/ khri chen 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis slob dpon bcas dad pa'i dge 'du grangs tshang dbus su tshigs gsum bar ma chad pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas mkhan slob gnyis gtso bor bzung bshes gnyen mkhas pa mang po brten te phyi mtshan nyid kyi theg pa rigs gnas dang bcas sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ dgra bcom pa tsun+dan sogs kyi yang srid 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra'i yang srid zung chen chos dbyings rang grol/ gnas gsar ba mgon po 370)bsod nams mchog ldan/ rnamapar snang mdzad bsams bzhin lo tsā ba'i tshul bzung ba bai ro'i yang srid gter bdag gling pa sogs rigs bdag tu bzhes te/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ sgrub sde brgyad dang yang zab gsang ba bla na med pa'i sngags gtsor gyur gyis gsang sngags gsar rnying du ma'i nyams bzhes mtha' yas pa gsan pas shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thugs su chud de thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ bka' rtsom gyi rim pa'ang mdo sngags rig gnas sogs thams cad la dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ma tshang ba med pa lta bu dang*/

gdul byar gyur pa'i tshogs dag kyang*/ rigs kyis mtho ba gnam bskos ji gir dang*/ bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rus/ 'khon gyi rigs las gdan pa gong 'og gi zhal ngo na rim rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung dpal phag mo grub 371)pa/ skyur ra 'bri gug dang stag lung ga zi 'od gsal lha las chad pa'i smyos kyis mtshon rigs rus mtho ba rnams dang*/ stobs kyis mtho ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sogs rgya hor gyi rgyal rigs dang*/ bod kyi che dgu bla chen dpon chen dang bcas pa ji snyed dang*/ gzhan yang mchog dman bar ma'i skal ldan mtha' yas pa la zab rgyas chos kyi char phab nas mtho ris dang thar pa'i sa bon yang dag par bskrun par mdzad/ gnam bskos rgya nag rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas par thar pa'i sa bon bzhag nas dad pa'i sa la bkod/ nor sna'i rigs byed kyis mtshon bcad ris kyi dngos po 'gangs che spam mthor stsal ba'i gnang skyes dang bcas bod du phebs nas gsar 'dzugs kyis dgon gnas bcu gsum 372)gsar du btab pa ni/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor/ lhun rtse'i rdzong 'og smyug lar dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtsi/ g.yu ru dol tshal ming du dga' ldan gsungs rab gling*/ rul lag byung rnam rgyal rtser dga' ldan chos 'khor gling*/ lho brag do rdzong du dga' ldan don gnyis gling*/ gong dkar du dga' ldan bshad grub gling*/ yar stod du dga' ldan thos bsam dar rgyas gling*/ gtsang gi nyug tu dga' ldan chos 'khor gling*/ de rnams bka' chen bzhi pa brgal brtags kyi gtan la 'phebs pa'i mtshan nyid rgyu'i bshad grwa brgyad dang*/ nang gsang sngags kyi nyams len gtsor skyong ba'i yer ba brag gseb tu dga' ldan gsang sngags gling*/ mnga' ris khyung rdzong du dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling*/ chu shul du gsang sngags byang chub gling*/ phung po ri bo cher bdud 'dul zil gnon gling*/

thob 373)rgyal du dga' ldan rab rgyas gling ste bcu gsum gsar du btab/ de nas dgon rnying gso ba dang gsar btab bcas khyon sum bcu brgal bas mtshon stod mnga' ris nas smad dar rtsi mdo yan du dge dgon gyis khyab par mdzad/ sa rnying sogs grub mtha' gzhan rnams kyang 'phel rgyas su ci 'gyur mdzad pa sogs gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir dga' skyid bde ba'i dpal 'byor rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i phan bdes yun rings bskyangs nas mthar dgu lo re drug pa khyi lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas don dam chos dbyings kyi ngang du bzhugs par mdzad do/ de rjes lugs gnyis kyi srid skyong phyi nang gi rten bzhengs sogs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad de/ zhabs brtan lha khang chen mo gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi bum nang du sku gdung ril 374)po bzhugs pa'i gser gdung rin po ches mtshon sku gsung thugs rten mtha' yas pa dang*/ sde srid rang nyid kyang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi mdzad pa mi g.yel ba'i bstan bcos kyi rim pa'ang dpag med mnga'o/ ༈ khri thogs bcu drug slar yang thugs rje'i nyi ma rgyal mchog drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas la 'go yul o rgyan gling du yab smyos kyi rigs 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin dang*/ yum cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa tshe dbang lha mo'i sras su sku bltams nas dgung lo nyer lnga'i bar du bzhugs te lha sa bla brang steng gser zangs kyibya 'dab rgyu dang bzo bkod khyar par 'phags pa sogs chos dang srid kyi mdzad pa blo'i ra ba las 'das pa bstan nas yang srid phyi ma'i lung bstan mtshan 'dogs sogs kyi bka' 'chems stsal te gzugs sku'i bkod 375)pa bsdus so/ slar yang 'dzam gling skye 'gro yongs kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bdun pa rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho zhes snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum du g.yo ba 'di nyid byon pa'o/

༈ gra chen po ser ra theg chen gling ni/ 'jam mgon gtsong kha pas ser ra chos stings su rtsa she'i 'grel pa mdzad skabs/ bar snang la sher phyin gyi yi ge gser zhun gyis bris pa lta bu gzigs pas theg chen bshad sgrub ma lus pa'i sde 'byung ba lung bstan pa ltar/ tshal dgung thang du 'khrungs pa'i rje'i dngos slob byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes de nyid/ rje rin po che rgya nag tu rgyal po rta'i ming gis spyan 'dren du byung ba'i rgyal tshab tu chos rje shāka ye brdzangs pa/ rgyal po'i bla mchod du gyur/ rgya yul du ha yan si zhes pa'i chos sde btab nas phyogs der mnyam med rje'i ring 376)lugs dar bar byas nas bod du phebs/ rje se ra rtser bzhugs pa'i drug du brgya 'bul mdzad pas/ rje'i zhal nas 'dir khyod kyis dgon sde zhig thob gsung ba dang du blangs te/ sa phag se ra theg chen gyi chos grwa chen po btab cing brten gtsor chos rje nyid kyis rgya yul nas bzhes pa'i tsan+dan dkar po'i gnas bcu nang gzungs su bzhugs pa'i thub dbang la gnas bcus bskor ba'i lha khang bzhengs/ dge 'dun yang 'du che bar stod smad rgya 'brong steng ste grwa tshang bzhi gtsugs/ bka' bcu smra ba dar rgyas bzang po gdan par bskos/ de rjes gdan sa mtshungs med chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang pos mdzad pa sogs so/ lha sa rme ru ni/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyis lha sa'i phyogs bzhir mchod khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde gnyis re gtsugs pa las/ shar ru kā ru dang rme ru zhes byung 377)ba kā ru dar mas bsnubs/ de rgyun slar rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dus dge lugs kyi grong chog par gtsugs pa'o/ ra mi che bzhi sde ni/ tshal pa khri dpon dga' sde bzang pos/ rgyas btab pa'i gtsug lag khang du mchod 'bul bzhi grwa gtsugs pas ming der thogs shing dar ro/ gsang phu zhes pa bod kyi rdo rje gdan lta bu'i chos grwa chen po 'di ni/

sngar jo bo sne thang du bzhugs skabs/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab la/ gsang phu'i phyogs su phyag mdzub gtad de/ lung pa ya gi'i phu na dung g.yas 'khyil rang byon dang*/ nam mkhar gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa 'khor ba dang*/ thub dbang dpang du khyams pa 'jam dbyangs gnyis drangs nges kyi chos la 'gro ba mdzad par snang bas/ der khyod kyis gnas gzhi byas na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur 378)ro zhes lung bstan pas/ 'o na re zhig gsang bar zhu zhus pas gsang phur grags/ mi ring bar nyer spyad ne'u les khyer ba der skyal bas gsang ne'u le thogs zhes pa'i bstan pa'i 'byung khungs kyi chos grwa chen po de btab bo/ thog mar 'dus tshogs lnga tsam las phyis gling stod smad gnyis su gyes te grwa tshang bcu gcig gam bcu gsum du 'tshogs te/ gling stod rngog lo'i khri dang grwa tshang yang*/ sgros snying pa/ gzhi ba/ nyang rong grwa tshang*/ gnas sgo ba gsum/ sgros gsar ba/ ra ba stod smad gnyis rnams so/ gling stod smad gnyis dang ra ba stod smad so sor gyis pa'ang byams pa 'jam dbyangs gnyis rtsod pa'i rten 'brel yin par brjod do/ ༈ 379)dwags po grwa tshang ni/ 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud kyi drug pa chos rje blo gros bstan pas btab/ bla thog lnga pas rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho la phul/ ༈ mnga' ris grwa tshang ni/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho la/ mnga' ris chos rgyal gyis rab byung ngang pa'i khyu 'dra ba mang po btang ba rgyal du grwa tshang gtsugs pas ming der thogs/ ༈ 'phyong rgyas bo bde chen ni/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi dngos slob 'gar ston chos rjes btab/ ༈ bden chen ni/ chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang dang mkhas grub chos rje dge legs dpal bzang mchod yon gnyis kyis btab pa'o/ ༈ smra ba'i ni/ byang chub sems dpa'am smon lam gyi mthu can zhig rgyal mo rong du bon po'i rigs su me lug la 'khrungs/

dbus gtsang du byon gsang 380)phur rngog lo chen por chos nyan nas/ rig gnas la sbyangs/ phan yul gro sar dmar ston cen po las so sor thar pa'i bslab pa yang dag pa blangs/ sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i dbang thob par gyur nas la stod/ lho byang*/ gtsang stod smad/ dbu g.yor gyi gnas mang por chos dar bar mdzad nas blo dang ldan pa mang po la ji ltar 'os pa'i sde snod so so'i bshad pa mdzad/ slob ma rnams la'ang rang gi yid la ji ltar 'thad pa'i grub mthapa' zung chogs sung*/ 'phral du chos bshad pa ltar snang yang rnal 'byor la rgyun tu gnas pas rlung lnga'i khog so sor gzigs/ shing mo yos los na len+d+ra'i dgon gnas btab/ ar byang chub ye shes de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'chad 'phro la gshegs 'dug nga yang*/ nga yang slob mas spur chos khri'i kha nas gdan 'dren pa zhig byed 381)ces rgyun ldan du gsung ba la/ khams pa phob phob 'di 'dra mi byed par/ dga' ldan du lha'i bu bdud rtsi 'thung ba zhig byed gsung ba/ spur chos khri kha nas gdan 'dren pa ma byung yang*/ zhi bar gshegs pa dang chos 'phro bcad pa'i bar na nyin zhag nyis las med par gshegs nas dga' ldan du bzhugs par nges so/ ༈ lo tsā ba rong zom chos bzang ni/ ru lag gtsang smad kyi sa'i cha rog gi snar lung par 'khrungs/ sku gzhon nu nas sgra tshad sogs shes bya mtha' dag la mkhas shing dngos stobs kyi rig pas gzhan dag tshar gcod nus/ kha gcig paṇ+ḍi ra smṛ ti dang*/ kha gcig paṇ+ḍi ta phra la ring mo'i skye ba yin yang zer/ phyis jo bo dang mjal te rtsod pa mdzad pas/ jo bos rtsod pa'i 'gram ma theg nas/ khyed rgya gar gyi ā tsar+ya nag 382)po zhabs kyi skye bar 'dug ste kho bos khyed dang chos kyi gtam bya bar ga la nus gsungs/ spyi mthun du 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par grags/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la mtshan nyid gsan/ bcu gsum pa yan la gsan pa rdzogs te/

bdag thos pa chung ba yang ma yin te/ chos thams cad ma thos pa med/ thos pa che ba yang ma yin te chos thams cad tshar te las ma thos gsungs te don la mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob par bshad/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang po brten nas de dge lo tsā ba mdzad de/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ gshen rje dgra nag dang*/ 'jam dpal sngas don dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud la sogs pa mang du bsgyur/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus nyang smad du 'gar ston tshul khrims bzang po la gsang sngags rnying ma gsan pa'i nub gcig masnal lam du/ gsang ba snyig pos zan byas/ sangs rgyas mnyam 383)sbyor gyis tshod ma byas gsol ba rmis pa slob dpon la zhus pas shin tu bzang*/ chos khong du chud pa'i rtags yin 'dug de gnyis la 'grel pa re yis gsungs te 'grel pa re yang mdzad/ bslab pa gsum rgyud la brten pa'i ched du/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i dam tshig mdo rgyas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i 'grel pa tshul bzhi yan lag bco lnga/ shes rab kyi bslab pa'i ched du rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom gyi man ngag rnams mdzad/ che gnyan gyi mi kun ma zad/ bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis kyang chos zhu zhing ci bgyi'i bka' nod cing 'phrin las sgrub/ slob dpon pad+ma/ bai ro tsa na/ g.yu sgra snying po sogs dang*/ bi ma la dang*/ myang ting 'dzin bzang po/ rma gnyags khu khyung sogs kyi yang gdams skor ma lus pa thugs la mnga'/ a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyis gdams 384)pa'i bdag por yang 'gyur/ 'di la rgya gar bdun rgyud dang*/ rgya'i ha shang bdun brgyud kyi gdams pa yang yod par grags te mdor na rgya bod kun tu grags pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyir pa yin no/ 'di la sras rgyud dang slob rgyud gnyis las/ sras rgyud ni gzi brjid 'bar dang 'bum 'bar gnyis las mchid pa'i gdung rabs mang tsam byung yang de sang gdung brgyud chad par snang ngo*/ slob brgyud ni/

spyir dam pa 'di la de dus kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs pas bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ khyad par du 'phags pa go rub lo tsā ba/ mar pa do pa/ rje 'gos la sogs pa lo tsā ba bcun/ g.yag rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa grub thob chen po sum cu rtsa lnga/ ma gcig kha ma'i ming po rje mkhan po bu la sogs pa sgom chen grub pa thob pa brgya dang brgyad bcu/ yol dge bsnyen rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ yang mkhyen bla ma 385)sogs ston pa gdugs thob pa lnga brgya la sogs pa byung ba yin no/ ༈ ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa de ni/ yul ding ri/ gdung rus ni ldong*/ yab gtso rgyal dang yum stong mi rje ma gnyis kyis sras su chu pho stag la 'khrungs/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang 'khrungs lo gcig bla ma rdo rje dpal ba la rig 'dzin bcu dang rdzogs chen dmar khrid la sogs chos mang du gsan/ gyang rim dang kong mo'i ri la mtshams mdzad pas phyag chen gyi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ chos rje ko pa lar bsnyen rdzogs tshig rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan du gsol/ phyis nang stod ko brag gi dgon pa btab pas sa skam po chu mig brdol/ ko brag pa zhes grags/ sgrub pa po dang mkhas grub che dgu thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs/ chos la'ang 386)'di mi mkhyen bya ba med/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo brgyad bcu pa lcags mo bya'i lo la zhi bar gshegs/ slom ma yang dpal yang dgon pa/ de'i gcen po rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ rin po che lha pa/ rin po che rgyal po/ mtshims nam mkha' grags la sogs pa bstan pa'i bdag po mang po dang*/ dpyal lo/ khro phu lo tsā/ chag lo/ nam mkha' dpal mo/ ras pa lo tsā ba/ gnyal lo la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba mang po dang*/ dge bshes gtsang pa/ dge bshes nyi ma/ mnga' ris dgra btsoms/ mkhas btsun byang chub la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po dang*/ myang 'tshal pa/ lha rje skyob pa ba so zur/

gnyos ston zhig po/ sham 'bum/ chu mig pa/ dar seng la sogs pa'i dgon sde'i bdag po sogs slob ma bsam yas par byung bar grags so/ ༈ na ro pa'i lcam mo ni gu las byung ba'i chos drug gi rim pa 387)ni/ lugs de'i len pa po ni mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor te/ de gdung rus khyung po/ yab stag skyes dang yum bkra shis skyid gnyis kyi sras su snye mo ra mangs su 'khrungs/ btsas ba thag tu rgya gar gyi grub/thob a mo gha byon nas lung legs par bstan/ bla ma 'byung gnas seṅge la rdzogs chen sems sai'i skor zhus nas bshad pas slob ma bdun brgya tsam byung*/ rgya gar du lan gnyis tsam byon nas rdo rje gdan sa dang mi tri pa las sogs la chos mang du gsan/ der rdo rje 'chang dngos la thug pa su yod dris pas/ na ro pa'i lcam mo nī gu ma zhes bya ba yod de/ de dag pa'i sa na sku 'ja' lus su gyur pas su rung rung gis mi mthong*/ so pa gling gi dur khrod du mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpon la 'byon pas las dag na der mthong srid zer/ der phyin te na mo bud+dha ya'i gsol ba btab 388)pas/ tā la bdun srid tsam gyi nam mkha' la sku mdog smug nag rus pas rgyan pa phyag na kha ṭām dang thod pa bsnams pa gar bsgyur ba zhig mthong nas/ nī gu ma yin par nges nas phyag dang bskor ba byas/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ nga ni sha za'i ḍā ki yin gsungs/ yang btus de zhus pas/ gsang sngags kyi gdams pa dgos na gser dgos gsung*/ gser srang brgya yod japa de phul bas phyag tu bzhes nas nags su gtor song bas/ sha za mkha' 'gro ma rang yin nam the tshoms su gyur pa na/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mang po 'dus nas dkyil 'khor sprul/ der sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dbang bskur nas/ mkha' 'gro mas dpag tshad gsum du khyer nas gser gyi ri'i khar bzhag der rmi lam du rdo rje btsun mos chos drug tshar gcig

dngos su tshar gsum 389)rdo rje'i tshig rkang sgyu ma lam rim gnang*/ gzhan yang rgyud dang sgrub thabs shin tu mang po gsungs nas/ chos drug gi gdams pa 'di rnams shes pa nga dang la bangs ma gtogs med brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du tshig brgyud gyis/ de rnam ngas byin gyis rlob cing lung yang ston pa yin gsungs/ de nas slar bod du byon pa'i mnga' ris su jo bo dang mdzal/ gsang 'dus la sogs chos mang du gsan glang ri thang pa la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ phan yul 'jog por 'chad nyan dgon btab/ 'jog po nas gdan 'dren byung bas shangs su byon lo gsum gyi nang du zhong zhong la sogs dgon gnas brgya rtsa brgyad btab/ 'dis dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs par grags/ slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rme'u ston pa/ g.yor po rgya mo che/ rdul ston rin dbang*/ la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ rmog cog pa/ zhang sgom 390)chos seng rnams yin/ brgyud pa bzhi pa rmog lcog pa ni/ lha phu spang rtsar 'khrungs/ lo bcu bdun la zhong zhong du chos sgor zhugs bla ma shangs pas smin par mdzad/ brgyud 'dzin lnga pa smog lcog pa'i gsung gi sras grub thob skyer sgang pa dharma seṅge yin/ brgyud pa drug pa sangs rgyas gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab ces bya ba skyer sgang pa'i thugs kyi sras su 'khrungs pa de yin/ brgyud pa bdun pa sangs rgyas ston pa sangs rgyas gnyag ston gyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa de yin/ de'i slob ma mkhas grub shangs ston/ de'i slob ma 'jog pa rgyal mtshan 'bum/ de'i slob ma grub thob chos 'byung rin chen la sogs pa rnams kyis shangs pa'i chos rnams dar bar mdzad pa yin no/ sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsa na/ yul lho phu chu khyer/ yab mar pa dbang phyug yum rgal mo 'od zer gnyis kyi sras su chu pho byi ba la 391)bstan pa spel bar smon lam gyi mthu grub pa ste/ de yang mar pa'i drung du sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i nyams len gtso bor ston nas mkhas nyan mdzad pas rje mar pas rdzong dkar bskyed mos tshal gyis pa'i dpyad kyi yon tan rnams bshad nas gnas de 'tshol la bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa skyong zhes lung bstan yang cung zad rten 'brel ma 'gregs pas rin spungs kyi thad kyi sa der bzung ste gnas gzhi ba de btab rtag gnyis kyi bshad pa gtso bor bzung nas bshad sgrub kyi 'phrin las bskyangs skabs nub gcig mar pa byon nas sngar lung bstan pa'i gnas de 'di ma yin skye ba phyi ma 'grub pa'i smon lam 'thob gsungs pa ltar/

skye ba phyim snar rdo dper 'khrungs nas rong byams chen du rab tu rigs sad pas sngon gyi mdzad spyod dran pas sku tshe sngon mar lung bstan pa'i gnas btsal bas 'di yin dgongs/ kha rag bum sgrub kyi dgon gnas 395)btab nas 'chad nyan bskyangs skabs nub gcig mar pa byon nas 'di nas yar rong chung du song zhes pa'i lung bstan gyis bskul ba ltar rong chung brgyud de byon pas rgyun ldan mtshan brjod la zhal 'don mdzad par skyid tshal gyi sa'i thad der phebs skabs chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'jugs/ zhes pa'i tshig mtshams su cung zad sku ngal brten pa der brtags pas sngar bla mas lung bstan pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang tshang 'dug pas 'di rang yin par nges shes bskyes te 'bras yul rdzong mkhar bskyid mos tshal gyi bshad grwa btab/ sde srid rin spungs pas dbu'i mchod gnas su bkur nas dus bzhi khebs pa'i gzhis kyi sa ris rgya cher brtsal/ chod kyi 'phrin las bskyangs pas kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel zhis snyan pa'i grags pas khyab ste/ dang por zab 396)gsal mnyam med zhi ba lha/ bar du sgrub brgyud gtsun rgyan mes ston mtsho bur/ tha mar spangs rtogs mthar phyin sangs rgyas 'phel/ zhes bshad/ slob ma yang gdan sa'i bka' babs sa 'jam dbyang kun dga' chos bzang*/ kun mkhyen go bo 'byams bya rgod shongs kyi gnas gzhi 'debs pa po/ 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs mtha' yas pa byung ngo*/ ༈ rje btsun mi la ral pas ni sgrub brgyad kyi bstan pa'i bka' gtso bor bzung ba ste/ de ni yab ming la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang*/ yum myang gza' dkar rgyal gnyis kyi sras su lcags pho 'brug gi lo la sku bltams/ mtshan thos pa dga' zhes btags/ dang por lha rje gnubs chung la drag bsngags gza' gdong dmar nag dang sgrul sogs gsan/ lo sum bcu rtsa brgyad lon pa na rje mar pa'i drung du byon gdams pa gnang dgos pa'i zhu ba

397)phul bas/ lo drug tu phru rlog pa dang mkhar las mang po dang rdo skyal ba sogs sgal pa rnag khrag du song song 'bungs/ de nas snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang khyon lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du bzhugs/ zhe lnga nas sgrub pa la rtsa gcig tu lo bzhi bcu'i bar mnyam bzhag mdzad pas nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs so/ rje btsun de la bu slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang mchog gsum ste/ mi'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i mchog rje sgom po pa/ mi la yin 'dul ba'i mchog bkra shigs tshe rings ma/ ḍā ki ma rnams 'dul ba'i mchog sngags skyes lhan gcig skye pa'i sgrol ma rnams so/ de la rje sgam po pa ni/ sngon rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du 398)khyim bdag phyug cing rigs mtho sras su zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshe/ bya rgod phung rir byon ste thub pa'i dbang por mo tang 'dzin rgyal po zhu ba la gsol bas/ zhal gyis bzhes par rang gi khyim du ston pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas legs par bsnyen bkur ston pas kyang khyod kyis snyigs ma'i dus su mdo sde 'di zung gcig ces bka' stsal/ de bzhin du bgyid la gso zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa tshe ston pas kyang khyod mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa'i tshe dang nyid kyis grogs byed do zhes bka' stsal ba'i byang chub sems dpa'am zla 'od gzhon nu de rje sgam po dang*/ grogs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thub pa ni phag mo grub pa yin par bshad do/ rje de nyid ni yul bung snyir/ yab rnyi ba rgyal po dang yum sho mo gza' gnyis kyi sras su mo lug gi lo la sku bltams/ gzhon nu'i dus sman bslabs shing*/ nyi shu 399)rtsa drug pa la dge bshes shan pa gling pa la chig rdzogs mdzad/ de nas rje btsun mi la'i snyan pa gsan pas de rtsad bcad pas snye nam gyi ri la bzhugs pa thos der byon pas mdun du chang ka pā la gang 'dug pa gnang byung bas/

dge slong yin pas btung du mi rung snyam byung ba na/ bla mas mkhyen te/ nan gyis bka' rtsal byung bas/ lhag ma la lus par gsol bas/ khyod kyi ming ci yin gsung bsod nams rin chen bya la lags zhus pas/ bsod nams bsod nams bya ba lan gsum gsungs nas/ bsod nams tshogs gnyis bsags las byung*/ sems can kun gyi rin po che/ zhes pa'i mgur yang gsungs/ de nas gdams pa zab mo gcig zhu zhus pas/ khyod kyi dbang thob bam gsungs/ mar yul blo ldan la rin chen rgyan drug dang bde ba mchog 400)la sogs pa'i dbang mang po thob/ dbu ru byang phyogs su bka' gdams kyi gdams pa yang mang du nyan/ zhag bcu gsum du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhig kyang yod zhus pas/ ha ha zhes bzhad mo chen po zhig mdzad/ de 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin pas gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i lha la bskal ba'i bar du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de 'tshang rgya ba la mi phan/ bye ma btsir bas mar khu 'chad rgyu ma bcug de bcug na da lta bod grub thob kyis gang ba 'ong ba yin/ bka' gdams pa la bskyed rim lha pho ring po re dang rdzogs rim snod bcud 'od gsal du sdud pa re las med/ da khyod nga'i gtum mo a thung sgoms dang gsungs gdams pa rnams 401)gnang ste/ bsgoms pas rtags mthara' yas pa rim par byung ba bla ma la zhus pas/ thams cad la lus kyi gnas 'dir rlung dang khams zin pa'i rtags yin/ skyon yang min yon tan yang ma yin da dung bsgoms shig gsungs/ de ltar zhabs drung du zla ba bcu gsum bar bsdad de nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/ da dbus pa ston pa rang dbus su bzhud gsungs/ khyod dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang ma 'grogs/ zhes sogs bslab bya mang po gnang da dung ri khrod 'grims la lo gsum na khyod la dge sbyor sha ma zhig skye'o gsungs/ de nas dbus su byon 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bzhugs pas bla ma rje btsun chos kyi skur gzigs/
