de nas sgam por byon nas chos kyi 'phrin las bskyangs te/ rje btsun gyi thabs lam dag phyag chen logs logs su mi mdzad par/ sngags kyi snod du 402)rung ba rnams la thabs lam gyi gdams pa bstan/ dbang bskur med kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod du rung ba rnams la phyag chen gyi gdams pa btab ste lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya ba'i khrid rim yang mdzad/ de la dwags po'i rtogs chos kyang zer/ bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i rim pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad gdams mang du bstan pas/ 'di nas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres su gyur te/ snyan pas phyogs thams cad khyab/ mthar dgung lo bcun cu rtsa lnga chu mo byi ba'i lo la gshegs so/ gsung las skyes pa'i bu chen mthara' yas kyang gtso che ba sho rom 'phags pa/ zim shing ye shes snying po/ gser sgom ye shes snying po/ rai nyi ba chos kyi g.yu drung ste grub thob kyi bu bzhi/ dwags po sgom tshul/ phag mo grub pa/ 'ba' rom pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa ste brgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhi 403)dwags po 'dul 'dzin la sogs pa brgyad re bu chen bcu drug tu grags so/ de la dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ bskal bzag gi sangs rgyas byams pa'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa seṅge zhes bya bar lung bstan pa de yin zhing*/ zhing 'dir ni sngon dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi slob ma pradzñā a laṅkā zhes bya ba dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma'i slob ma rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la sogs dang*/ phyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba rin chen gsal rnams su skye ba zung nas/ de rjes mdo khams yul gyi ti shod gangs kyi ra bar/ yab gshes gnyen gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa sgom pa rdo rje mgon dang*/ yum rnal 'byor ma lha thog bza' gnyis kyi sras su lcags pho stag la sku bltams/ yab las rgyal po'i srog snying zhus nas bsgrub pas grub pa brnyes/ mkhan po mal 'dul 'dzin la/ bsnyen par rdzogs 'dul ba

404)la mkhas par mdzad/ de nas chos rje sgam po pa'i drung du byon nas dbangadang gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ thabs lam gyi gdams ngag gnang nas bsgoms pas zhag dgu na btsan thabs su bde drod 'bar te rtogs pa 'khrungs/ tshur phur dgon sde btab/ de nas phyogs nges med du phebs te 'gro don phrin las rgya cher bskyangs nas mthar sku 'da' khar nye 'khor bgres pa rnams la dngos po mang du yod pa rnams kyis dkon mchog gi rten dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gyi gsungs nas chu mo glang gi lo dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu bas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ slob ma mtha' yas pa'i nang nas sangs rgyas rab chen ni/ yul yar klung du yab gtsang pa dpal grags dang*/ yum btsun chung ma bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus nas gar byon du 'ja' gur 'ong ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma gser 405)gyi rgyan can bzhi phyi bzhin du 'phrang ba yod par grags/ dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs bshes gnyen du mas la gsan pa mang du mdzad/ 'gro don phun sum tshogs pa'i mthar dgung lo bdun bcu pa dbyar zla ra ba'i nyer lnga la dag zhing du gshegs so/ de'i slob ma chos rje spom brag pa yin te/ de ni skye ba snga ma bya rgod phung ri dang rdo rje gdan gyi bar du sa thob pa'i byang sems ye shes blo gros zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes par bshad/ de nas 'dar 'bri dam pa chos phyug ces bya bar 'khrungs/ lo bcu bzhi la sangs rgyas ras chen dang mjal bas phyag na rdo rje dngos yon pa'i snang ba shar/ sa gzhan du 'gro 'dod pa la dus gsum mkhyen pa dngos su byon nas khyod kyi bu slob dang yang slob kyi bar du yang 'phrin las rgya chen po 'ong ba yin/ gar yang ma 'gro pa 'di nyid du sgoms dang rang gzhan gnyis ka don 'grub ces 406)lung bsran pa ltar/ spel sgo dgon par phyag phab nas lo bcu drug sgrub pa mdzad pas dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par shar snyan pas phyogs thams cad du khyab bo/

de'i slob ma rin po che karma pak+shi yin/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnams thos pa tsam gyis thugs su chud snyan pa'i grags pa shin tu che ba'i tshe hor rgyal pos gser yig pa btang ste gdan drangs/ rgyal po 'khor bcas byang chub la btsud mi nyam 'ga'i yul du gtsug lag khang chen po brtsegs/ mthar dgung lo brgyad bcu pa chu mo lug gi lo la gshegs so/ de'i slob ma grub thob o rgyan pa yin/ de'i slob ma chos rje rang 'byung pa yin/ karma pak+shis stod lung 'phar tshang du grong 'jug mdzad pas shi nas log pa mi rung snyam/ pha mas spyan la khab kyis btsabs pas der rten 'brel ma 'grib nas tsa'i phu gangs zhul mo'i 'gram du 407)chos rjes srid pa bar ma'i gzugs kyi byon nas der shing pho spre'u'i lo yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ de nas lo lnga lon pa na grub chen o rgyan pa'i gsung gis sang nga'i bla ma 'byon pa yod gsungs nas stan mthon po gshams/ der grub chen pa'i drung du byon pa na bstan mthon po de la thogs pa med par 'dzegs te bzhugs par/ grub chen pa'i gsung gi byis pa khyod nga'i bla ma'i gdan la sdod do pa ci yin gsungs pas/ bla ma dang nga yin te/ da khyod la re dgos par 'dug byas nas zhol gyis babs/ de nas o rgyan pas sems bskyed dang 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi dbang dang ma phur gyi dbang rnams gnang*/ de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa la/ mkhan po gzhon nu byang chub dang*/ slob dpon dge 'dun pa rin chen sgang las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bde chen steng dang lhun grub steng gyi ri khrod btab/ de nas hor 408)rgyal po'i spyan 'dren pa byung nas thegs/ 'gro don dpag med mdzad nas bod la phebs khar khyi lo ri bo rtse lngar thegs/ de nas bod la phebs nas bsam yas 'chims phur ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu bzhugs nas/ slar yang rgya'i yul du thegs nas/

der sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ste chos nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs par bstan nas rgyal po 'khor bcas dad pa'i sa la bkod do/ de ni dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa sa mo yos kyi lo yin par bshad do/ slob ma yang g.yung ston rdo rje dpal la sogs pa mtha' yas pa byung ngo*/ rje rol ba'i rdo rje ni/ rang byung pa'i sku skye ba de ma thag pa yul kong yul du 'khrungs/ 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs nas dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi la gshegs/ de'i sku'i skye ba de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ yum e myang du shing pho byi ba'i lor 'khrungs/ phrin las rgya cher spel nas dgung lo sum cu 409)rtsa gnyis pa shing mo lug la gshegs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i yang srid chos rje mthong ba don ldan ni karma pak+shi sku bltams yal dang nye ba'i sa cha ngom du mi pho sprel lor 'khrungs/ phrin las rgya cher spel nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad pa chu mo bya la gshegs/ de dag ni brgyud pa dang po'i skabs so/ sprul pa'i sku'i brgyud pa gnyis pa'i rim pa brjod par bya ste/ rje btsun ti li pa'i slob ma khol po dga' zhes bya ba las sku tshe 'phos nas/ na ro pa'i slob ma dza lan+dha rar 'khrungs pa'i tshe nags su me tog 'thur byon pa'i skabs zhig sprin gsegs nas mkha' 'gro'i lung gis bu bu byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ rgyal bas lung bstan bod ces grags pa'i yul/ der song khyod kyi 'dod pa 'grub byed de/ bde gshegs nyid sprul khyod kyi mthong bar 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan pa 410)ltar bod du shon bshes gnyen du ma dang mjal/ khyad par rje mi la dang mjal nas/ rje btsun mi la/ khyod ni kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ yang yang skye zhing chos spyod de/ zhes sogs lung bstan nas bal bod kyi mtshams su bka' thub la gnas pa las sku tshe 'phob ste/ dbur stod du yab dge bsnyen 'byung seng dang yum sgrom ma 'bum gyi sras su mi pho byi ba la 'khrungs/

cher gyur pa nang sgam po pa khu dbon gyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs mtshan tshul khrims dpal du gsol/ phrin las rgya cher bskyangs nas chu pho byi bar gshegs/ de'i sku skye dgo slong nam mkha' 'od drug cu rtsa bdun la gshegs/ de'i sku'i skye ba bkra shis grags pa brgyad bcu rtsa gsum la gshegs/ de'i sku'i skye ba rtogs ldan grags seṅge/ de'i sku'i skye ba chos rje chos dpal ye shes/ de'i sku'i skye ba chos kyi 411)rje zhwa dmar bzhi pa'o/ ༈ rje sgam po pas dge bshes khams pa chen po zhes ma gas par mdzad pa'i rje phag mo grub pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po rang nyid yin pas sangs nyid kyi lung bstan cing*/ rgya bod kun tu grub pa'i skyes mchog rnams su sku'i skye ba bzung ba ni/ o rgyan gyi yul du srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin zhes bya bas rjes su bzung ba'i dpa' bo rdo rje de nas rim gyis dam tshig rdo rje/ pad+ma'i rdo rje/ lhan gcig skyes pa'i rdo rje/ tha ga pa rdo rje sogs su skye ba bzung nas bod 'dir yul mdo khams kyi lho brgyud 'bri lung rne shod tu lcags pho stag gi lo la 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu lon tshe slob dpon lhing ngo 'od zer rgyal mtshan pa las rab tu byung mtshan rdo rje rgyal por gsol/ bcu dgu lon tshe dbus su phebs/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes gang sa dang don steng pa dang*/ 412)bya yul ba sogs la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ nyi shu rtsa lngar zul phur bya 'dul ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas sa skya pa chen po la lam 'bras sogs gdams pa mang du gsan/ de rjes rje sgam po pa'i drung du byon pas bla mas chos gang la nyan zhes sogs kyi gsung gling mang tsam gsungs byung bar/ bla ma sa chen gyis mthopang lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo sprad lags zhus pas/ zan changs zhig phyag na 'dug pa der/ khyod kyi de las 'di mi dga' ri tshi gsungs pas thugs skyog gis song bar/

khyed rang shar gyi ri di'u pha gi'i khar khams seng la byon gcig khong 'ga' zhig gis chos zin pa dang*/ 'o sgom gsung gling bya'o gsungs ba/ di'u shar ma'i khar byon nas mno bsam mdzad pas/ sngar gyi chos thams cad phyi shun dang snun par song nas nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu'i rtogs pa bzang 413)po 'khrungs/ thugs rab kyang nam mkha' la mdung bskor ba ltar song*/ de nas spyan sngar byon pas sgam po pas mkhyen te/ da nga la yang de las lhag pa brtan rgyu med 'on kyang nga rang gi lugs kyi khrid gcig bya'o gsungs nas lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi khrid gnang*/ de nas ring por ma lon par sgam po pa gshegs/ de nas thugs dgongs la/ bags khrod dben pa ste dbang gis/ spyod cing rang dbang rten mdzad gsol/ zhes pa'i gsol ba btab nas/ gdan sa mthil du sa pho stag gi lo phebs/ der rgya sgom rmi ras bya ba'i spyil por bzhugs nas khyod kyi spyil po 'di skyid bya ba lan gsum gsungs pas bzhed na phul bas chog zer/ sa de gnas kyi snying por 'dug pas 'o na/ kho bo'i ko gdan long shog gsungs te de nyid du 414)gnas bcas/ der mjag spyil las med pas/ de nas stag lung thang pas bla ma'i spyil po gcig byed par zhus pas/ nyin gcig la grub na gyis gsungs/ de nas ring ba mi rung gsungs nas nyin gcig kho na la glang spyil de sgrub po/ der dge 'dun mang du 'dus nas grwa pa brgyad brgya la gdugs thogs kyi slob ma lnga brgya byung bar grags/ de ltar chos kyi 'phrin las rgya cher mdzad nas lcags pho stag gi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer lga la sprul pa'i sku bsdu bar mdzad do/ bu che byon pa ni/ mos gus mthar thugs stag lung pa/ thar thug snang phu ba/ mthar thug par phu ba/ nus pa'i mthar thug 'chan bu rgya ras te mthar thug gi bu bzhi/ skal ldan ye shes seṅge/

rtogs mi nyag sgom rings/ grub thob nyang re seng bo/ kun 415)ldan gtsang ba rab chung rnams la gdams pa'i bu bzhi zer/ rje 'jig rten mgon po 'ban dha phug ba/ chos rje ldum/ chos rje gtum rnams la ro gcig rtogs pa phyed bzhi/ gshes sgom dkar ba sogs thugs kyi sras bzhi dang*/ rin chen shug rtsar ba sogs yi ge ma'i bu bzhi dang*/ ye phug pa sogs nye ba'i sras bzhi sogs mtha' yob 'di la 'bri khung sgom pa shāka rin gyis/ gdan sa dpal gyi phag gru de/ chu mig brgya rtsa'i mgo bo yin/ zhes smra pa ltar bod kyi yul 'dir gtsug lag khang dang sde dgon las sogs pa gdan sa 'di las mched pa mang bar bshad do/ 'bri khungs las mched pa bod khams gnyis su bgrang gis mi lang ba dang*/ gling ras pa las mched pa 'brug skor rnams kyis bya rgod kyi 416)nyi lam bcu gsum gyi khyab par grags pa dang*/ stag lung thang pa gyes pa'ang dbus dang khams kyi sa char shin tu mang ba dang bcas phyogs thams cad la khyab par grags so/ de rjes phag gru'i gdan sa 'bri khung chos rjes mdzad pas longs spyod chung zhing grwa pa rnams re che bar byung bas/ 'gro mgon la gsol ba btab pas/ 'gro mgon byon nas za 'og gi 'bol snying pa zhig 'dug pa de kho rang tshor gtod/ khyod rang dbu ru byang phyogs su song gsungs pa'i lung bstan byung ba ltar/ gdan sa lo gsum du nyi ba zhig mdzad nas/ dgung lo sum cu tsang bdun pa sa phag 'bri khung du phebs/ lo de nyid la btsun gsar brgya thams pa byung*/ za mo'i gdams pa de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i slob ma mang po o rgyan dang dza lan+dha ra tshun chod dang ri bo rtsi lnga yon chod kyi layang sul dang dben gnas thams cad du khyab 417)par mdzad/ khyad par lcags pho byi ba'i lo la 'bri khung thel gyis chos sde btab/ phyis dgung lo drug bcu'i steng du phebs pa'i tshe/ siṅga la'i gling gi dgra bcom pa kha le pa

me tog bzhi pa zhig sgam bur rgyas btab nas so sor ma 'phrod kyi bar mi rnying bar byin gyis brlabs te/ gcig 'bri zhes bya ba'i sar slob dpon klu sgrub byang sems rin chen dpal du skye ba blangs nas yod pa de la phul/ gcig rat+na ku ṭi zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang na byang chub sems dpa' skal ldan shing rta yod pa de las phul/ gcig dwi bhā ṣi zhig yod pa de la phul/ gcig des lha chen po zhig bzhengs 'dug pa de'i thugs gar bzhog ces gsungs pa ltar/ rje 'bri khug pa ni klu sgrub yin pas bshad de/ de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po de ni dgung lo bdun 418)bcu rtsa lnga pa me lo glang gi lo la gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ de yang gshegs par nye ba na drung na gnas pas/ da chos rje rin po che gang du gshegs zhus par/ nga gang du yag mi 'gro/ khyer rang slob ma rnams kyi khams rgyud la sdod pa yin gsungs/ slob ma grub pa brnyes pa bgrang bar mi nus kyang*/ 'gro don skyong nus pa/ rje spyan snga rin po che/ dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ gnyos 'gar chos gsum/ dbon sher 'byung*/ bsod nams gling pa/ ti shri ras pa/ shri phug pa/ ba lu gongs pa*/ nyi ma byang chub/ g.yag rgyu dpal grags/ byang chub rdo rje la sogs pa mang ngo*/ gru'i ma stag lung thang pa ni/ g.yang shod bong ra steng pu chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/ bco brgyad la rab tu byung nas 'gro mgon lo drug tu brten/ de nas sngar po to ba'i bzhugs gnas kyi sa der lcags byi la stag lung dgon gnas 419)btab lo ngo sum bcu tsam gyi bar 'gro don mdzad chos dang zang zing gi 'byor pa mnga' bas phag gru'i gdan sar dkon mchog gi srid zhu bskrun pa'i dge stobs bla na med par mdzad/ khams phyogs su'ang ri bo che la sogs pa'i dgon sde rgyas par spel/ mthar dung lo drug bcu rtsa dgu pa rta'i lo la zhi bar gshegs so/

dag sna phu ba chen ras myang stod glang phu snar/ yab rgyal po skyabs dang yum gzus mo dar chung gi sras su sa spre la 'khrungs/ de dus kyi mkhas grub du ma la mdo rgyud dbang lung man ngag mang du gsan pas da lta 'dzam gling nang gdams pa'i thob rgya nga rang las che ba med snyam mdzad/ de nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad pa shing mo bya la 'gro mgon phag gru'i zhabs spyi bos blangs nas gdams khrid zhus/ 420)lo bdun zla ba bdun zhag bdun gyi bar mtshams kyis dam bca' zhus nas bsgrags ngar phug tu bsgom pa pas zhag gsum na rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ bla ma'i drung du rtogs pa phul ste bsgoms shig gsungs nas bsgoms lags pas/ bsgom bya dang bsgom byed stor nas thal/ zhes sogs kyi mgur gsungs so/ de nas phyogs thams cad du 'gro don mdzad nas/ phyis rna phur dgon pa'i gzhi bzung nas gzhan don mang du bskyangs/ der slob ma rnams la khrid kyi rim pa dang tshogs chos mang du skyong gis bzhugs/ skabs zhig dam tshig lnga pa gsungs zhing yod pa'i 'phro ma dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i mi gnyis byung bas rkyen byas/ sa spre lo drug cu re gcig la gshegs so/ de'i slob ma gtsang pa ye shes rdo rje ni/ rna phur lo lnga'i bar gdams khrid gsan gdan pa bzung dgos pa'i 421)bka' gnang ba ltar rna phu'i gdan sa bzung*/ 'brug 'dzin pa'i lung bstan kyang byung ba grags/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa rnams la sbyangs yon mthar phyin pa gsan/ 'brug tu dgon pa btab pas lo de nyid la spyil po stong tsam thebs/ 'jig rten gyi zhen pa log tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa/ bla ma'i mos gus gsum gtso bor 'dzin cing phyag chen gyi rtog pa shar ba'i slob ma stong phrag lnga tsam byung*/ bya rgod kyi nyi lam bco brgyad du 'brug pa'i bu slob kyis khyab par byas nas dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig la lcags mo lug la gshegs so/

mchog gi slob ma ni/ dang por chengs spa rkyang gnyis te/ spa ri gling btas/ rkyang mo kha bas dgon rkyang mo kha btab nas 'gro don mdzad do/ bar du tshe ba rgya 'bras gnyis te/ rgya grwa'i 422)zar phur rgya yags btab/ 'bras lo ba ni dgon pa'i ming ste myang stod na yod de de gnyis kyis kyang 'gro don bskyangs so/ thar mar che ba lo rgod gnyis te/ de ltar lo ras nas brgyud pa rnams la rmad 'brug dang*/ rgod tshang nas brgyud pa rnams la stod 'brug ces grags so/ sgo tshul khrims snying po las yang dag pa'i don bsnyes pa'i rin po che yul tsha ba grur/ yab sngags pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang yum mang skyid bya ba'i sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te chu mo yos la 'khrungs/ lo lnga lon skabs yab kyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bshad pa shin tu bred nas nyin mtshan dal med du lha phyag dang bskor ba mdzad/ de nas cher song ba na/ byi'u ston/ rngog mdo sde gsang phu lo tsā ba rnams la gsan pa mang du mdzad/ dpal rga lo'i spyan sngar byon pas zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa lhag par 423) skyes/ sgom lung zhus pas thog mar he ru ka'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya snyam pa gyis gsungs/ sbyor drug la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du gnang*/ dgung lo so gsum par slob dpon sgom pa dang mjal/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gnang nas bsgoms pas/ shes rab kyi rtsal skyes te gsungs rabs kyi tshog don mang po 'di'i don 'din yin 'dug snyam pas/ rtags dpyad ma byed par sgoms shig nged kyi 'di byin rlabs la re ba yin gsungs nas bsgom pas gzod dngos po'i de kho na nyid lhang gis rtogs te/ bya byed thams cad gzhi rtsa dang bral bar thugs su chud/ sngar rang gis chos zab mo bshad pa rnams kyang don thog tu dus der phebs nas smyon pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas gzhan don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo bdun bcu rtsa gcig pa chu mo glang gi lo la zhi

424)bar gshegs so/ de'i bu slob gnas la ming btags pa lta ri ba nam mkha' 'od/ lha phyug pa nyi ma 'od/ kha rag pa 'dul ba 'od/ 'bri ra ba shākya 'od ces grags pa rnams dang*/ mnyam med shākya ye shes dang*/ brag dkar shes rab ye shes la sogs pa gzhan don nus pa mang du byung ngo*/ de dag las grwa 'jad pa nam mkha' 'od sangs rgyas ras chen du grags pas lha ri kha'i dgon pa btab ste/ dbon po lha dges gdan sa mdzad/ de nas dbon rgyud/ de nas de ba ku mā ra zhes pa la sogs pa byon zhing*/ lha ri gyang mtho sogs dgon pa bskor gsum dang 'brog yangs stengs la sogs pa btab/ 'gro phan rgya cher mdzad pa grags so/ po che'i gdan sa ba mnyam med shākya ye shes ni/ me mo yos lo zhe brgyad pa shing stag la gdan sar bskos/ drug bcu re gcig pa la gshegs/ de rjes gdan sa slob dpon byang yes 425)lo gsum/ de rjes lha dbang phyug mkhar pas lo lnga/ de rjes sangs rgyas 'bum pas lo bco brgyad/ de rjes sgom ye shes lhan gyis lo bdun/ de rjes rin po che sangs rgyas gzhon nus lo lnga/ de nas rim par sangs rgyas 'bum mo/ rin po che gser khang pa/ rin po che sangs rgyas rin po che/ de rjes rin chen shākya 'bum/ de rjes rin chen byang chub bzang po/ de rjes spyan snga grags pa bshes gnyen gyis gdan pa lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi mdzad de drug bcu la gshegs so/ de rnams tshal gung thang pa'i bla rab kyi rim pa'o/ de yang rje mar pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa rnams tshig brgyud yin par/ don la phyag rgya chen po dri ma med par rtogs pa'i brgyud pa yin par bshad/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa de yang rje mar pa dang mo la yan la sngon du gtum mo'i ye shes bskyed nas/ de'i stobs kyis phyag chen gyi rtogs pa skyed par mdzad pas rdzogs pa'i rim 426)par yang bzhed/ dwags po rin po ches ni/

las dang po pa dbang ma thon pa dag la yang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa bskyed par mdzad pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs yin gsungs/ de yang theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma la brten nas so gsung*/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyis ru lag gi sa'i char rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i sras dpal lde/ bod lde/ skyid lde zhes pa'i sras gsum byung ba des/ lo ston la bdag gi thad du mkhan slob zung gcig bstan pa spel bar zhus pas/ mkhan po shākaya gzhon nu dang*/ slob dpon ye shes brtson 'grus gnyis btang bas/ de gnyis kyis bka' bgros nas 'brog mi dang stag lo gzhon nu gnyis la gser mang po bskur nas rgya gar du brdzang pas stag los rdo rje gdan du bskor ba mdzad cing bslab gnyer ma mdzad/ 'brog mis shin+ta pa'i 427)sar lo brgyad bzhugs nas gsan pa mang du mdzad/ slar bod du byon slob dpon gnyis kyang dgyes par gyur/ de nas stag gnyis la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur/ shān+ti pa'i dag ldan la'ang 'gyur mdzad/ 'gos lo tsā ba dang ba dang mar pa lo tsā gnyis kyang khong gi slob ma yin par bshad de/ mar pas dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa ru/ sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la/ sgra thang klog skad kyis yig tshang bslabs/ khong bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ zhes pa'i mgur bzhes skad/ de ltar gdams pa mang du gsan pa'i yon tan/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis la bstan pa thob cing*/ rlung gi stobs kyis nam mkha' la skyil dkrung 'cha' ba/ 'chi ba lam du byas pas sku lus de nyid ma spangs par 'tshang rgya bar bzhed nas rten 428)'brel ma 'grigs pas bar dor phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes brnyes pa zhig go/ de la slob ma mang du yod kyang gzhung dang gdams pa gnyis ka'i bdag por gyur pa ni/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma rnams te/

de dag gang las su'i rigs brgyud du byung ba'i rim pa yang*/ bod yul du lha srin dar ba'i tshe yar klungs shar gyi g.ya' spang skyes gcig dang si li ma gnyis mjal bar gyur pa na/ srin khrag med kyang de la chags pas de gnyis 'khon pa'i bar du lha sras skyes pa la jo bo 'khon bar skyes zhes grags pa la/ ma sangs las 'khon nas skye brgyud rim par byon zhing*/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi nang blon du gtogs pa 'khon dpal mo che'i sras bzhi ste/ khri mdzes lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ tshe 'dzin no/ gsum pa de sad mi bdun gyi drug pa yin/ bzhi pa'i sras rdo rje rin po che 429)nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/ shes rab yon tan/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rgyal po rdo rje gtsug gtor/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong*/ bal po/ shākaya blo gros/ de dag thams cad kyang gsang sngags snyigs ma'i chos kyi bdag po dang yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ de la sras gnyis/ gcen shes rab tshul khrims tshangs spyod bsrung*/ gcung dkon mchog rgyal po shing po khyi la 'khrungs/ bzhi bcu bzhes pa chu mo glang la sa skya btab/ drug bcu rtsa dgu pa chu pho rta la gshegs/ chen kun snying yab kyi nga dgu pa chu pho sprel la 'khrungs/ bcu gcig lon pa la yab gshegs/ lo skabs der ba ri lo tsā ba drug bcu rtsa gsum lon pa gdan sa bskos/ de nas rang lo nyi shu pa nas drug bcu rtsa bdun bar gdan pa lo zhe brgyad bzung nas sa pho stag la gshegs/ sa chen la sras bzhi las 430)kun dga' 'bar rgya gar la byon mkhas par gyur kyang nyi shu rtsa gnyis la rgya gar du gshegs/ gnyis pa slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo yab kyi nga gcig pa chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/ bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa chu pho stag la gshegs/ gsum pa rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ yab kyi nga drug pa me mo yos la 'khrungs/

rang lo nyer drug pa chu 'brug nas gdan sa bskyangs/ bdun bcu pa me pho byi ba la gshegs/ bzhi pa dpal chen 'od so yab kyi nga dgu pa lcags rta la 'khrungs/ nga bzhi pa chu mo bya la gshegs/ de las sras gnyis las/ che

'das paṇ+ḍi ta yab kyi so gsum pa chu pho stag la 'khrungs/ drug bcu rtsa gsum pa shing pho 'brug la gong ma rgyal pos rgya nag tu spyan drangs/ bdun bcu pa lcags mo phag la gshegs/ gcung bsam rgyal mtshan yab lnga pa shing po 'brug la 'khrungs 431)nga drug pa sa mo phag la gshegs/ de'i sras bla ma 'phags pa yab kyi nga gnyis ngas shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ zul phur na bza' phred gsol la dge tshul mdzad/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa shing mo la bsnyen par rdzogs nyi shu rtsa drug pa lcags pho sprel la she chen rgyal sar 'thon pas gong ma'i bla mar bkur/ bod khri bskor bcu gsum sogs srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phayan sum tshogs pas bkur te bla na med pa byas/ so gcig pa shing mo glang la bod la gteg slar sa mo sbrul la gong ma'i drung du byon lo bdun bzhugs nas zhe gnyis pa me pho byi ba la gdan par phebs/ me mo glang la chos mig chos 'khor mdzad/ bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa lcags pho 'brug la gshegs/ de'i gcung po bla ma phyag na yab kyi drug pa sa mo phag 432)la 'khrungs/ nyi shu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos la gshegs/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan yab bzangs tshas nga lnga bzhes pa sa pho khyi la 'khrungs zhes gnyis pa sa mo yos la gshegs/ yang bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal yab kyi nyer lnga sa chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/ re gcig sa chu pho khyi la gshegs/ bla ma 'di la sras bcu gnyis yod par grags/ de la sogs pa nas da lta sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis sras 'di rnams 'khon gyi rigs las bstan 'dzin skyes chen zam ma chad par byon pa'o/ dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi ltar byung ba'i de'ang pha rol tu phyin pa bdud kyi spyod yul zhes bya ba spyod kyi bsam gtan ni/ sdud pa las/ rgyu rnams bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod pa mi

433)nus te/ stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang*/ ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa ste/ stong par gnas pa'i lta ba/ sems can yongs su mi gtong ba'i snying rje ji skad smras bzhin byed pa'i byang sems kyi tshul khrims/ bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ de nyams su len pa la spyod yul zhes bya ste/ de yang gang la spyod ce na/ mdzod las/ phra rgyas spangs pa ma yin dang*/ yul ni nye bar gnas pa dang*/ tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las/ nyon mongs skye ste/ zhes bshad pas bcad bya ni nyon mongs pa yin la/ nyon mongs pa de dag phra rgyas dang*/ yul dang*/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa las skye bas nas/ rnal 'byor pas yul de nye bar bcug nas bag chags 434)blangs te/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nyon mongs pa rnams yul gyi thog de nyid du gcod par byed pas spyod yul zhes bya'o/ de'i gdams ngag kyang dam pas brgyud pa la pho gcod dang*/ ma gcig nas brgyud pa la mo spyod zhes bya/ de spyir bod du byon pa'i gdams pa khrid lugs phal che ba ni slob ma mi dge ba las bzlog tu bcug nas de'i sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa sbyong bar byed pa gtso che ba yin mod/ zhi byed kyi chos 'di ni tshe rabs snga ma'i las dbang gis tshe 'dir lus dman par gyur pa dang*/ nad bu can dang*/ dbul 'phongs can dang*/ mi ma yin pas gtses pa dag gi sdug bsngal rnams 'phral 'phral du zhi bar byas nas rnal 'byor la sbyor bas na sdug sngal zhi byed ces bya ste/ rgyal ba'i yul las kyang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad 435)rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i bsngags/ zhes gsungs so/ 'di'i chos kyi bdag po ni dam pa sangs rgyas te/ de ni rgya gar lho phyogs su yab nor bu len pa'i rigs can brtson 'grus go cha dang*/

yum dkon mchog mchod pa la mkhas pa spos sbyor la brtson pa'i rigs ba ra sa ha zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs ma thag nas mtshims dang ldan pa zhig ste/ skye ba bdun pa yin pas sdig pa'i dri ma med cing dge ba la ngang gis dga' ba ste/ bi kra ma la shrī lar mkhan po dge ba'i lha las rab tu byung nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la mkhas par sbyangs/ bla ma gser gling pa la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ ngag gi dbang phyug sogs bla ma mang po las dbang dang gdams pa mtha' yas pa thos te rten sdom pa gsum ldan du mdzad do/ de yang mtshan nyid sgra rig 436)pa'i bla ma bcu gcig ni/ klu sgrub/ shes rab bzang po/ yon tan 'od/ chos grags/ ā ka/ ra si dhi/ shaṅka ra/ ye shes snying po/ thogs med/ ār+ya de ba/ zhi ba lha/ bla ma gser gling pa rnams so/ pha rgyud ba rlung gi bla ma ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug bud+dha gu sta/ go dha ri/ dza ba ri sa/ ye shes zhabs/ klu dbyang*/ ā nan+ta/ kṛṣ+ṇa pa/ ba su dha ri/ pad+ma badz+ra rnams so/ ma ba nyams myong gi bla ma bcu gcig ni/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ sngom+bhi pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ti li pa/ nag po'i zhabs sgeg pa rdo rje/ lū hi sa/ bi ru pa/ kun dga' snying po/ ku ku rī pa rnams so/ phyag rgya brda'i bla ma bcu gcig ni/ sa ra ha/ tsarma pa/ gu ṇa ri/ tog tsi pa la sogs pa rnams so/ rig pa ngo sprod kyi bla ma bcu gcig ni/ ri khrod ma/ dri med ma/ pad+mo zhabs 437)ku mu dang*/ bde ba'i 'byung gnas la sogs pa rnams so/ de rnams brten nas nyan bshad mdzad pas/ thun mongs kyi dngos grub/ sa 'og dang*/ mig sman dang*/ rkang mgyogs/ ril bu/ gnod sbyin mo/ ral gri/ mkha' spyod la sogs pa 'grub cing*/ mchog gi dngos grub mthong lam chen po'i ye shes brnyes par mdzad do/ de la du gzhan don ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ spyir bdod du lan lnga byon pa la/

dang po 'brin thang las sgo nas rtsa rir byon/ kong yul dang sum yul gyi bar bcad de smad khams gsum zhabs kyis bcags/ de dus nyid na chos sbyin pa'i snod med kyang*/ phyis de rnams su bstan pa dar bar lung bstan/ gnyis pa ni kha che nas 'thon te mnga' ris su byon/ zhang zhung gling kha ba dang*/ 'brug bla ma la gdams pa 'ga' ri gnang*/ 438)gsum pa ni bal po nas tshongs pa dang 'grogs te byon/ yar klung gi rma ra ser po dang mjal te gcod kyi gdams pa mang du gnang ngo*/ bzhi pa ni sha 'ug stag sgo lang byon nas gnyal du bzhugs/ de nas dbus su phebs nas rma so la sogs pa'i don mchad/ lnga pa ni rgya nag tu byon der lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas ding rir phebs so/ de ltar slob ma dpag tu med kyang grags che ba'i brgyud 'dzin snga phyi gsum ste/ brgyud pa dang po ni/ kha che dzñā na gu h+ya la gsungs pa'i zhi byed sgrol ma'i bskor gsum dang*/ gshen rje gshed la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs rnams te/ de rim par brgyud pa'i mthar rog shes rab 'od la brgyud do/ brgyud pa bar ma ni/ gtso bo rma po rkam gsum phran dang bcas pa rnams te/ dam pa rmas ni/ yar stod skyer snar rma smon lam zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs pa de'o/ de 439)las rim par brgyud pa'i mthar rog shes rab 'od la brgyud do/ so lugs ni/ yul ra mo ba der lo nyes byung nas bza' mi rnams sprang du song*/ bu yun gnyis yod pa/ chung ba so chung dang*/ chi ba la so ring zhes zer/ so chung dam pas rjes su bzungs bas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs pa gdams pa ma lus pa gnang nas rjes su bzung bar mdzad do/ so lugs kyi chos kyi rnams grangs ni/ tshig brgyud dang don brgyud gnyis las/ tshig brgyud la'ang brgyud pa chen po dang brgyud phran gnyis las/ chen mo la dam pa skyes mchog chen ba nga bzhi/ 'bring po gnis/ chung ba bcu bdun de/

de la grub pa thob pa re re'i lo rgyus dang gdams pa'i ngo bo slob ma 'khrid lugs cha tshang re re yod pas brgyud pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'o/ brgyud pa brgya dang gsum du 'gyur bas brgyud pa 440)chen mo zhes bya'o/ brgyud phran ni/ don bskor lnga ma rim pa bzhi la/ bstan ma gyi thun che chung*/ grags pa brgyad/ yab sras gsum skyon can skyon med la sogs chos sde sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ don brgyud la phyogs su lhungs ma lhungs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la don brgyud lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ bla ma sum bcu so gnyis la don brgyud so gnyis/ dam pa bcu bdun la don brgyud bcu bdun bzhugs/ phyogs su ma lhungs ba la mig 'byed kyi bskor dang mkha' 'gro ma'i bskor las/ dang po la bu bzhi ma lnga ste/ de yang gzhung sbas pa mig 'byed/ de yang lag dus dang phran la gdams pa/ ngo sprod brgya rtsa drug pa/ ma 'gags rnam dag rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam mo/ mkha' 'gro ma'i bskor la/ so'i bskor mgo chen mo bzhi ste/ mchog 441)sgrub pa la brda bskor/ thun mongs sgrub pa la yi ge bzhi pa'i bskor/ gnyis ka sgrub pa la dza ga ra'i skor dang thun skor ro/ brda skor la he ru ka'i brda skor/ bde bar gshegs pa' brda skor/ rdo rje dril bu'i brda skor/ dam pa'i brda skor thor bu'o/ thun mongs sgrub pa la dmar mo gsung sgrub dang*/ nag mo thugs sgrub bo/ de la yang phag mo chos sku'i sgrub thabs/ longs sku'i sgrub thabs/ sprul sku'i sgrub thabs so/ dza ga ta'i bskor ni/ gtum mo 'khor lo gcig ma yin/ thun skor la/ spyod lam gyi nyams skyong lugs so/ de rnams kyi rtsa ba'i snying po gyur pa ni/ rgyud sde dang chos skad bstun pa smra ba'i seṅge'i don rgyud/ chos skad ma bstun pa brgyud pa bzhi pa yongs su ma grags pa'i don rgyud/ ma tshang mdor bsdus/

so'i rigs pa 442)srangs 'jug snyan brgyud bzhi rnams bzhugs so/ skam lugs ni/ dge bshes grwa pa'i slob ma rten dge slong du bzhugs/ de ni dam pa la rjes su bzung la gdams pa gnas bar gsol zhus pas/ zhal gyis ma bzhes nan gyis zhus pas ming ci yin gsungs/ skam ye shes rgyal mtshan yin zhus pas/ 'o na phan thogs par 'dug pas gnang nam par 'ong gis gsungs/ de nub kha ba chen po babs pa'i nang par nam langs ma thag a tsar gcig nang du byon pas/ bla ma yin nam byas pas yin zer/ nam par 'byon snyam pa la byas pas bar chad byung dgos nang rang 'ongs gsungs/ kha ba la 'o rgyal lam byas pas kha ba la ma rig gsungs/ sgo ma phyi byas pas nged cig pa la thogs rdugs med gsungs nas bzhugs so/ der nye 'brel sogs tshogs pa'i gseb tu brda'i ngo sprod gcig mdzad pas nges shes 443)skyes nas mi mangs kyi gasreg tu gnang ba snyams nas/ brda mig can gyis mthong ba yin/ mig med kyis ni mi mthong ngo*/ gsung ste gzhan gyis go bar ma gyur ro/ der zhag bzhi bcu bzhugs pa la zhag lngar gling bslang mdzad/ zhag dgu chos thun du bcug nas gsungs te/ skabs dang po la nad thog tu bskor ba dang bsgom thog tu bskor ba gnyis gnyis su ngo sprad/ bar du bden bzhi dang skubs 'gro dang 'thor bu ba rnams gsungs/ zhag bcu bzhi lon nas nga 'gro gsungs/ bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang*/ phyis mjal bar zhus pas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang lhan gcig tu gnas pas der gsol ba thob gsungs so/ shul du ma bde ba byung na su la 'dra zhus pas/ rab rig pa'i ye shes yin pas sgro 'dogs gco pa'i bla ma nang nas 'byon/ 444)'bring 'phags pa'i dge bshes yin pas mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la ltos/ tha ma gang zag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas/ nga dang mi 'phrad mched po nyams myong can dang gleng bslang gis la lo brgyad bsgoms/

de nas mngon shes 'char gsungs/ snyam gyis nga la de tsam sgom long med/ khong pa na skran mang dgu yang yod/ grags pa mngon shes kyis zla ba gsum na 'chi bar lung bstan byas pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa la mog na ba tsam yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro gsungs nas bzhud do/ de nas ji ltar gsung ba bzhin skran rnams kyang thon lo brgyad nas mngon shes kyang shar/ mngon rtogs brgyad ka bshad/ mdo sdud pa'i steng du mdo rgyas 'bring gnyis drangs nas kyang bshad pas/ slob ma yas brgyud dang mas brgyud gnyis su grags/ yas brgyud pa 'khun 'dzi yang dben pa dbang phyug rdo rje sogs la 445)nad thog tu ngo sprod pa gzhung skabs dang po/ gdams ngag bden bzhi/ lag len thor bu dang bcas pa gsungs/ mas brgyud ni/ sgro nas brgyud pa ste/ nad pa min pas gang zag rim gcig car gyi dbye bas snying po'i don dang mngon par rtogs pa gnyis su ngo sprad nas/ la la lus pa brten 'brel gyi 'gros bzhis 'chad de mas brgyud sgom thog tu bskor ba'i gdams pa'o/ bar du byung ba'i brgyud phran la/ gra pa dang*/ lce dang*/ ljang lugs gsum mo/ de la dge bshes grwa pa la zhi byed sgrol ma dgu skor gyi gdams pa gnang ste/ man ngag sku'i sgrol ma/ theg pa gsung gi sgrol ma/ gsang ba thugs kyi sgrol ma/ yang dag lta ba'i sgrol ma/ rin chen sgom pa'i sgrol ma/ byang chub spyod pa'i sgrol ma/ mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgrol ma/ rnal 'byor lam gyi sgrol ma/ dngos grub 446)'bras bu'i sgrom ma rnams so/ lce lugs ni/ bzang yul gyi dge bshes lce pa sogs la bka' babs pa rnams so/ ljang lugs ni/ mchis yul gyi lngas bka' gdams pa la sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gdams pa gnang ste/ ljang gis ljang chung la/ des 'chus pa yab sras la/ des rog shes rab 'od la gsungs so/ brgyud pa 'thor bu'i skor ni/ 'gro sgom la mtshan brjod gser gyi mthur ma/

dgu sgom la las rgya'i gdams pa/ chu sgom la snying gtam lhugs pa'i gdams pa/ sgom pa dmar sgom la tshig chod gsum gyi gdams pa/ gnyags lo tsā ba la bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i gdams pa/ lce mo dpal sgron la grub thob nyams kyi chos sde bcu drug pa/ gnyal stod ngor rje sgom pa la lhan gcig skyes sbyor/ chu dbar gyi gnas brtan 'byung grags la sher snying gi gdams pa/ sngags bshang 447)shes rab rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor gyi gdams pa/ shangs pa dbu sdebs la yi ge bzhi pa'i gdams pa/ snye mo'i rgya ston skyid rtsegs la dgyes rdor gyi gdams pa/ zhang sag chung pa la phag mo'i gsang sgrub/ bla ma dgon dkar ba la phyag rdor gyi gdams pa/ skyid shod kyi 'ban gung rgyal ba bde mchog snyan rgyud/ ma gcig lam sgron la gcod kyi gdams pa gnang ste/ de rnams ni brgyud pa bar ma'i skor ro/ phyi ma ni/ dam pa rgya nag tu lo bcu gnyis 'gro don mdzad nas ding rir phebs te ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi smin grol la bkod/ ding ri'i dam pa kun dga' la bka' babs pa ste/ kun dga' ni dam pas skye ba lnga'i bar du rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma/ dam pa mya ngan las 'da' khar yang*/ nga dang mnyams pa kun dga' tsam/ thur la babs pa chu bo tsam 448)mkhas la 'char ba nyi zla tsam/ gsungs/ de'i slob ma phan yul gyi sa tshab sgom pa/ de ni chos nyid dbang po'i mngon sum shar bas rtogs pa'i mthar chod pa cig byung zhus pas legs so gnang*/ dbu thog na shog ril gcig btags 'dug pa de la/ 'di na tsha bzang po yod/ la stod na myang shes pa med gsungs nas sa tshab la gnang*/ sna mar gyi thel la kha phye gsungs nas der byon gzigs pas/ zug pa rtsa ba'i chos se zhus lan dgu/ 'gril ba sgong pa'i chos don rgyud skor gsum/ gyes pa yal ga'i chos mtshon dpe dang brul tsho/ lo nab kyi chos sde bcu drug mdzes pa me tog gi chos sde lnga/

'bras bu'i chos sde ā li kā li phyi nang gsang gsum rnams byung ngo*/ de'i slob ma chig brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa rdzogs pa rgyal ba de gsum la chig brgyud sbas 449)pa'i bla ma rnams gsum du grags so/ rgyal ba ri nes chos kyis brgyud pa yang dag par gtad pa rog sku mched gnyis so/ de yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rog nam mkha' ye shes zhes bya ba mkhyen pa dang nus pa ldan pa zhig byung ba'i gdung rabs thams cad du sngags 'chang khyer par can sha stag byung ba'i nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa rog shes rab bla ma/ de'i sras bkra shis grags pa/ de'i sras rog shes rab 'od/ de nas rim par zhig po sogs la brgyud do/ chos bskor 'di la thun mongs dang thun mongs ma yin pa gnyis las thun mongs pa la/ mdo rgyud phyag len dang bcas pa/ bka' babs snyan brgyud dang bcas pa/ dri med phra rig dang bcas pa/ dar tshags bshad 'bum dang bcas pa/ dang po ni/ spyin mdo chu klung rol pa'i mdo/ dgos mdo sher phyin/ spyi rgyud sde snod gsal byed 450)dgos rgyud chu klung chen po/ phyag len ni/ dbang 'khor che 'bring dang lam rim che chung gsum/ bka' babs snyan brgyud ni bka' babs bzhi/ de'i lam slong snyan brgyud bzhi/ dri med phra rig ni/ dri med ma zug pa rtsa ba'i chos bskor la sogs drug phra rig ni sa tshab kyis kun dga' la gegs rnams dris pa'i gdams pa'o/ dar tshag bshad 'bum ni/ dar gas zhal gdams/ skor sogs brgyad yod de/ ba tshab la 'phral gtam te nes yi ger btab pa'o/ ༈ gsang sngags rnying ma ni/ de ltar bod kyi yum 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'brib theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ni/ ding sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhing*/ de yang chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yab sras kyi ring la dar ba yin te/ 'jam dpal sku'i rgyud ni shīn+taṃ gabha bod du byon nas dar

451)bar mdzad/ yang dag thugs kyi skor ni slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras bod du skal ldan rnams la stsal/ pad+ma gsung dang phur pa phrin las ni/ slob dpon pad+mas rgyal po dang jo mo bza' mtsho rgyal dang 'bre a tsar sa le rnam la bstan/ bdud rtsi yon tan ni slob dpon bi ma la mi tras bod du snod ldan la bstan pa ste ye shes lha'i sgrub sde lnga dang*/ ma mo rbod gtong la sogs te 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi sgrub sde gsum ni de dag gi bka' bsrung gi tshul du gnas pa'o/ khyad par sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum las sems sde ni/ sems mar bco brgyad las lnga bai ra dang bcu sum bi ma las dar bar mdzad do/ klong bai ro las byung ba'i man ngag ste/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa' rgyud chen po'i don klong dgu dang tshig bam so nyi khri zhes 'byung la/ bam so nyi khri ni grub pa'i 452)skyes bu rnams kyi phyag na bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyis/ 'dir gzhung tshang bar 'gyur ba ni med par grags/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud chung ba'i don yang klong dgu rnams so/ dang po lta ba'i klong*/ gnyis pa spyod pa'i klong*/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi klong bzhi pa dbang gi klong*/ lnga pa dam tshig gi klong*/ drug pa sgrub pa'i klong*/ bdun pa 'phrin las kyi klong*/ brgyad pa sa lam gyi klong*/ dgu pa 'bras bu'i klong ste/ gzhan yang ye shes gsang ba la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten pa'i rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag rnams kyang bai ros */ mi pham mgon po la gnang ste/ de'i drung du ngan lam byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gsan pa ste/ de ni yul dbu ru ngan lam ral gsum pa yin/ lo brgya dang bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhayugs nas lhag med du gshegs/ de'i slob ma za ngam rin chen/ khu 'gyur gsal 453)ba mchog sogs kyang lo grangs mang po bzhugs pa'i mthar 'ja' lus su gshegs pa sha stag go/ man ngag gi sde ni/

bi ma las myang ting 'dzin bzang po sogs la stsal te dar bas gsum po 'di dag bod yul 'dir shin tu dar rgyas che ba byung zhing*/ snga 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi bshad pa ding sang gi bar du gnas pa sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i skor rnams yin te/ 'di ni bi ma las lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog la gnang zhing*/ des legs par bsgyur nas/ mkhas pa gtsug khyer rnam gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kyis dar rjes dpal gyi grags pa dang zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan gnyis la bshad/ zhang nas brgyud pa rnams la bka' mchims phu ba'am man ngag rgyud pa ces grags/ dar rjes dbus gtsang khams gsum du bshad pas/ yongs grags dbus lugs pa dang*/ khams 454)lugs pa zhes gnyis su grags so/ zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan gyis gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la bshad pa dang*/ yang slob dpon pad+ma dang*/ bi ma la gnyis kas gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra la/ des sog po dpal gyis ye shes la/ des gzhubs sangs rgyas ye shes la bshad pa ste/ gnubs la brgyud pa'i chu bo thams cad 'dus par grags so/ de yang rdo rje theg pa la brten nas grub pa bsnyes pa mang du byung ba ste/ 'bre dpal gyis blo gros sna snam rdo rje bdud 'jams/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ u na a nang ga gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ klangs dpal gyi seṅge/ klangs gtsug gis rin chen/ 'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros/ khams pa go cha/ bai ro tsa na/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra/ gnyan dpal dbyangs la sogs pa rnams nam mkhar 'gro ba dang*/ ri brag la 'dzum ba dang*/ chu la mi dbyings pa dang*/ lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du skye bo mang po la ston 455)nus pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'bro gza' dī sam la sogs pa bu med grub pa thob pa'ang mang du byung*/ de rnams phal cher 'das pa na gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes byon te/ rgya gar dang bal po dag 'bru sha'i yul rnams na bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa'i skye bo mang po bsten/ khong gi bla ma 'bru sha'i lo tsā ba che btsan skyes kyis mdo dgongs 'dus bod du bsgyur/

de legs par gsan cing dar bar mdzad/ dgung lo brgya dang bcu gsum bzhugs nas gsang sngags kyibastan pa dar bar mdzad pa yin/ slob la thugs sras/ de sras kyi dam pa dang lnga byung ba las/ sras bzhi ni/ so ye shes dbang pyug de la lta ba sgang dril bshad/ sa gor blo chen 'phags/ de la mdo 'grel ṭīka dang sbyar nas bshad/ don yon tan mchog de la star kha gegs sel gyi tshul du bshad/ 456)sru legs pa'i sgron ma/ de la tshig sdebs sbyor legs pas bshad/ sras kyahi dam pa yon tan rgya mtsho la/ lta ba sgang dril/ gab pa mngon byung*/ man ngag khog sdebs/ zab mo gsang ba khong lto ltar bshad pa/ star kha gegs sel gyi tshul ste bzhi ka bshad pas chos skor thams cad tshang ba yon tan rgya mtsho yin/ 'di la sras ye shes rgya mtsho dang pad+ma dbang rgyal gnyis/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i sras lha rje hūm̐ chung*/ 'dis rje btsun ming la 'drag gsang sngags gsungs par grags/ yon tan rgya mtsho yab sras kyi slob ma myang shes rab mchog des dog la gshongs kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bskyed rdzogs gsum la mkhas sbyangs mdzad pas grub pa brnyes pa'i grub rtags kyi lo rgyas mang du snang*/ de'i slob ma bskyed rdzogs gsum ka la mkhas pa chos lung gi myang ye shes 'byung gnas yin/ de dag las brgyud pa phal cher la rong lugs dang*/ 457)gdung rus las btags te myang lugs shes kyang bya'o/ de'i slob ma zur po che ste/ zur po che 'di stong tshab 'phags pa rin chen slob ma yang yin pas sangs rgyas ye shes zur po che'i bar na bla ma gcig las med par yang bshad do/ man ngag gi sde la snying thig ces bya ste/ de nyi bi ma las khri srong dang myang ting 'dzin bzang po la stsal ba/ myang gis dbu ru zhwa lha khang bzhengs nas snying thig gi gdams pa rnams gter du sbas/ tshig brgyud rnams 'bre rin chen 'bar la bshad/ des sbas blo gros dbang phyug la bshad pas tshig brgyud gang zag brgyud pa la'ang yod par grags/

phyis bi ma la'i sprul pa gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal gyis gter nas byung ste/ rang gis nyams su blangs/ myang stod kyi lce btsun seṅge dbang phyug la gdams pa rim pa bdun btab 458)nyams su blangs pas grub pa bsnyes nas zag bcas mi snang bar 'od skur gyur/ de nas gdams pa rnams la grong gi 'chad pa ltag dang*/ jal gyi phu ste gter kha gsum du sbas/ de nas lo sum cu na rong snar mda'i lce sgom nag pos gter zhig bton nas/ rang nyams dang gzhan spel mdzad/ shangs pa ral pa zhes bya bas kyang lang grong 'chad pa stag gi gter byung nas 'gro don mdzad/ yang yar 'brog gi snubs mtsho gling dgu'i bla do zhes bya bar 'khrungs pa'i zhang ston bkra shis rdo rje zhes bya ba/ rdor legs skyis bskul nas nu ma'i ri'i brag mthon po zhig gi steng du bskyal der kha byang du lta ba'i phug pa sgo rtsas 'gags pa zhig nas gter phyungs dus e ka dza ṭīs gzugs ston cing skad 'byin pa na/ rdor legs kyis 'di lung bstan pa de yin byas pas/ e ka dza ṭī na re 'o na tshogs 'khor 459)brgya rtsa brgyad thong*/ lo gsum du mi la ma shod zer nas song*/ gzhan yang jal gyi phur lce btsun gyis sbas pa'i chos gter dang*/ mchims pa phur bi ma las sbas pa'i chos gter kyang thon te rgya cher spel nas dgung lo bdun bcu rtsa gcig la gshegs/ gdams pa rnams rang gi sras nyi 'bum la gtad rgya mdzad par grags so/ de la zur gyi gdung rabs ni/ lha rje zur po che'i mes po zur shes rab 'byung gnas/ de'i sras bzangs mig po che/ lha rje sman pa sgom chen shāka ste/ sgom chen rdor 'byung*/ lha rje zur po che dang bzhi las/ zur po ches tshangs spyod mdzad pas sras med cing 'dis spyir mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du brten/ khyad par chos lung gi myang ye shes 'byung gnas la sgyu 'phrul dag sems phyogs 460)gsan nas rtsal bton du spel/

rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud du phye/ rtsa ba dang 'brel pa sdebs/ rgyud dang grub thabs sdebs/ sgrub thabs dag mchog yig la sogs par sdebs nas chos kyis phrin bskyangs bug pa lung gi gtsug lag khang dang*/ shangs kyi mdar sram pa sgrub khang dang sku rten dpal chen po lha dug lde gur bzhengs skabs 'og gdong gi brag snar klu zhig yod pa bzung nas rdza mar bcug rgya rim pa bdun btab nas bzhag pas/ klu dpe phyogs phyogs kyi chang rnams bsdus nas las byed skabs dang rab gnas kyi skabs su chang zad mi shes pa byung ba byas/ rab gnas kyi tshe grong pa'i phyugs mang po g.yar nas bsad de sha ston chen po byas/ nyin nub khar phyugs rnams ma tshang ba med par grong pa so sor gtad pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad pa dpag par 461)dka'/ de nas skabs shig nya ri na ma ma g.yu drung bkra shis bza' mi gnyis chos 'khor bya ba 'dod nas/ yul mi dag nye du kun bsags te/ slob dpon gang bzang dris par/ la las bsngags pa/ la las btsun pa/ la las 'on po bzang zer kha ma 'chams nger rnams kha mi 'cham bar 'dug khyed rang gang mos la gyis ces smras pas/ mo na re/ 'o na nga'i yo byad kyis ldengs pa yod pas gsum ka spyan 'dren no zer nas/ bsngags par 'ug pa lung zur chen btsun par chu mig ri mo ba/ bon po la ke tse pa gdan drangs pas/ mchod gnas gsum po na re/ 'u cag tsho lha khag zhig rtsig dgos ces bka' bgros par/ lha'i gtso bo la ma mthun ste/ bsngags pa rdo rje sems dpa' la byed zer/ btsun pas shākya thub pa dang*/ bon pos 462)gshen rabs mi bo la byed zer/ ma mthun pas lha khang so sor brtsegs so/ 'ug pa lung pa zur chen la/ sgro ston gyis sgro phug phul te/ der brtsegs pas sgro phug gi gtsang khang 'byongs tsam la dgung lo drug bcu rtsa gcig thog sku gshegs so/ de la slob ma rtse mo bzhi/ rtse lkog lnga/ sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad sogs byung*/

rtse mo bzhi ni/ lta sgom gyi rtse mo zur chung shes rab grags/ sgyu 'phrul gyi rtse mo san nam bres kyis mi nyag 'byung grags/ mkhyen rgya'i rtse mo ra za'i zhang 'gos chung pa/ sgom sgrub kyi rtse mo 'tsho nya'i bzang sgom shes rab rgyal ba'o/ zur chung shes rab rab grag ni/ mes po a tsa ra bya ba'i bu zur sgom zhes bya ba la/ ldom bu byed pa'i btsun rgan zhig yod pa las/ btsun chung ba'i phyir 'greng ste bug pa lung du phyin pas/ lha rje 463)zur po che'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi rgyus ci yin gsungs pas/ zur lags byas pas/ 'o na btsun chung 'di nga'i rtsar zhog go/ ngas gsos pas chog gsungs pas/ kho dga' ste/ bu lha rjer phul ba/ bslab gnyer byed rgyu gcugs pas shes rab shin tu che bas chos mkhas par shes kyang yo byad med pas dbang rnams ma 'thob cing dpe cha yang med pa de tshe/ lha rjes/ pan gyi khang sngon na jo mo g.yu mo bya ba phyug mo mad smad gnyis yod par/ khyod rang ma smad 'di gnyis kyi thog tu sdod gsungs pas/ nga khyim thabs mi byed zhus par/ 'du shes ma chung*/ khyod yo byad med pa la khong gnyis kyi yo byad la spyad nas dbang zhus dpe bris/ chos nyan pas mchog pa yin mod/ des khong gnyis kyi tshogs kyang rdzogs/ khyod rang gi don yang grub pas de dga' 464)mod gsungs/ der gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pa gdams pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa dang*/ da khyod der ma sdod par dpe cha rnams khyer te nga'i 'dir sdod par shog gsungs pas/ de ltar byas na khong gnyis kyang drin che ste zhus pas/ blo ma chung khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don nus pa shig 'ong ba 'dug pas/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa rgyas par byas nas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don byed dgos pa yin/ khong gnyis la 'gab pas rang gzhan gyi don gang yang mi nus gsungs pas/ de nas ji skad gsung ba bzhin mdzad pas/

lung stongs bye ma'i gseb tu zhal skyes pa la skyems zhu dang*/ ri stong gi rtser sku bkra shis pa la zhal zas 'dren pa 'byung ba sogs gang 'dod pa'i thugs dgongs 'bad med du grub pa byung bas/ da ni 'gro ba'i don byas kyang 'grub par 'dug snyam pa 465)na/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ da khyod kyi bshad pa zhig gyis gsungs nas/ der mdo dgongs 'dus gsungs pas dus gcig la dpe 'grel/ gsum brgya byung ngo*/ dang po chung ngu'i dus 'ug pa lung gi sgo rtsar mchod rten zhig yod par skor ba mdzad skabs zhabs khru gang tsam sa la ma reg par dang*/ shangs kyi sral pa sgrub khang du yang dag gi lo sgrub mdzad skabs sgrub pa la bzhugs skabs snang ba zad par kyi skye mched brnyes/ cir snang thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' rang bzhin du gsal/ sa rdo ri brag thams cad la thogs med kyi rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba sogs mdzad pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo*/ de ltar shing stag la 'khrungs nas mthar dgung lo ring 466)gcig pa shing stag la 'brum pa'i snyun gyi zhi bar gshegs so/ de la slob ma ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ phyam bcu drug dram ma sum bcu so gnyis/ yus po che mi gnyis la sogs pa byung ngo*/ 'di la sku'i sras lnga tshar phyi tshar gnyis las/ snga tshar la rtsa tsha rdor 'bar dang*/ phyi tshar gyi yum dang po nas jo mor bzhes pa yin yang*/ mda' rig dzo shāka gi lcam mo de/ grangs na chos nyan la ltar byon pas/ grangs rnams bag sdang bas 'don par byas pa na/ skyo ston shāka ye na re/ 'di'i srin lag ma bstan pa'i gtso bo zhig 'dug par rmis pas/ sras chung na phan thogs pa 'ong nyin che bas zhog gsung skad/ der bzhag pas lha rje sgro phug pa shākya seṅge shing stag la 'khrungs so/ yab kyi zhal nas/ skyo ston shāka ye'i rmi ltas bzang*/ nga'i bu 'di bstan pa'i gtso bo 467) dang tshul mthun pa 'gro ba la phan thogs pa gcig 'ong bar 'dug pas/

ming shākya seṅger thogs gsungs/ de nas zla ba gsum tsam na zur chung po gshegs so/ sgro phug pa shākya seṅge ni/ sku na gzhon dus yum dang zhang pos bskyangs nas mda' phur lo bco lnga bzhugs/ de nas chu dbar du glan dang*/ sker lungs su yang mkhyen bla ma'i sar chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu dgu la che 'don mdzad pas/ sku bsod chen po rgyas te bslab gnyer gyis 'phro byed pa'i skabs ma byung*/ bla ma mkhas pa dag tshur gdan drangs slob gnyer 'phro rdzogs par mdzad/ khyad par zur gyi slob ma ka ba bzhi la mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs rgyud lung man ngag phrin sgrub phyag bzhes dang bcas pa gsan/ dbang rnams kyang rdzogs par zhus/ glan shākya byang chub 468)la rdzogs chen skor gsan te thos bsam sgom gsum gyis mtha' rgyas chod par mdzad/ spyir rje sgro phug pa 'di phyag rdor gyi sprul par grags te byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir gsang sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba la byon nas gdul bya'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par chos 'khor bskor bas/ slob ma gshin rje chen po grangs 'dzin zhing bstan pa skyong ba gdugs thogs stong byung bar grags/ de'i nang nas kyang thugs zin gyi slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis byung*/ de la nag po bzhi ni/ zur nag 'khor lo/ lce ston rgya nag pa/ nyang nag mdo bo/ 'dar nag gtsug gtor dbang phyug gam/ kha gcig dpal seng zer/ ston pa bzhi ni/ nye ston gyabs ston/ zhang ston/ rgya ston nam/ phyi ma gnyis khrid nas gnyan ston dang*/ kha rag ston snying mnan pa'ang mthong*/ me 469)bzhi ni/ g.yung ston hor po/ dpang ston lcags skyu/ gtsang ba byi ston/ dbus pa chos kyang khyer la 'ong gis gsungs nas sgro phug gi ltag na ring spo to gcig yod pa'i khar byon/ tshogs 'khor skor gsungs gleng mang po mdzad nas/ khyed rnams nga med pa la mya ngan ma byed/ ngas da res lus ma spangs par khyer nas rig 'dzin gyi sa la song ba 'dis/

khyed rnams la shul du yang bkra shis mi brgyud dang bstan pa 'phel ba gcig 'ong gsung nas mgur gcig bzhes/ nam mkha' la 'phags nas gshegs so/ yang mgur re bzhes 'phags/ yang 'phags te mjug tu nam mkha'i 470)dbyings mig gis mi mthong ba'i sa na yar gshegs so/ de nas khong rnams kyis sems kyi ma bzod de ngus cho nge btab rgyal 'dres byas mtshan nas bso pas mar la byon te/ khyed rnams zhan de ltar mi byed par ngas gong du kha chos legs par bcug de la mi nyan par/ da nga'i mi brgyud la bkra shi+es sa bag mi 'ong gsungs so/ de nas de'i phyi lo la sku 'da' tshul bstan pa yin te dgung lo drug bcu re gcig pa shing stag la gshegs so/ thugs zin gyi slob ma nag pa bzhi'i nang nas lce ston rgya nag pa ni/ mes pos khams la byon nas yar log glong thang sgrol ma'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas skyi mkhar lha khang bzhengs/ de la sku mched gsum yod pa'i a mi sher btson gyi sras rgyal gsum/ de la sras bzhi ste/ rin chen/ nyi po/ rgyal bzang*/ rgya nag pa'o/ rgya 471)nag pa ni shing khyi la 'khrungs nyi shu rtsa gcig nas mtshan nyid gsan te/ gzhung lugs ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad/ de nas rje sgro phug pa'i zhabs drung du sngags gsan du byon lo bcu gcig bzhugs/ zur tsho gzhan rnams la'ang gtugs de gtams pa ma lus pa rdzogs par mdzad pas sngags mtshan nyid gzhung gdams ngag rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa kun gyi bdag por gyur/ bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa mdzad skabs sman gyi pho brang nas sman gyi lha mo zhig byung ste/ dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas pa kun gyis mthong ba sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma mtha' yas pa mnga'/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa la rje sgro phug pa gshegs/ rje'i 'gro don gyi rgyuman bskyangs nas lnga bcu rtsa drug pa sa sbrul la gshegs so/ nyi po ma sras 472)gsum/ jo skyes/

bla ma chen po/ dpon nag rdo rje'o/ bla ma chen po yon tan gzungs ni/ mi rta la 'khrungs/ khu bo rgya nag pa dang lo bcu gsum 'grogs nas bka' bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa kun chub par mdzad/ dgung lo nyer bzhi la bla ma rgya nag pa gshegs nas gdan sa mdzad/ bslab gnyer 'phros cung zad yod pa dbus pa ston shāka dang dbus pa zhig po gnyis las mtha' chod par mdzad/ de la dbus pa ston shāka ni/ mi chos gzad kyi gcer pa thung gi brgyud pa yin/ gtsang du dgon pa btab nas sgrub pa mdzad pas lha 'dre dam la thogs pa dang*/ gdul bya mang po'i don mdzad nus pa byung ste dam pa so sprag pa zhes grags pa de yin/ dbus pa zhig po ni/ mi chos yar klung byangs ba yin/ sgro phug 473)pa'i gra sar yig mkhan chos la tshud pa zhig ste/ lha rje rgya nag pa'i drung du bskyed rdzogs gsum la mkhas par mdzad/ snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag gnang ste sgom pas zhag bdun la rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa 'khrungs/ theg pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshig ma lus par thugs la lam lam shar ba byung*/ sgom sgrub la bzhugs nas mtshas 'og nas grwa sa skyong ba lo bco brgyad mdzad na dgung lo bdun bcu pa shing yos la gshegs/ bdag nyid chen po de'i slob mar gyur pa zhig po bdud rtsi dang*/ ston pa bla skyabs dang*/ dbus pa jo bsod dang*/ snye ston nyi ma rdo rje la sogs pa gzhung lugs smra ba'i mkhas pa mang du byon no/ bla ma lha khang pa'i thugs kyi sras dam pa sprul sku zhig po bdud rtsi ni/ mes 474)rdo rje rgyal mtshan bshes gnyen la sras mkhar re dang mkhar chung*/ mkhar chung gi sras shu ston mon sran bya ba/ de'i sras ston pa lha snang bya ba/ de la sras sangs rgyas dgas chung dang sgom shu sangs rgyas dgas chung zhig po bdud rtsi'i yab yin/ gzad pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis/

gzad kyi lha gdong dgon dang 'ug skad dgon la sogs phul bas/ bla ma dgas chung gis gzad kyi gcen pa wang thung brgyud kyi bum sring mo wang mo rgya gar gsal bya ba khab tu bzhes pas/ de la jo sras ma rgya ma skyes nas zla ba brgyad lon pa ma 'das/ der a ma'i nu mo'i wang mo gcig yod pa bso nas nu bcol la btang bas de jo mor song ste zhig so bdud tsi sa sbrul la lha gdong dgon du sku 'khrungs/ mngal ba bzhugs skabs yum gyi rmi lam la mi dkar po 485)zhig gi gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can zhig yang yang mgo la pheb pa rmi ba dang*/ sku bltams nas zhig ma'i nang du bsnyal bas 'ja' tshon zug pa sogs ltas ngo mtshar ba mang po byung*/ de nas log nyis lon tsam na yab la rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba mang po rmis pas yab kyis bu 'di 'gro ba phan thogs pa 'ong ba 'dug gsungs/ de nas zla gnyis tsam song ba na yab dga' chug dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gshegs so/ de nas cher longs pa dang*/ mas zhang po se sprag pa'i sar bslab gnyer la brdzangs lo gsum se sprag pa dang 'grogs/ de nas se sprag pa sku gshegs/ bla ma rgyag nag pa'i drung du byon nas chos mang du gsan/ nga sems phyogs kho na sgrub pa yin gsungs nas nyams len dang 'chad nyan sems phyogs kho na la mdzad 476)sems phyogs ji ltar gsan tshul yang*/ kun byed mdo bcu la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rtsa ba sems sde'i skor la rtsa ba bco brgyad skor lugs rong lugs khams lugs la sogs pa kun gyi bshad bsrol lugs mi gcig pa bcu bzhi gsan/ gdams pa snyan brgyud kyi skor la skor lugs rong lugs khams lug gsum gyi gdams ngag sogs thos bsam gyis mtha' rgya chod par mdzad do/ de nas che 'don mdzad de 'ug skad dgon pa la sogs pa bzung*/ gtsang du se sprag dgon kyang bzung ste 'gro don bskyangs/ de nas nged kyis se sprag la mi thar pa 'dug pas ri sgab 'dir ngal bso sa zhig byed gsungs nas chos sding btab/

bla ma zang gi snyan pa thos pas spyan drangs chos 'brel zhus pas/ zhang gi zhal nas/ khyod kyi dgon pa 'di chu shing 'dzom pa mi 'dug ste/ mi 'du ba 'gro 477)ba la phan thogs pa gcig 'ong ba 'dug pas ming chos sdengs su thogs gsungs/ dgon ming zhang gis btags/ de'i tshe mi rnams kyis chos lha khang pa la zhus nas zhab tog 'tshal pa la byed zer rmad pa'ang byung skyes bu chen po 'di rtogs grol dus gcig la byung ba rdzogs chen rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa rang shar nas rdo ri brag sogs la thogs med du 'gro nas/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skye dgu rnams blo bsgyur nas chos la bcud de thar pa'i lam la bkod/ slob ma dge bshes nyi zla ltar grags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang du byung*/ rgya gar rgya nag bal po la sogs skad rigs mi gcig pa'i skye bo du ma 'dus/ rdo rje gdan la mchod pa lan gsum bskyal/ mthar dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 478)pa lugs gsang phu'i rgya rang gad logs kyi dgon par sku gshegs/ spur chab la gdan drangs nas gzad du 'ug skad dgon par zla ba bzhi bzhugs/ de nas thang skyar spyan 'drangs nas spur sbyangs pa'i tshe na sgra dang 'od dang 'ja' tshon sogs dang sku dang yig 'bru mchod rten dang ring bsrel gyi tshogs dpag med byon no/ gcen po dpon dang slob mar gyur pa rnams kyi skyes bu chen po de'i gdan sar dgongs nas gzad thang skya'i gtsug lag khang btab/ zhig po la/ thugs zin gyis slom ma drug gi nang nas kyang gdams pa'i bka' byo zhing mkhyen pa'i bcud thob pa'i thu bor gyur ston jo ye yin/ de ni mes po rta bon dbang grags bya ba chos bon gnyis ka byed sa g.yu ru stod kyi bad gapor gyur pa zhig la bu brgyad yod pa'i chung shogs r+t+wa ston jo 'bum/ de'i bu sta ston jo yi 'di yin/ bla 479)ma'i mkhyen rtogs bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du thob pas/

'di skad gsungs te/ thogs ma med nas 'khrul lugs bsam gyis mi khyab/ las 'phro sad dam bsags pa'i stobs kyis su/ tshad ldan bla ma gsang sngags zab mo dang*/ mang du mjal te thos pa bag ri byas/ sems kyi sgro 'dogs zhig po'i drung du chod/ mnyam med rin chen de yi thugs kyi bcu brgyud pa bzhi ldan gdams pa zab dgu gnang*/ zhes kyang gsungs/ rta ston jo ye 'di chu lugs la 'khrungs/ nyer lnga la zhig po dang mjal/ lo bcu gcig bar dbu sngas sgrel te bzhus so bdun la bla ma zhig po zhi bar gshegs/ de rjes de'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun rgya cher bskyangs nas dgung lo drug bcu rtsa brgyad pa lcags stag la zhi bar gshegs so/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba ni/ gdung rus glan 480)te tshong 'dus su 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas mkhyen pa shin tu che/ sngags gsar snying dang mtshan nyid kyi'ang mngon pa kun las btus la mkhas/ gshed skor shangs pa shāka 'bum gsan nas 'khrul 'khor las sbyor sogs la mkhas shing mthu che/ gzhon dus gong ma'i lung gis rgya yul du byon/ 'tshams la sogs pa'i rnams 'gyur dang*/ gong ma la 'bru 'dab dgos pa'i me sde mang pos/ than pa byung ba'i tshe gong ma la char 'bebs pa zhus pas/ der khong brdzangs pas/ khong gis dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ char yang dag par phebs/ gong ma dgyes te gnang sbyin mang po gnang bas/ nom pa chen po dang bcas bod du phebs/ ngo shes dang grogs mched sogs la ci yang ma sbyin par yum gyi don du bla ma dang dge 'dun la yo byad rnams phul/ sku tshe'i smad 481)la tshogs pa chos lung pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan rdo rje 'bum zhes pa rdo rje dpal zhes gsol lo/ 'di nyid shing spre la 'khrungs nas dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis pa shing sbrul la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs so/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa ni/ ston pa nyid kyis gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud thal 'gyur las/

slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje nas bzung rim pa bzhin lung bstan nas/ de 'og dge slong dpal dang ldan/ zhes rig 'dzin kun mā ra dza dang*/ de nas blo gros mchog gi 'dzin/ zhes chos rje kun mkhyen chen po lung bstan pa yin te/ shes bya thams cad la chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i don dang*/ blo gros zhes pa'i mtshan sgras tshig gi sgo nas kyang shin tu gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ des nas dam pa 'di nyid ngo bo rgyal ba kun dang rnam dbyer ma mchis 482)pa'i 'phrin las la dbang 'byor yang*/ gnas skabs gdul bya thun mongs kyi don mdzad tshul gyi lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ rigs ni sa mi bdun gyi nang tshan rta mgrin gyi grub thob ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi dbon rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga pa slob dpon lha bsrung zhes bdu rtsi'i grub thob dgung lo brgya dang lnga bzhugs pa de'i sras slob dpon brtan bsrung zhes pa'i bar du grub thob rgyun chags par byon pa de dang*/ yum 'brom bza' bsod nams rgyan zhes pa'i sras su sa spre la g.yu ru grwa'i stod grong zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ btsas ma thag nas nam gru re ma tīb gzugs dngos su bstan nas bsrung ba dang*/ gsung byi tshe dad pa dang snying rje blo gros kyi mthu rnams skye bas thob pa'i rtags shin tu gsal lo lnga nas bris klog brda bstan pa tsam gyis tshogs med par mkhyen/ bdun nas bzung yab las/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 483)'dus pa/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ gu ru zhi drag rnams kyi dbang lung man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa dang sman rtsis la sogs pa'ang gsan cing kun chub par mdzad/ dgu pa la gra phyi'i tshong 'dus su nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa brgya tshar sgrogs pas tshig don thugs su chud/ bcu gnyis pa la bsam yas su mkhan po bsam 'grub rin chen dang*/ slob dpon kun dga' 'od zer las rab tu byung*/ mtshan tshul khrims blo gros su gsol/

'dul ba la sbyangs shing bcu bzhi pa la bshad gsar mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa 'thon/ bcu dgu pa la/ gsang ne'u thog tu slob dpon btsan dgon pa dang*/ khyad par bla brang pa chos dpal rgyal mtshan dang*/ chos grags gnyis par grags par gzhon nu rin chen gnyis gtso bor brten cing*/ phar tshad kyi gzhung 'grel mtha' dag gsan nas tshig 484)don rnams la mkhas par sbyangs/ slob dpon gzhon nu rgyal po las dbu ma rtsa 'jug sogs kyi gzhung 'grel man ngag dpang lo chen po las mngon pa dag mod ting 'jin rgyal po sogs zab mo mdo lnga'i bshad pa dang snyan ngag sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams kyang gsan cing*/ de dag gi tshig don mtha' dag lo gsum la kun chub par gyur te/ lung rig smra ba'i snga rnams su gra skor mdzad pas/ gzhung tshogs kyi rgya/ mkhyen rabs kyi rtsal/ rig pa'i rno 'gyur kun la thogs pa mi mnga' bas/ thams cad kyi bsngags pa'i yul du mthun snang grubacing*/ bsam yas lung mang pa zhes mtshan du thogs/ de dag gi snga phyi ci rigs par don phag pa gzhon nu don 'grub las/ mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs kyi dbang khrid bshad bka' thams cad dang*/ gsang 'dus sbyor rgyud la sogs pa/ slob dpon bkra shis rin chen 485)las bde mchog dang lam 'bras/ sbyor drug zhi byed rdzogs chen sems phyogs kyi bskor/ slob dpon gzhon nu rdo rje las spyod 'jugs dang bslab bsdus bstan rin ma la sogs pa/ mthing ma ba sangs rgyas grags 'od las/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa sogs gsang sngags gter ma mang po dang*/ gzhan yang chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ sa skya pa'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ slob dpon dbang yes bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa/ rin chen khro phu ba/ khang dmar ba/ bla ma tshong 'dus pa/ za lung rin po che/ shug gseg ri pa sogs yongs su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen nyi shu lhag tsam las gsang sngags gsar snying gi dbang bka' rjes gnang*/

mdo sngags kyi gzhung che chung mang po'i bshad pa dang lung zab khrid gdams ngag rtsis sogs tha snyad kyi phyag khrid sogs shes bya'i chos tshul mtha' dag la sbyangs shing mkhas par 486)mdzad/ gsang phur sde snod kyi gsan pa mdzad pa'i skabs de rnams su mi gso ba/ dbyangs can ma/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa'i de dag zhal gzigs shing*/ khyad par lha mo dbyangs can mas phyag mthil du bzhag ste gling bzhi ri rab dag bcas pa bzhag bdun du bstan pas thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi mthu grub/ gsang phur bzhugs skabs khams pa'i chags sdang gi rtsod pas thugs phyungs te dbur stod rgya ma lcog la'i brag phug tu zla ba brgyad mun mtshams kho na ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/ de'i tshe rje btsun 'phags ma mdzes sdug mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi skus rin po che'i cod paṇa nyid kyi dbu la bcings te/ rtag tu byin gyis brlob cing dngos grub stsol bar dbugs dbyung ba thob/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa la yi dam lhas 487)lung bstan pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin chen po ku mā ra dza'i spyan sngar phebs/ yar stod skyam gyi phur bzhugs pa dang mjal/ nga'i chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa' 'dug gsungs dgyes par mdzad/ spyir dbang dang gdams pa mang du gsan/ khyad par gsang ba bla na med pa'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams nyams khrid du gsan nas zas gos gnas mal sogs kyis bka' spyad la mi zhums pa'i snying stobs kyis nyams len chig sgril du mdzad pas rdzogs pa chen po rang snang res med kyi nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ gzhan yang de dag gi rgyud 'grel gdams ngag phran tshegs dang bcas pa rnams kyang rdzogs par gsan cing gdams pa'i gtad rgya dang bcas rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ mchims phu la sogs pa'i dben gnas rnams su lo gsum pa'i dam bcas mchon lo bdun du zab lam gyis sgrub pa la

488)nan tan du mdzad/ skabs 'gar bla ma'i drung du bsnyen nas nyams rtogs kyi mtha' rgya legs par spyad pa las/ gnas lugs zab mo'i lta ba'i gnad/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags/ shes bya rab 'byams la thogs med kyi mkhyen pa/ srid zhu'i spyod lam brten tshul 'khor gsum yongs dag gi 'bul ba mang po sogs sgo du ma nas mnyes par bsgrubs shing thugs kyi sras gcig bur gyur/ mchims phur sgrub pa'i dam bca' la bzhugs skabs/ gu ru zhi drag dpal chen po gtso 'khor/ rdor sems dang rje btsun sgrol ma sogs yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs/ ma mgon gza' dang dam can rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrub par dam nos/ mkha' 'gro rnams dang chos kyi sgro ba mi lab pa bzhin byung*/ lha sar jo bo mchod nas gsol ba btab pas/ mdzod spru las 'od zer 'phros pa 489)rang la thim pas rgya gar bya rgod phung ri dang li yul kyi bkor pa der paṇ+ḍi tar 'khrungs tshe chos mkhyen pa rnams gsal bar shar/ yos kyi lo mchims phu ri mong can du skal ldan 'ga' la snying thig gi dbang khrid dang por gsungs shing*/ de dang 'brel bar sngar srog sgrub mas glegs bam gtad pa'i brda dang gzugs can gyis gsol 'debs la brten mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang khrid kyang gsungs dus o rgyan yab yum gyis dbang bskur zhing mtshan btags/ rdo rje phag mo yi shes su babs pas gdams pa'i gnad bstan/ las 'brel rtsal gyi 'og tu longs sku'i zhing nyul bar bshad pa der ngos bzung nas lkog 'gyur lung bstan pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas kun gyis spyod yul du gyur/ g.yu sgron mas bskul ste gangs ri thod 490)dkar du phebs/ der mkha' 'gro snying thig gi zab mo gsal byed yang thig gi yig cha mdzad pa na rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dbugs dbyung dar bcas yun thung ngu la grub/ ku mā ra dzas dbang gi brda bstan gshegs pa'i mtshan ma shar ba ting nge 'dzin gyis mdo la bzlog

skabs 'di nas lhun grub 'od gsal gyi snang ba dang*/ lha dang bla ma'i zhal gzigs dang lung bstan pa'ang rgyun chags pa byung*/ gsungs rabs kyi rtsom pa phal cher yang gnas 'dir mdzad/ lha rings brag tu zhi khro'i skongs kyi cho ga mdzad dus nam mkha' la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor der 'khod thams cad kyis mthong*/ rgya ma'i gnas su spyan drangs dge ba'i bshes gnyeran mang du 'dus pa la snying thig gi dbang khrid gsungs/ mkhas rlom 'ga'i blor ma shongs pas brgal brtag zhus pa rnams lung rig zab mos log rtog gsal 491)nas dad pa'i lam la bkod/ sgom pa kun rin gyis 'bri khung du spyan drangs/ grogs o rgyan gyi dgon pa phul dad pas bsnyen cing gdams pa du mas thar pa'i lam bstan/ lung bstan bzhin zhwa lha khang gsos dus dbu rtse'i thad nas gser mgu tshe gang bton pas gtsug lag khang gi cha rkyen dang rten gyi nam bzar gsol/ gter mang du 'dug pa las sgrub thabs zab pa 'ga' zhig bzhes/ dam can byis par brdzus nas bzo bo rnams kyi grogs byas rdo ring gnyis po sngar cab/ 'gyel du yod pa thabs 'phrul cis kyang ma lhongs pa chos rje nyid kyis bden stobs brjod nas sku chos kyi g.yab mos mod la lhongs/ sa rdo bsam dus 'thon pa'i mnan pa rnams slar gnon par brtsams pa na thug chom gyi sgra chen 492)pos 'phar zhing pa rdo'i char dang rlung 'tshub mun bsros pa lta bu'i cho 'phrul gyis 'khor rnams bag 'khums te ci bya dang bral ba na nyid kyis sku'i 'gyur ba dang gsung gi sngags sgra drag pos mnan pas cho 'phrul rnams mod la zhi/ rab gnas mdzad dus sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' gag bas shis brdzod kyi me tog 'thor ba dang*/ mgon po byams pas skye ba gnyis 'das pa'i 'og tu pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing du rgyal ba ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ zhes lung bstan pa gzigs tshe bcu'i mchod pa mdzad tshe slob dpon pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas pa byon nas byin gyis brlabs/

te sgro'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bum thang du 'byon par lung bstan/ gnas der zhi khro'i skongs bshags yun ring du mdzad/ mis mi thar ba'i 493)brag g.yang gzar po la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan btsugs/ de dag tu 'gro ba mang po rjes su bzung nas thar pa'i lam du rigs sad par mdzad/ phyir lam lha par byon dus yar klung pas tho mtshams par brtsam pa na mi snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis ngan pa de dag dmus long du gyur/ jo bo la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i tshe sku las 'od zer 'phros pa'i steng gi nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med bzhugs pas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ dam can mang pos bran bzhin du dam nod/ shug gseg tu phebs dus pa phag gis 'khrugs pas bod mi bde ba'i mtshan ma gzigs nas lho mon du thegs par phyogs/ mkha' ri sogs gzhis bdag rnams kyis pho ma nas bsus la yag man thang gnas su mkhan chen pas dbus skal ldan du mas 494)gus par mchod cing zab lam gyi gdams pas smin par mdzad/ bum thang dang rnga long sogs mtha' khobs mun pa'i gling lta bur dbang khrid sems bskyed sogs skal ba dang mtshams pa'i chos kyi sgron mis thar pa'i lam gsal bar bstan/ thar 'dod mang po 'dus sdero gas pa la thar pa'i gling du ming btags nas ri zhig bzhugs/ slar yang lho 'brog gi che dgus spyan drangs la yag lha lung dang man thang gnas su dge 'dun gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dus pa stong phrag longs pa la/ gsang ba snying thig gi dbang khrid spyi dang khyad par mkhan chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la gdams pa'i bka' bsrol rdzogs par gnang nas bstan pa'i gnyer gtad/ yar 'brog tu khri dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas dad pas mchod/ skal ldan bcu lnga la mkha' 'gro snying thig dag 'dus pa mang por chos 'khor 495)rgya cher bskor/ mkhyen rtogs dang 'phrin las kyis phag gru tā si dad par gyur nas g.yor po gzhung du brnyed bkur bzang pos yun ring du mchod cing nyis stong du longs pa'i 'dus pa la snying thig gi dbang khrid dang gong dkar du si ru pa gtso bor gyur pa la dbang dang gdams pa du mas rjes su bzung*/

sa skya pa'i bla ma dag pa dang gsang phu grags bzang gis lta grub kyi gnad la the tshoms gcod pa'i dri yig phul ba chos dang mthun pa'i lan gyis gus shing rangs par mdzad/ skyid shod gsang mdar gling stod slob dpon yon rgam pa sogs 'dus pa'i bsnyen bkur dang chos kyi dri ba mang du byas pa lung rigs dang 'brel ba'i lan gyis spobs pa btsoms/ gser srang bcu sogs yo byad mang pos tshims par mdzad/ lha sar byon dge 'dun mang po'i ser phreng gis bsus/ 496)lha ra gnyis kyi bar du chos kyi khri brtsegs pa'i steng nas sems bskyed sogs chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ khengs pa'i bla can mang po lung rig gis brtul nas dad pa'i gnas la bkod/ gnas rten rnams mchod cing bshad sgrub kyi sde mang por tshogs gsog rgya cher spel nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa'i rgyur bsngos/ snye phu shug gseg tu phebs skal ldan 'dus pa stong phrag brgal bar zab lam rdzogs pa chen por smin par mdzad nas dbur stod du spyan drangs/ mkhar ba rir si ru shākya bzang pos mchod dbang dang gdams pa du mas byin gyis rlobs/ dbyar bzhugs kyi phogs phul nas grog o rgyan dgon pa'i phu'i rdza 'dabs nas mda'i brag rtsa yan gang ba'i chos nyan 'bri khung gi mkhan slob sogs chos 'chad kyi slob dpon bzhi bcu tsam dang mi chen skya btsun mang pos mtshon 'dus 497)pa sum stong du longs pa la 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i dbang khri rgyab chos dang bcas pa gsungs shing yo byad du ma'i 'gyed chen gyis kyang tshim par mdzad/ slar yang gzhan don nus pa brgya phrag brgal ba la dbang gong ma sogs thun mong min pa'i gdams pa dang rgyud 'brel man ngag rnams mtha' rgyas su rtsal/ chos 'thon pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi tshe/ rang re dpon slob chos 'khor bskor nas tshogs mchod byed pa da res tsam du gda'/ khyed rnams kyi tshe 'di blos btang nas zab mo'i lam gyis gtan bde'i snying por longs pa gyis shig ces zhal bskos kyang nan tan du mdzad/

zhwa lha khang du mchod cing smon lam mdzad/ der khrom cos gsungs dus me tog gi char ngo mtshar ba babs/ bsam yas dud gtong drung gis spyan 'dren la brten rgya mar dad can du 498)mas mchod cing gdams pa'ang ci ris pa rtsams nas mchims phur phebs/ chos nyan pa mang du 'dus pa la gsang ba bla na med pa'i khrid gtsugs tshogs pa ches pas spros med kyi dbang zhag du mar sbrel ba tshes bcu drug gi bar du gsungs nas/ nga ni mi stod pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ 'chi med bde chen btsan pa 'dzin du 'gro/ g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbang dang*/ rgya mtshor don yongs grub pa'i tshong pa dang*/ bsam gtan grub pa'i dga' bas ches lhag gong*/ zhes sogs kyis zhal tshems gsungs pa bzhin du dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug zhes pa chu mo yos kyi lo rgyal zla'i tshes bco brgyad kyi dro khar chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis gdod ma'i zad par gshegs so/ de'i tshe rdul bral gyi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi gur dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas zla 499)mchod kyi bar rgyun chags pa dang*/ khyad par gdung bsreg khang du spyan drangs tshe sa lan gsum du g.yos thugs ljags spyan gsum mes ma rmas pa dang rigs lnga'i gdung ring bsrel grangs med pa byon no/ slob ma yang dus mnyam gyi skyes chen phal mo ches gsang ba snying thig gi chos 'di dang 'brel ba'i man ngag ci rim pa ma gsan pa med pa lta bu dang*/ dbang lung man ngag rdzogs par thob pa ni stong phrag mang po dang*/ dbang khrid tsam thob pa ni bgrang ba'i yul las 'das shing*/ nyams ni/ mkhas grub khyab brdal lhun grub/ gu ru 'od gsal rang grol/ mkhas grub bde legs rgya mtsho/ bra bral bkra shis 'byung 500)gnas/ grogs o rgyan chos rje/ rgyal sras bzod pa grags/ ldan sgom chos sagrags bzang po/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po/ shug gseg pa ye shes rab 'byams rnams kyis 'phrin las kyis rgyun rgya tsher spel bar mdzad pa'o//

༈ da ni rang cag rnams kyi sgrub brgyud kyi brjod par bya ste de la sprul sku rang grol ni/ gter chen rat+na gling pa'i skye ba de ma thag pa ste/ lho brag sman thang zhol du yab tshe dang bsam 'grub dang*/ yum o rgya skyid kyi sras su shing stag la 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus nas dad pa dang snying rje che zhing dam pa'i bag chags sad/ dgung lo bdun brgyad la bris klog sbyangs pa tshegs med du mkhyen/ bco lnga la lha lung du mkhan chen tshul dpal ba dang*/ lhun bkras pa las rab tu byung*/ chos spyod 'phrin sgrub gar 'chams dkyil 'khor bri thig sogs sbyangs pas mi ring bar 501)gzhan gyi slob dpon pher ba byung*/ 'phyis spos khang pa kun dga' blo gros dang*/ chos lung pa tshul dpal la mkhan slob zhus nas bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'dul ba'i bslab bya dang lag len rnams kyang legs par sbyangs/ mkhan slob gnyis dang*/ mkhas grub rin chen bzang po/ gter chen pad+ma gling pa/ sprul sku byang chub gling pa/ kun spangs legs pa'i shes rab sogs bshes gnyen dam pa drug bcu tsam snga phyir brten nas bka' gdams pa sa snying dwags shangs zhi gcod jo zhal bo dong pa sogs yongs cing*/ khyad par mtshungs med kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rdzogs chen po kun dga' bkra shis/ sman rtse ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas 502)grub ma ti dh+wa dza/ byams sding pa khu dbon la sogs las chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' bsrol snying thig ya bzhi mdzod bdun ngal bso bskor gsum gyis mtshon 'phrin las bka' bsrung dang bcas pa mtha' dag don gnyer chen pos gsan nas bsam sgoms kyis kun chub par mdzad cing*/ shel brag mchims phu/ mkhar chu/ yang rdzong sogs dben pa'i sgrub gnas du mar bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig pa'i nyams len lo zla du mar sbrel ba lan mang du mdzad pas rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom 'bras bu'i drod tshad mthar phyin/

yi dam lhag pa'i lha du ma'i zhal gzigs shing lung bstan pa thob/ chos brgyad kyi 'ching bas ma gso pa'i 'gro phan gyi 'phrin las lhun grub tu shar/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa shing lugs dar rgyas chos sdanings kyi ri khrod btab/ 503)thar pa don gnyer gyi tshogs pa'ang lnga brgyar longs tsam 'dus/ chos dang mthun pa'i rnam thar la bkod/ dbyar dgun gyi dus chos khrigs su bcad nas/ dus med kyi dbang chos sos so'i mos pa dang mtshams bar gsungs nas nyams rotas can mang du 'thon/ phyogs kyi dad ldan rnams kyi zhing du dbus gtsang lho mon la sogs par byon nas sgrub dbang khrid lung man ngag sogs chos sgo ris med skal ba bzhin bstan pas 'brel tshad don yod par mdzad/ dam pa'i chos la brten pa'i slob ma 'ang zhwa dmar ba dkon mchog 'bangs dang*/ 'bri khung zur pa sogs che dgu du ma dang*/ sprul sku byang chun gling pa/ snang rtse ba gar gyi dbang po/ bde chen gling pa sogs zab gter gyis bka' babs pa rnams dang*/ dpal sdings rab 'byams pa dang dpal sga lo 504)tsā ba sogs mkhas pa du ma dang*/ grub chen kun bzang dpal 'bar dang*/ klong yangs pa sogs sgom nyams can gyi rnal 'byor pa du ma dang*/ khyad par bstan 'dzin tshos kyi rgyal po dang*/ thugs sras kun dga' grags pa/ sha ma dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan pa sogs bka' srol snying por 'dzin pa du ma dang*/ sa skyong yar 'brog pa dang*/ 'phyongs rgyas pa sogs sde bdag mang po dang*/ gzhan yang rab byung sngags pa sgom chen pho mo khyims bdag sogs gdul bya mang po'i don mdzad pas dbus gtsang mnga' ris khams kong mon sogs su chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa mang du byung bas mtshon snying ma'i bstan 'dzin gci la/ chos kyi 'phrin las chi bar mngon sum du grub bo/ de ltar zhing 'dir lo grangs don bdun du bzhugs nas 505)lcags rta la g.yu ru khra 'brug gi nye 'dabs su gshegs so/

sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa ni snga lung rgab lar yab bkra shis dang yum bsam bstan bzang mo'i sras su me spre la 'khrungs/ gter chen pad+ma gling pa'i sprul par lung gis zin gsung byi ba tsam nas sngon gyi bag chags gsal bar gsungs/ dgung lo bzhi ba la gter ston gyi sras rnams kyis bum thang du spyan drangs so so'i sar rnyed bkur phun sum tshogs pas mchod/ pad+ma gling du sras dkon mchog bzang po'i gdung tshab tu bzhugs par byas te rab ru byung*/ gong ma'i gter ka'i dbang lung sgrub phrin rnams gsan sbyong la zhugs nas mi ring bar chos rje dkon mchog bzang po gshegs pas bde chen gling du sras zla ba'i sar re zhig bzhugs te chos bka' ci ris sa gsan/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa 506)la sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol gyis bod du spyan drangs lho bod kyi bstig gnas rnams su bzhugs su gsol te snyed bkur gyis rim 'gro dang*/ mdo sngags gsar rnying gi chos sgo mtha' yas pa dang*/ khyad par chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dang*/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i chos skor rnams kyi dbang khrid lung man ngag phyag len dang bcas pa thams cad bum pa gang byor gsan cing*/ de dag gi don bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnam 'byor gyis sgom sgrub dang sbyangs pa rnams bla ma'i drung du sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad/ nyi shu sa la lho brag tu byon/ mtsho yul brag dkar bas dgon gnas sogs kyi 'bul bas mtshon sngon gyi bu slob dang yon bdag thams cad kyis btud cing mchod/ der bla ma dbu mdzad pa las dbang lung ci ris pa dang 'chams dbyangs sogs gsan cing sbyangs/ 507)bum thang du sras zla ba'i spyan sngar bka' brgyad sgrub dbang sogs dbang lung 'ga' zhig gsan/ phyogs de'i skye bo mchog dman kun gyis mchod cing mos pa dang mtshams pa'i chos kyis don ldan du mdzad/ slar yang bod du byon nas rigs bdag sprul sku chen po nyid dang*/
