gzhan yang sa skya sngags 'chang chen po/ rje btsun grol mtshan/ snang rtse rig 'dzin sogs yongs 'dzin du ma la chos sgo rnam grangs mtha' yas pa gsan/ mchims phu la sogs par zab lam gyi sgrub pa nan tan du mdzad cing gnas lugs zab mo'i don rtogs/ lhag pa'i lha du ma'i zhal gzigs shing lung bstan pa'ang thob/ de nas chos rje nyid kyi dgon gnas rten gsum dang bcas pa phog nas gdan par dbang bskur/ zhi 508)bar gshegs rjes dgongs rdzogs rten bzhengs sogs bsgrub pa'i khur bzhes shing*/ 'phyis gu ru gtso 'khor gyi gser sku mi tshad ma sogs rten bzhengs du ma dang*/ dbyar dgun gyi sgrub dbang dus khrid gsung bas mtshon bu slob yon bdag gi 'dzin skyong sogs bla ma'i 'phrin las skyong ba'i khur bzhes shing*/ rgyal sras pad+ma chos rgyal dang*/ byang bdag dbang po'i sde sogs kyis kyang gus par btud pas mtshon/ lho mog dang gtsang rong sogs kyi gdul bya so so'i zhing du byon te de dag gi ri ba dang mthun pa'i don mdzad/ rigs sras pad+ma 'phrin las chos dang zang zing gnyis kas bskyangs te/ rang gi 'khrungs yul dang nye ba'i ri la dgon gnas 'debs par bka' bsgos pa ltar sgang steng gsang sngags chos gling gi dgon sde btab cing bstan pa'i rgyun bzung ba yang 'di'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun yin/ dbus su rje sna 509)tshogs rang grol gyi sprul sku gdan sar spyan drangs/ dbang lus man ngag dang bcas pa mtha' rgyas su stsal te bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol nas/ mi ring bar dgung lo drug bcu re gnyis pa me mo bya lo nag zla'i nyer brgyad la dar rgyas chos sdings kyi deb gnas su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te gshegs so/ mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin ni/ g.yu ru dol du yab smyos rdo rje tshe dbang dang yum bsod nams bu khrid kyi sras su me byi la 'khrungs/ rje sna tshogs rang grol gyis sngon rabs gsal bar gsungs bas mtshon dam pa'i bag chags bzang po pad/

dgung lo drug pa la gong ma'i gdan par spyan drangs/ bri klog dang phrin sgrub sogs kyi thugs sbyong tshegs med du chub/ brgyad pa la zhwa dmar dkon mchog 'bangs la dge 510)bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/ dkon mchog 'od zer du btags/ bcu gsum pa la rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin grags pa las rab tu byung*/ mdo sngags bston 'dzin bzang por gsol/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dang*/ gter chen pad+ma gling pa'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang lung khrid man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa mtha' rgyas dang*/ gzhan yang thugs sras kun dga' grags pa/ grub chen kun dga' rdo rje/ sngags changakun bzang dpal 'byor/ rgyas sras nor bu dbang rgyal/ byang bdag dbang po'i sde sogs la snying ma dang*/ sa skya pa khri chen/ zhwa dmar nag sogs bshes gnyen mang por gsar rnying gi chos bka' ji snyed pa snga phyir gsan/ btso brgyad pa la 'bras yul skyid tshal du 'bum rab mthar pa rgyal mtshan la brten nas sdud tshad dbu phar 'dul mngon sdom rig dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rnams la nan 511)tan chen pos sbyangs shing*/ chos gra der lung rig smra ba'i mgran zla med pa'i mthun snang du grub sgra dag snyan ngag sdebs sbyor gso rig bzo gnas sogs kyang las de dang de la mkhas pa'i slob dpon 'ga' zhig las thugs su chud par sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i gnas thob/ gung lo nyer lnga pa la karma pa dgu pa mkhyen pas thugs 'phrogs te/ sgar chen gyi 'bel gtam gleng bar bka' bskul ba las lo gsum su mdo sngags rig gnas lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i gsung rab 'bel mched kyis 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod ngag gis rgol zhing lan 'don pa sogs gang la yang thogs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod kyis blo ldan thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur/ skabs gzhan du gdan pa phan tshun dang*/ mchims phu/ g.ya' ma lung*/ lho brag mkhar chu sogs 512)dben gnas du mar yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub dang*/

rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig pa'i sgrub pa lo dang zla ba mang por sbrel ba sogs snga phyir mdzad pas bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ gu ru rin po che dang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma sogs yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs shing dbus dbyung ba thob/ lho dbus kyi gdan sa rnams dang*/ dad pa'i zhing du mar bla ma dang thugs reja chen po zhi khro/ bka' brgyad rnams kyi sgrub chen la brten la brten nas dam rdzas kyi 'gro phan dang*/ dbang khrid lung man ngag mang po dus dang dus med du gsungs pa las/ rigs sras gsang bdag chen po dang*/ rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra mnga' bdag bstan 'dzin chos bzang*/ spa gro ba chos dbang lhun grub/ spo bo rba kha sku skye rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/ mang thos dam chos bzang po sogs bka' bsrol 513)skyong ba du ma dang*/ lung rig smra ba'i ston chen/ tha snyad 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa sgom nyams can gyis rnal 'byor pho mo sogs dam pa'i chos kyis bsdus pa'i bu slob dbus gtsang lho mon gyi phyogs thams cad khyab pa dang*/ sa skyong sku rab pa dang*/ bya pa khri dpon 'phyong rgyas stag rtsi ba/ yar klung pho brang pa sogs rigs dang longs spyod kyis mtho bas mtshon yon bdag du mas dad pas bsnyen bkur/ dbang chos dang 'phrin las bzhi'i yul gang la gang la 'jug pa des las 'bras don ldan gyis re ba bskangs lkog gyur gyi gnas lung du bstan pa rnams kyang ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur pas blang dor gyi dmigs phye/ lho brag bkra shis sgang gi ri bor dang tshugs can gyis 'dus te btab pa yang re zhig gnas/ byang chub gling du rdzogs chen bla brgyud kyi snang brnyan ngo mtshar ba'i 514)'bur sku dang*/ thub pa gnas bcu dang*/ sgrub sde dgu mtshan brgyad sogs bris thang mang po dang*/ 'dul ba lung sogs bka' bstan gyi glegs bam ji snyed pa bzhengs shing*/

chos 'khor bsam yas dang*/ lha sa la sogs par snga phyir mar me sogs mchod 'bul smon lam dang bshad sgrub kyi 'dus sde mang por tshogs gsog gi yo byad du mas bsnyen bkur bas mchon sku gsung thugs kyis 'phrin las 'khor lo gsum gyi 'jug pa ci rig pa las nam yang mi g.yel bas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad nas/ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa pho 'brug gi lo'i bar gyi rnam thar zhal gsung ma'i mthar/ khyad par brgyud 'dzin bu la dbang lung dang*/ man ngag khrid lung mang po bar med bshad/ gsang chen bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ da ni bya ba zin gyis 'gyod pa med/ 'chi bar dga' ba'i 515)mdo sngags bstan 'dzin ngan/ gdod ma'i sa la gtan srid 'dzin du 'gro/ zhes sogs kyi don bsdu zhal gdams su mdzad nas zla ba gsum 'das pa mchu zla'i tshes bzhi la dar rgyas chos sdings su sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas pa bsdus shing dgongs pa skong ba'i mchod 'bul phyi nang gi rten bzhengs phrin las mi nyams pa'i rgyun skyong ba rnams rigs sras gsang bdag chen pos mdzad do/ rig 'dzin chen po 'phrin las byung ba ni/ yab smyos ston mkhas grub mod sngags bstan 'dzin dag yum rgyal rigs dgos po 'dzom pa'i sras su lcags phag lho brag byang chub gling du 'khrungs/ gsung byi ba tsam nas dam pa'i ngang tshul 'ba' zhig pas blo ldan thams cad dang bar mdzad/ dgung lo lnga nas bri klog gnyis ka byang bar mkhyen/ brgyad la yab rje 516)las rab tu byung mtshan o rgyan tshe 'phel du gsol/ rim bzhin 'phrin sgrub phyag bzhes dang bcas pa nas brtsams yid bzhin mdzod dang*/ sems nyid ngal bso rtsa 'grel rnams dang*/ sgra dang rtsis sogs shes bya rnams la thugs sbyongs mdzad pas thugs rab phul du byung ba'i blo gros kyi mthu thob/ khyad par yab rje nyid las bla rdzogs thugs gsum/

snying thig ya bzhi/ zhi khro bka' brgyad sogs gsang chen bka' gter du ma'i dbang khrid bshad lung man ngag sogs mtha' chod par gsan cing*/ bsam pa dang sgom pa'i nyams bzhes kyis gtan la phab ste kun chub par mdzad skabs der lho rgyud kyi bdag po 'phos pa'i dbang las re zhig lha lung gi 'dus sder bzhugs te/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho las dge tshul dang*/ kun rigs phag mo dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang lung 517)rnams gsan cing*/ de dag gi sgrub dkyil bri thig gar 'chams sogs kyang tshegasamed mkhyen/ khyad par rgyud bla dang zab mo nang don 'brel pa dang bcas par sbyangs te mdo sngags kyi zab don mtha' dag thugs su chud slar yang rang gnas su yab rje nyid las snying thig gi dbang khrid nan tan chen pos gsan pas mtshon thab chos mang po'i mtha' rgya bcad cing bstan pa'i gnyer kha gtad pa bzung*/ mi ring bar yab rje nyid dar rgyas chos sdings sus zhi bar gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod 'bul phyi nang gi rten bzhengs sogs dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad/ spyir yab rje nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma yang*/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ lo chen gzhan phan rdo rje/ lha btsun kun bzang rnams rgyal/ rdzogs chen nam 518)mkha' 'brug sgra/ bon lung pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol sogs snying ma dang*/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ gu shri grags pa mchog dbyangs/ gnas gsar bka' 'gyur ba/ sprul sku karma bstan bsrung sogs gsar ma ste/ bshes gnyen dam pa bcu phrag gsum lha pa las mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul rab 'byams gsan cing*/ de dag gi snying po'i lam bsrol ji bzhin pa bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i gnad kyi sgrub pa lo zla du mar sbrel ba lan mang po dang*/ rgyun gyis thugs dam 'khrigs su bcad pa las mi g.yel bas rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur/

'khor 'das ye shes kyi rol par shar bas yi dam du ma'i gzigs snang la dbang 'byor/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i bu slob ni/ yab rje dang*/ gsung sprul 519)rin po che/ dpa' bo rgyal mtshan pa tsam ma gtogs rang gi yongs 'dzin rnams kyis kyang chos kyi bdud rtsi ngoms med du gsol zhing gus par gtud/ gzhan yang dpal ri sprul sku 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ lo chen chos rgyal bstan 'dzin/ dam pa klong yangs 'od gsal/ khri dpon sngags 'chang chen po sogs rigs dang skye brgyud yon tan gyis mtho ba du mas mtshon/ bla ma slob dpon/ rab byung*/ sngags pa/ sgom chen/ khyim bdag sogs skal ldan du ma la/ spyir sgrub dbang khrid lung man ngag sogs thun mong du stsal ba dang*/ khyad par bzhed pa tha dad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs so so'i skal ba bzhin stsol ba la thogs pa mi mnga' bas snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin thog mnyam gcig la chos kyi 'phrin las 'gran du med pa mngon sum du 520)grub/ ngo bo chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i gnas lugs las ma g.yos bzhin du rnam 'gyur rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi bcu la dbang 'byor bas de dang de'i las la nges shes 'dren cing*/ khyad par dbang dus su ye shes kyi byin phebs pas dbang don rgyud thog tu 'byor/ khrid dka' gsungs dus so so'i nyams myong gi sne nas khrid mkhas pas zab lam gyi rtogs pa khrul med ngo 'phrod pas nyams myong drod tshad thob pa mang du thon/ gdul bya thun mongs pa rnams kyi ngor yang bsrung bzlog sogs 'phrin las bzhi'i las phran don ldan du grub pa la thogs pa med cing*/ gdon drag pos bzung ba'i nad pa lus rings pa/ ngag lkugs pa/ sems smyo 'bog gis 'chi bar thag bcad pa du ma yang*/ bka' sgo byin rlabs rten 'brel gyi bsgyur kha ci ris mdzad pa'i mdo la gsos pa dang mdzi 'phro chod pa'ang mang du byung 521)'chi khar 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyor dang rjes 'dzin mdzad pa la spyi bo 'phar zhing skye ba ngos zin yang mang*/

sad ser dang mi phyugs nad rim gyis mnar ba la thugs gtad pa tsam gyis bzlog cing zhi ba sogs 'gro ba so so'i re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang 'byor/ don de rnams mchog dman sus bskul yang mi chos ngo 'dzin gyis dbye ba mi 'byed par thams cad kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong*/ phyag tu 'byor ba'i yo byad kyi dngos po che chung gang la yang 'khor 'dabs kyi sri chags med par dkon mchog gi rten brten pa mang po dang*/ khyad par bka' gter gyi glegs bam brgya phrag brgal ba gsar du spel zhing*/ mchod sbyin gyi yul la tshogs gnyis kyi rgyur smin par mdzad pas mtshon/ mdor na chos brgyad kyis 'ching bas ma gso shing bstan 'gro'i 522)phan bde kho na sku srog las kyang gces par 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed kyis dbus gtsang lho mon sogs gdul bya'i zhing rnams su 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam thar gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las ris med du brkyangs pas don gnyis kyi 'bras bu lhun grub tu stsol ba las g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i ngang nas dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa chu stag dbo zla'i nyer gnyis la dbu gtsug 'phyur por 'phar ba las spos dud lta bu'i rlangs pa 'phro bzhin du sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su bsdus so/ mchod 'bul rten bzhengs phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ba gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa nyid kyis mdzad do/ ༈ bdag cag gi ma dam pa gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa ngo bo rgyal ba thams cad dang rnam dbyer ma mchis kyang gnas skabs 523)gdul bya'i don du sprul pa'i zlos gar bstan pa'i tshul ni/ rang gter gab rgya can gyi lung bstan las/ bai ro khyod ni skye mtha'i byang sems te/ khyod kyi 'di gong skye ba 'das pa ni/ smra bsam brjod 'das ye shes snying po'i don/

sems can sangs rgyas mnyam nyid khyab brdal yang*/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren par rdo rje chos/ shākya'i nye gnas ā nan+ta zhes dang*/ rgyal po dzaḥdang shit+naṃ ga r+bha dang*/ bod 'dir sam+bho ṭa sogs dag pa yi/ skye bo de tsam snang gis ma dag pa'i/ skye tshul brjod du lang ba'i gnas ma yin/ de ltar dag pa'i skye ba dag gis/ 'gro la snying rje chen po'i thugs bskyed pas/ bai ro khyod du skye ba blangs pa yin/ khyod kyang shrī sengha ye shes mdo/ pad+ma bdag sogs gtsug gi bla mar brten/ gdams pa'i gnad rnams phu thag bcad 524)byas nas/ chos sku'i rang zhal mngon sum rtogs gyur pas/ las 'phro ma dag skye ba len mi srid/ 'on kyang sems bskyed smon lam bzang po yis/ mtshams sbyar mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpal nyid du/ dbang phyug 'bar dang rak+shag rdo rje gling*/ kun skyong gi dang mdo sngags gling pa sogs/ pad+ma bdag gi zab gter bdag po dang*/ gzhan yang theg pa che chung sna tshogs la/ de dang mthun pa'i ngo mtshar skye ba'i grangs/ bcu phrag gcig dang gsum tsam 'das pa'i mthar/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pas laṅka'i yul du li tsa wi dri med grag pa sogs rig 'dzin gyi 'khor rnams la gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams gsungs nas phyag na rdo rje la gtad de rdo rje chos zhes ming btags te bka'i bsdu ba por grags pa dang*/ de nas bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus 525)shākya'i rigs las thos pa 'dzin pa'i mchog 'phags pa kun dga' bor gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rim gro ba mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu za hor gyi rgyal po dzaḥr gyur nas rgya gar shar phyogs su rnal 'byor phyi nang gi rgyud rnams ches dar bar mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu slob dpon shin+t-i gar+bhar skye ba bzhes te/ bsel ba'i tshal du slob dpon brgyad la sgrub ste chen po brgyad ma mo dang*/

mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gtad pa'i tshe slob dpon 'di nyid la gzi'i sgrom bu babs te drag sngags dmod pa'i sgrub pa la mkhas par mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po bod rjer byon pa'i dus/ de nyid kyi blon po thu mi snang grags kyi bu thu mi sam+bho ṭa zhes bya bar skye ba bzung nas bod du 'bri klog gis bsrol med pa la/ paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seṅge la sgra bslabs te bod skad dang bstun nas 526)nas kā li sum cu dang*/ ā li bzhir bsdus/ gzugs kha che'i yi ge dang bstun nas bcos/ byā ka ra ṇa'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad de rgyal po la bslabs/ dpang skongs/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ dkon mchog sprin sogs bsgyur te bstan pa'i bsrol gtod par mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal mo legs zher dpal mo'i bu dge slong pur+ṇa zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes pa'i phyi ma la lo tsā ba bai ro tsa nar sku 'khrungs pa yin te/ rang gter sha 'ug lung byang las/ shaka thub nye gnas kun dga' bo/ in+t+ra bhu ti rgyal po dzaḥ thu mi pur+ṇa la sogs pa/ 'gro 'dul skye srid de dag las/ bai ro khyod du 'phos pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsā na ni/ gtsang snye mo bye mkhar du spa gor he 'dod kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mkhan po zhi 'tsho las rab tu byung*/ rgya gar du lan grangs mang du 527)byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la rgyu 'bras kyi chos spyi dang phyi ma bdun las gsang sngags nang gi chos mang du bslabs/ khyad par shrī sengha gtso bor brten cing*/ de'i slob ma ye shes mdo dang bi ma la sogs la'ang gtugs te rdzogs pa chen po'i chos la mkhas par sbyangs/ rkang mgyogs grub pas bod yul du nyin gcig la brtol/ rje blon rnams la nyin par rgyu 'bras spyi dang nam gung man ngag gi chos rnams bsgyur bshad kyis gtan las phab/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas rje 'bangs nyer lnga la dbang bskur ba'i tshe stobs ldan nag po'i me tog la dbang bar gyur te drag sngags kyi grub pa brnyes/

g.ya' ma lung sogs bod yul gyi dben gnas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rgya mo rong*/ rgya nag li yul/ sogs yul sogs su byon nas 'gro don mdzad mthar 'od 528)kyi skur yal lo/ de'i 'og tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbang phyug 'bar du skye ba bzhes te sngar grwa pa mngon shes kyi lo rgyus brjod pa de'o/ de'i 'og tu rak+sha chos 'bar tu skye ba bzhes nas sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis tshul bzung ste ma mo sgang shar sogs mdos chog gi 'phrin las 'ba' zhig skyong ba mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal sras rdo rje gling par gra'i phu grogs gad du sku 'khrungs/ zhang ye shes mdzes pa las rab tu byung*/ kun mkhyen 'khras pa/ sman lung pa shākya 'od/ khyab brdal lhun grub sogs la chos mang du gsan/ gnam lcags brag yang rdzong spa gro mchims phu sogs dbus gtsang lho mon gyi gter gnas mang po nas/ snying thig bcu gsum/ bon rdzogs chen gser zhun/ lta ba klong yangs/ gu ru zhi drag bka' brgyad/ bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs gter chos shin tu mang ba bton te 'gro 529)don mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu kun skyong gling par skye ba bzhes te zab phu lung*/ bsam yas mchod rten dkar po sogs nas/ rdor sems snying thig gu ru'i zangs sku mi thub ma/ bram ze dri med bshes gnyen gyi dbu thos sogs chos dang dam rdzas kyi zab gter spyan drangs nas 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu mdo sngags gling pa'am/ mtshan gzhan mchog ldan mgon po ste/ lho brag ban pa lung du sku 'khrungs te/ mnga' ris gung thang rgyal pos bla mar bkur ste mtha' dmag bzlog pa la sogs pa'i 'gro phan rgya cher mdzad pa dang*/ de'i sku phyi mar lho nub rnga yab gling du slob dpon pad+mas rjes su bzung ste 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes pa srin po chos kyi go char skye ba bzhes nas bdag nyid chen po nyid du sku 'phos pa yin no/

gzhan yang rdo rje gling pa'i lung 530)byang las/ nyi ma seṅge khyung po rnal 'byor dang*/ sum ston jo dar gra pa mngon shes dang*/ bstan pa gzhung 'dzin rong sgom chos bzang dang*/ dge bshes nyams bro gu ru brnon rtse dang*/ khyung grags lha 'bum shākya 'byung gnas dang*/ grub thob dngos grub g.yag sde paṇa chen dang*/ mtshal thang sgrom sde sprul skur grags pa'i mthar/ zhes 'byung bas/ khyung po rnal 'byor dang*/ dge bshes grags pa/ rong zom/ bon po lha 'bum rnams dus mtshungs kyi sku'i sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ sum ston jo dar/ bstan pa gzhung 'dzin/ dge bshes nyams bro rnams gang du byon dang phrin las gang bskyangs kyi lo rgyus bdag gis ma thos la/ de las gzhan pa nyi ma seṅge ni/ rog shes rab 'od kyi gcung zhig po rin chen zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan mnga' ba ste/ rgyal ba te ne'i chig brgyud kyi bka' 531)babs pa zhi byed bka' babs phyi ma phyogs kun tu rgyas pa'i chu mgo lta bur gyur pa de'o/ khyung grags kyang*/ shākya 'byung gnas ni/ bde gshegs zur po che zhes mtshan nyid zla ltar grags pa de'o/ grub thob dngos grub ni/ gtsang gi ri bo che'i gter spyan 'dren pa de/ 'di gter bzhes dus dgung lo drug brgya yin par grags pas/ snga mo zhig nas byung bar mngon/ g.yag ste paṇa chen ni/ rang byung pa dang g.yung ston pa sogs kyi slob ma mkhas grub chen por gyur pa de'o/ mtshal thang sgom sde sprul sku ni/ mtshal gyi gdan rabs bzhi pa sangs rgyas 'bum gyis dus/ bla tshang dang dbon tshang zhig nas 532)khong gi zur du 'phrin las bskyangs pa las sgom sde byung bar grags pas sangs rgyas 'bum lags so gzhan rnams sngar smos pa dang*/ der ma zad sprul pa'i zlos gar/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ chos rje pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ gter bton kyang sangs rgyas bla ma/

rgya lo tsa ba/ ldang ma lhun rgyal/ g.yag 'phyar sngon po sogs mtha' yas te 'phags chen rnams kyis mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir na rmongs pa bdag lta bus brjod par mi nus so/ de'i phyir sku tshe snga ma'i 'phrin las dang skye ba'i phreng ba zur tsam zhig rmos nas/ da ni sku tshe 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa cha tsam zhig brjod pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rigs ni 'od gsal gyi lha las chad pa zhig ste/ de yang sngon gyis dus na bod yul gyi sa'i kha cha rag tu sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i skyes 533)bu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa lta na sdug pa mig gi bdud rtsi gyur pa zhig snang bas/ der mi rnams yang ya mtshan par gyur te bla'i gnas su bkur bar byas so/ de'i tshe mi'i grib kyis lha'i bu nyid myos par gyur pa na smyos zhes pa'i rigs brgyud du grags pa las phyi rus smyos ston yon tan grags pa sogs kha rag gi lha sa rnams yin cing*/ nang rus mthing ste/ mthing ma smyos zhig chen po nas smyos sgom chen po pad+ma rdo rje sogs nas smyos ston grags pa rin chen gyi sras grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras jo 'bum dpal la gong ma'i zhal tas/ sngon lha sras mu rub btsan pos gra dol gzhung gsum gyi bdag por dbang bar byas pa'i zhang rnam snang gi sar sku dmag tu byon pa las mi rabs lnga'i mthar yab smyos tshe dbang rdo rje dang yum spa gor gyi rigs tshe ring bu 534)ga gnyis kyi sras su lang 'gro'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen mdo sngags bstan 'dzin sku 'khrungs/ de'i sras sus yab rje rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub sku bltams pa de dang yum yang bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa tha snyad rigs gnas kyi dbang phyug gong ma rgyal mchog lnga pas rtsis rig gi slob dpon du bkur ba khyim na gnas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas 'tsho ba rje don 'grub dbang rgyal gyi sras mo lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma ste/

mkha' 'gro ma bde chen rgyal mos yab la stsal ba'i lung byang las/ rta nag shel dkar mtsho sgron gyi/ sprul pa byi lo dbyangs can ming*/ rang gnas grwa yi phyogs nas 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pas yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su me khyi hor zla gnyis pa'i yar ngo'i tshes dgu'i mtshan mo'i tho rangs kyi thun gyi cha la/ grwa nang rigs pa'i 'byung gnas sprul pa'i skyes 535)mchog sna tshogs rang grol gyi gdan sa dar rgyas chos gling gi 'od gsal rtse zhes pa'i gzims chung du sa g.yo ba dang 'od 'byin pa dang mchas la 'ja' tshon khrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan dang bcas bltams te/ gab rgya can gyi lung byang las/ sum bcu kha ral snyigs ma lnga bde'i dus/ bsam yas lho nub gra zhes g.yo ru'i sar/ lung pa byang blta dor ma brkyang 'dra'i tshigs/ srin mo 'jigs 'dra'i dge bsnyen sngags zhol du/ bud+dha dzñā na'i sprul pa tshe ming ba shel dkar mtsho sgron sprul pa dbyangs ming mas/ bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor sngags kyi brtul zhugs can/ mi khams khyi yi lo pa pad+ma'i ming*/ gzugs byad ha cang mi ring mi thung ba/ mdangs bsnubs rin chen rigs kyi rtags 'chang bas/ pad+ma nga la mos pa lhag 536)por byed/ bco brgyad lo la gter kha dang po 'byed/ ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ de ltar sku bltams ma thag don 'grub dbang rgyal gyis rde'u brgya po drug pas gtan la phab pa'i btsas rlung sogs rtsis pa las byung ba'i mtshan/ kun dga' dngos grub rin chen dbang gi rgyal po zhes gsol/ yab rje nyid kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs du mas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ lo gsum bzhi tsam nas bri klog nyer mkho'i mchog 'phrin dbang rab gnas lung dang bcas pa'i tshig dang lag len tshegs chu ngus mkhyen par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su 'dzam gling gi nor bu kun mkhyen rgyal ba lnga pa'i drung du gtsug phud phul/

mtshan ngag dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin zhes bstsal/ skyed grong gi rang byung 'phags pa thog mar phebs pa dang dus 'gribs pas rten 'brel bzang zhes 537)dgyes pas dbus dbyung*/ rim bzhin gnas dus ci ris pa kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun te bka' drin mtshungs med rnams gnyis/ smin grol lam bzang ston pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po bcu drug zab chos sna tshogs gsan pa'i yongs 'dzin so snga rnams gus par brten nas/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang*/ byang sgom bka' bsrol gsum bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur brda don 'phrod pa thog ma'i smin byed du gsan nas sdom pa gsum ldan gyi gzhi bzung*/ mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs snga 'gyur bka' ma ding sar rgyun yod de cog dang*/ gter ma bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde spyi bye brag mang pos mtshon yongs grags phal che ba/ sngags gsar ma rags pa rnams dang*/ mdo phyogs mang po dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid bshad lung 538)ji snyed pa rnams gsan/ dgung lo bcu gsum nas gzhung lugs ci rigs pa sbyong ba la zhugs te/ dpal gsang ba snying po dang*/ rgyud bla sems nyid ngal bso/ yid bzhin mdzod rtsa 'grel gsan nas gzhan la 'chad spel mdzad/ khyad par kun mkhyen chen po'i gsungs rabs rnams la gsan gzigs nan gtan tu mdzad pas sngar don spyi tsam gyi shun pa bud nas don gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i spros pa che par mdzad/ de nas gnas skabs ci rigs par mchims phu dang*/ g.ya' ma lung sogs gnas chen dang rang gnas kyi dben pa rnams su lo sbrel dang*/ zla drug ma/ zla gcig gi mtha' brten pa yan gyis/ gu ru zhi drag rdor sems bka' brgyad/ yang phur gshin rje gshed/ rta mgrin/ mkha' spyod ma sogs zhi khro sum cu so lnga tsam bsnyen pas zhal gzigs dang lung bstan gyi 539)rim pa mtha' yas ste gsang ba'i rnam thar du 'khod pa ltar dang*/

khyad par thod rgal dang rlung sbyor gyi rtags snang mngon du gyur/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la g.ya' ma lung nas zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig gi chos skor ma bu sogs dang myong grol byin rlabs kyi ril bu dang bcas pa'i zab gter spyan drangs nas snyal ldan mang po smin grol la bkod/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa nas bzung rgyal ba lnga pa chen po dang mjam mgon sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gnyis kyis dbu'i bla mar bkur bas lo re bzhin rkyen sel gyi sku rim dbang bka' mang po dang*/ khyad par bka' gter gyi chos skor ji snyed pa phul/ rang gi yongs 'dzin du mas kyang chos kyi rnams grangs mang po don gnyer chen pos gsan pa'i ri bo bskang*/ gzhan yang bstan 'dzin gyi skye mchog du ma dang*/ chen po'i 540)go sar bzhugs pa mang po sogs mchog dman bar gsum la dbang dang sgrub chen khrid lung man ngag sogs chos 'chad pa'i rnams grangs 'di tsam zhes dpag par mi nus/ khyad par rnyigs ma rang lugs la med du mi rung ba'i chos bka' khyad par can chad du nye ba du ma 'bad rtsol chen pos nyan bshad dang*/ bshad sgrub kyis bsrol gtod nas srog 'thud par mdzad/ de bzhin du bka' rtsom gyi rim pa yang mtha' yas so/ bstan pa'i bdag po mchod yon zung gis dbus/ phul ba'i dngos po rnams don yod par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gter lung las kyang*/ khyad par g.yu ru gtsang ma'i sar/ tshom bu gcig tu 'dus pa'i sde/ ma 'ongs bstan pa cher 'phel nas bod kyi bde skyid dgung du 'degs/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ 'dus sde o rgyan smin grol gling 'di nyid me 'brug gsar du bskrun 541)nas rim par gtsug lag khang gsum du bzhes/ gra tshogs kyang dang po brgyad gra tsam las phyis sum brgyar nye bar sdom pa gsum gyi bslab khrims la bkod nas 'khor lo gsum gyi rnams thar lhur len pa bsnyen bkur gyis mi brel ba rgyun chags pa dang*/

de dag gi gnas mal rten gsum mchod rdzas dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po du ma'i sgrub mchod dus bzhir bsgrub pa'i gzhi rten yo byad du ma dang*/ bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan mang po dag*/ gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur gyis mtshon glegs bam lnga brgya skor dang*/ mchod rten chen mo sogs thugs rten du ma bste yo byad kyi dngos po thams cad mchod rdzas su thims par mdzad pa dang*/ gnam lcags brag dang shel brag sha 'ug sogs gter gnas rnams nas zab gter gyi chos sgo mang po spyan drangs nas skal ldan rnams 542)smin grol la bkod pa ste mdzad pa cha shas tsam zhig smos so/ de ltar dgung lo bcu drug nas drug bcu re dgu'i bar chos kyi 'phrin las bskyangs pa'i slob ma ni bgrangs ba las 'das/ mthar shing rta hor zla dang po nas cung zad bsnyun ba'i tshul bstan nas/ khyad par nyer lnga nas khu dbon rnams la zhal gdams phyi mtha'i bslab bya rnams bstsal/ de nas bzung zhabs rim du gnas pa rnams kyi snang ngor nub kyi phyi'i rtsig ngos na yod 'dra ba'i rgya ba gling lta bu'i sgra shin tu snyan pa rgyun chags su byung zhing de mtshungs ga bur lta bu'i dri dad kyis gzims chung phyi nang thams cad khyab pa'ang byung*/ shar phyogs su goms pa bdun 'gro dgos yod gsungs bzhengs te zhabs gom bdun spos nas skyil dkrung gis bzhugs nas/ snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang*/ sku dang ye shes rol par 'byams klas pa 543)zab gsang rnal 'byor chen po'i nyams len la/ dbyer med thugs kyi thig ler ro gcig shog ces 'da' kha zhal tshems kyi tshul du gsungs te/ shing rga hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis kyi nyi dros la da de mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba yang byung ngo gsung ste/ phyag gnyis ḍā dril khrol ba'i brda' dang spyan lta gdengs dang bcas skad gcig la mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ de'i tshe nam mkha' 'ja' sprin gyis khebs pa dang me tog dkar po 'dab ma drug pa dang brgyad pa'i char ro mtshar ba babs/

de nas bzungs zhag mang po'i bar du me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od dang sa g.yo ba sogs pa'i ltas ngo mtshar du ma byung ngo*/ de nas zhabs drung khu dbon rnams kyis mchod 'bul phyi nang gi rten bzhengs 'phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ba la sogs mdzad cing*/ khyad par gdung zhugs la phul skabs dbu thod 544)dang thugs mes ma smas par phebs shing*/ ring sril gyi tshogs dang zhun thigs la rnam rol mtha' yas mgon po'i sku brnyan byon gtsang gzi byin dang ldan pa phebs te/ gter lung las/ 'das dus gdung la ring bsrel 'byung*/ sus myong mkha' spyod btsan pa zin/ zhes gsungs pas so/ thugs kyi sras dang gsungs kyi sras kyis mtshon pa'i bu slob gter lung nas bshad pa ni/ dam lhan chos bdag slob bu ni/ da lta'i mnga' bdag yab sras sogs/ sa thob rje 'bangs skye ba'i mtha'/ 'gro don nus pa sum cu lnga/ rang don gyur pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ chos kyis 'brel pa stong tshe gnyis/ smon lam 'brel pa khri phrag lnga/ las kyis 'brel pa drug bcu bdun/ gdugs thogs bdun gyis zhabs nas 'debs/ mi chen gsum gyis mnga' thang spel/ zhes so/ rags tsams zhog brjod na/ mchod yon nyid zla zung 'brel 545)sa skya pa bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ chab mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/ thugs sras gsung sprul/ spri bo chos kyi dbang po/ kong po thong 'brog sprul sku/ 'phyong rgyas dpal ri sprul sku/ gtsang nas drigs pa sprul sku/ zangs la mkhar sprul sku/ dwa la'i khu thog thu ngag dbang bshad grub rgya mtsho/ bon po sprul sku/ khams nas rdzogs chen pa dang ka thog rgyal sras/ kong po sba kha sku skye/ mi rag bla ma sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dus de'i mkhas grub thog snyam/ phal cher gyis zhabs la ma gtugs zhes bya ba med pas mtha' yas so/ khyad par du yang bka'i bum pa byo zhing mkhyen pa'i bcud thob pa'i thugs sras dang gsung gi sras/

dpal rgya rgya mtsho/ gcung 546)yid bzhin legs grub/ gcung rin chen rnam rgyal te/ 'di rnams ni chung ngu nas rjes su bzung ste/ dbang lung khrid man ngag rgyud bshad lag len rigs gnas dang bcas pa bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du rdzogs par gnang nas chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur te rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba'o/ de la mkhan chen lo tsā ba chos dpal rgya mtsho ni/ gter lung las/ g.yu sgra'i sprul pa blo ldan dharma'i ming*/ byang sems dad brtson snying stob ldan pa 'byung*/ zhes lung gi bstan pa'i skye chen sku tshe ril por 'chad rtsod brtsom gsum gyis 'phrin las bskyangs pas/ rigs gnas mang po la 'grel bshad sogs kyis bstan bcos dang*/ mdo'i skor la sdom gsum rnam nges kyi 'grel pa dpag bsam snye ma dang*/ sngags phyi nang skor la/ dbang sgrub thabs rjes gnang la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pa dang*/ khyad par gsang ba 547)snyig po la ṭī ka gsang bdag dgongs rgyan/ spyi don gsang bdag zhal lung la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mdzad nas dbyar dgun gyi chos grwar rgyud kyi bshad pa tshar re smin rgyas star chags pa dang*/ gnas dus ci ris par lo dang zla 'brel gyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes la snying por mdzad pas rdzogs pa chen po/ rang sganang ris med kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ slob ma yang sa skya bdag chen kun dga' bkris dang cham mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lha sogs che gnyan du mas bkur zhing mchod/ de ltar mchog dman bar ma'i skye dgu thams cad la chos kyi 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs nas mthar dgung lo re lnga pa sa khyi hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer bzhi la/ log smon stobs su gyur pa'i sbyongs 'gar pa'i dmag dpung gis dbus gtsang gi rnying pa ma'i chos sde yod do cog thams cad kyi dgon sde dmigs med du gshig grwa 548)pa rnams gcer bur phyungs nas skya bor bsgyur te khyim thabs byed pa'i gan sdom blangs/

bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams dkrongs pa'i dus der hor zla dang po'i nyer bzhi la/ lha ldan pho brang chen po'i mdun thad kyi pad+ma rags gsar zer ba'i sa de'i thad du spyan drangs par skad cig de nyid la zab lam 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyor gyis dag pa'i zhing du thal ler gshegs pas/ gshed ma rnams yu bur gyur te kha skyems so/ rigs sras pad+ma gyur med rgya mtsho ni/ gter lung las/ rigs sras rta mgrin sprul ba ni/ rdo rje'i ming gis 'gro don spyod/ ces lung gis zin pa 'di nyid/ yab gter chen nyid dang yum mkha' 'gro'i rtags kyi spras pa'i yon tan sgron ma zhes pa'i sras su me stag la 'khrungs/ btsas pa'i mtshan las/ shes rab rnam rgyal rdo rje 'bum zhes gsol/ chung ngu nas dam pa rnams gnyis kyis chos kyi bdud rtsi 549)bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du gnang*/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la mkhan po lo tsā ba ngag dbang chos dpal las tshig rdzogs kyi bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ chos rje gzhan phan dbang po'i drung du 'dul mdzod phar phyin la sogs pa rig lam nas lung rig gi bshad pa mtha' chod pa gsan/ bla ma dam pa gnyis kyis gsan pa gang yod kyi steng du gong dkar chos sde slob dpon dbang phyug pa spyan drangs nas rdo rje phreng ba la sogs pa gsar ma'i chos kyi rgyun yod do cog kyang gsan/ bstan bcos kyang snyan ngag gi ṭī ka phar phyin gyi spyi don/ gsang snying gi spyi don/ sdom gsum gyi zur 'debs/ tshe dbag gi las sbyor la gces pa'i man ngag gi sgron ma bdun pa dbang du sgrub phrin las kha tshar dang bcas pa'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pas yab kyi zhal chems su yang*/ chos 550)kyi cha pha las bu lhag ces dbugs dbyung*/ de ltar chos kyi phrin las bskyangs pa'i mthar dgung lo so gsum pa sa khyi hor zla dang po'i nyer drug la log smon can de rnams la lus srog ltos med btang ste ya nga dang bag tsha med pa'i lta gdengs kyis gshegs so/

gcu yid bzhi legs grub kyang rigs gnas sogs mkhas pa'i yul du phyin yang log smon can de rnams kyi dbang du song ngo*/ rigs sra rin chen rnams sdig can de rnams kyis brje bar ma nus te/ mon bod kyi sa mtha' rnams su re zhig bkums nas bzhugs/ de nas rtsā ri rgyud khams phyogs kyi dben rir gsang thabs kyis bzhugs nas gu ru zhi drag la sogs pa'i yi dam du ma bsnyen/ skabs su drag po mngon spyod kyis las la yang 'bad pa gang 'thon byas te lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs 551)skabs/ gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i thugs rje'i nyid mas bdud tshogs bdun pa'i dmag tu de dag pha mthar bskrad de spas kong bar byas/ gangs can bod kyi lha gicag 'dzam gling skye dgu'i 'dren pa rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho gru 'dzin 'jig rten dbang phyug gi pho brang chen po'i gser khri'i steng du mnga' gsol/ bod yul skye rgu so so'i lugs kyi chos dang srid kyi bya ba sngar lugs bzhin skyongs zhes pa'i btsan po'i lung bsgrags nas/ rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i nyi ma phyogs thams cad du brdal bas/ sngar yab mes kyi bu slob khams pa bla dpon rnams kyis bsnyen bkur gyis 'bul ba rgya cher btab cing*/ chos dang zang zing gis phrin las rgya cher gyur pa na/ gdan sa ma lag dang bcas pa 552)sngar ltar lhogs pas/ dbu chen khayur bzhes pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren byung bar/ de 'phral las stegs nas pho brang chen par rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshor mjal phyag mdzad pas/ gong ma gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i khri thog tu mnga' gsol ba'i bskon cha dang 'jags pa sogs tham ga spyi bor stsal bas/ gus 'dud kyis thon phyag zhus nas lam du zhugs/ rang zhabs pa rnams kyis bsu ba gser sbrengs kyi bkur bsti dang bcas rang dgon du phebs so/ dam pa 'di nyid ni sngon nas gter chen nyid kyis phyi mtha'i gzigs pas don gyis gdan sar khri non mdzad pa 'dra ste/

sku mya ngan las 'da' bar phyogs pa'i lo de'i nang du gcung kun dga' tshul khrims kyis do khur chen pos bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs dang chos 'khor lhun po'i steng du gser 553)gyi rgya phabe sabazo bkod kyis mtshar ba mdzes par spras nas rab tu gnas pa gsol bas de legs shin tu legs te de dus bu chung rgan par khri non yang byas nged kyis nas zhig 'thor byas na yongs gsungs par/ re zhig sku nyid bzhugs ring khri non gyi rigs mi gnang ba zhu zhes nan gyis gshol bas/ sang nyin rab ston gyi tshogs la phabes rgyu'i dgongs khang tshun da res nged kyi byas pa de ring legs 'dra yang*/ 'o na nged rang pha bu yang yang dus gcig tu 'dzom pa dka' bas sang nyin bu chung rin chen rnam rgyal yang tshogs su phyin na ཿlegs gsungs pas/ mgron gnyer gyis gdan gyi bkod pa rnams tshar bas bzhugs sa gang du byed zhus par/ gdong gral g.yon gyi mgo der gdan mtho ling nge ba zhig byas pas yongs gsung ba ltar 554)thog mar tshogs su phebs pa de yin pas ma 'ongs pa'i phyi mthar de dus mnga' gsol ba'o/ de ltar gdan sar phebs nas gtsug lag khang phan tshun sngar rgyun ltar bsos/ 'dus tshogs sngar yod rnams la bar skabs su khrims gtsang mi gtsang gis dag ther mdzad/ gsar zhugs brgya skor tsam bslab pa gsum gyis bsdams nas 'khor lo gsum gyis bya ba'i gnas la bkod/ yab mes kyis gtsugs pa'i tshul sgrub mchod rnams pa rnams gsos so/ gar chams spyan gzigs sogs pa'i yo byad sngon dus kyi grangs tshang ba sgrigs/ de nas dbus gtsang gnyis kyi sde 'khrug gis mthar sa spre hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer lnga la bsod nams dpung pa mtho bas stobs kyis 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal sor mi dbang 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyas shugs 'byung du gson pa/ 'jam dbyangs 555)gong ma rgyal pos bod khri bskor bcu gsum gyis rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba'i mnga' gsol legs skyes kyi 'jal 'bul sa phebs/

dad mos kyis gus par brgyud de rkyen sel gyi dbang sogs gsan te hi shrīr bkur/ rnyed bkur gyis gnang skyes mi dman pas dbugs dbyung ba'i bslab ston rgya cher stsal ba yi rangs kyis gnas su mdzad/ de nas rang dgon du bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar gyi rjes su zhugs te dbang lung khrid sogs dang*/ khyad par gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi bshad pa chad du nye ba 'chad nyan gyis spel nas sngar gyi bsrol gtod de chos kyi 'phrin las skyong bzhin pa 'di'o/ gzhan yang gter chen de nyid kyi dngos slob grwa pa 'dir sgrigs su zhugs pa'i bshes gnyen ni/ 'chad phrin gyi las sogs la dbang 'byor ba/ chos rje gzhan phan dbang po/ 556)mnga' bdag rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/ bla ma skyed ston pa/ snye mdo bla ma o rgyan rnams rgyal/ dge slong blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'bum rab 'byams pa o rgyan bskal bzang*/ zengs ston o rgyan dpal 'byor rnams dang*/ 'tsho byed gzhan phan mchog sbyin/ 'dul mngon phar tshad dbu ma sdom gsum sde pod chen drug gi steng gsang bdag dgongs rgyan te gzhung tshogs de rnams rig lam nas drangs pa'i bshad sbyangs mthar phyin pa'i dge bshes rab 'byams pa bstan 'dzin gar dbang*/ rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang*/ rab 'byams pa 'phrin las rab 'phel/ rab 'byams pa mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams o rgyan mchog dga'/ rab 'byams pa o rgyan dpal mgon/ bdag kyang de rnams kyi phyogs su gtogs tsam dang bcas pa rnams la dam pa de nyid kyis ding sang grwa pa gzhan la brtags na dge bshes kyi gras 557)da la btags pa dge bshes gras su 'dug ces dbugs dbyung bas mtshon dam pa de'i bka' drin gyis rang gzhan gyi don nus pa'ang mang bar snang ngo*/ ༈ gter ston dang gter gnas zhig gter chen bla ma bzhin thor bkod pa ni/ shel gyi brag phug gsang gter bka' 'dus sbas: lho brag mkho mthing bde gshegs 'dus pa/

mkhar chu gnam skas can la yongs rdzogs/ gtam shul srin mo sbar rjes gsang gter/ gra yi g.yu sgom brag la gter smyon/ mu tig spa ma gong la gsang gter/ zar phu zangs kyi mtsho brag gter phran/ mtshon mkhar mgon po gdong la thugs gter lnga/ nor gter g.yu khrab dbul dang bral ba sbas/ gra phyi brag go che la bod gter/ gra yi sne gdong zur la ral gri/ dol gyi spyi sde'i 558)zur la khrab rmog gzhung gi ra grong rgyab la gser ka sbas/ o dkar brag tu zla ba gnyis/ snying po'i rdza la zla ba gnyis/ dbu rtser lo drug bcu/ mchims phur lo lnga/ yang rdzong lo gsum/ g.ya' ma lung du lo bzhi/ shel brag tu lo gsum/ spa ma gong du lo gnyis/ sham po'i gangs la lo gsum/ mkhar chur lo bdun/ te sgror lo bdun/ yer pa/ chu bo ri lo re/ zab phur lo gnyis/ g.yu sgom brag la zla ba gnis/ rdor 'bum chos grags ni 'khrungs sa mnga' ris pa'o/ yab yum gyis rdor gcod dang 'bum bzhes pa der grags/ sra bdun rtse'i rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon gyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bum pa dang byams sprin nas 'brum bsrung sogs bton/ lha btsun sngon mo ni/ yab yum ba.aratan gyi brgyud po dhi rā dza jo bo rje'i rab byung babs pa'i sras yin/ 559)dbu rtse dang*/ 'on 'jang lha rings sogs nas sman rdzas kyi gter kha 'ga' zhig bton/ ri bo che'i gter sgrub thob dngos grub kyi 'don par gsungs kyang ma mthong*/ lha sa nas ma ṇi bka' 'bum bton pa las gzhan rgyun bzhugs pa ma mthong*/ ra shag ni yar 'brog gnyan du 'khrungs/ sgang shar mdos bcu sogs gter mang*/ dwags sgam sogs dus rtags/ mi las tshe ring ma'i sgrub skor 'di la zhus par nged/ nya grub thob dngos grub dang ra shag gnyis kar thug gter kha ni mang*/ lcags spre gter kha bco brgyad/ rgyal sras pa/ yab dbang phyug rgyal po o rgyan pa gnyal du phebs dus da de lo bcu lnga na khyod la bu khyad par can zhig 'byung zhes lung bstan pa de'o/

lo dror dgung snying glang*/ 560)mkha' 'gro kun dga' 'bum ni 'on gyi bkra shis do mkhar 'khrungs/ tshes bzhi rnying ma grags rgyal gyi grwa pa yin/ de'i slob ma dung mtsho ras pa ni/ dgas po lha rje'i slob ma dung mtsho ras pa'i skye ba yin pas de skad du grags/ kong po mon gnas kyi sgo phyi yang ti yang 'di'i gter/ lhung po ni kong po 'o shod du chu 'brug lo lha sa'i rta mgrin gyi phyag g.yon 'og nas dgon tig rgod ldems ni thang yig nas mi gsal/ la stod byang pa/ me pho rta'i lo'i sbrul zla la gter bton/ o rgyan gling pa grwa yar rjer 'khrungs/ gter kha nyer brgyad tsam bton/ dus rtags phag gis slog ces pa ste te si byung ba/ rdor gling ni grwa grog sked du me khyi la

'khrungs/ khra 'brug gi gter nas brtsams te gter kha zhe gsum bton pa gter bton nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gter byung 561)na gsal/ de nas kyang 'ga' ri bton par snang*/ sras gro bo lung dang dbus kyi bug skad sogs kyang bzung*/ tshe tshu'i snod ni byang thang lcags ru ba la yod 'dug dus rtags sa btsan ri bos re la zhes pa/ 'di dang dus mtshungs rgya mtsho/ dus rtags sing ma la khar/ mon rtse ba yin zer/ gter gnas mu tig sangs gling pa/ kong lo long po gyi ma dgung lo nyer lnga nas so drug yan la gter kha bcu drug bton pa gter byung zhal gsungs mar 'dug de nas kyang 'ga' ri bton par snang*/ bsam gling pa kong po long par 'khrungs/ zhing skyong gi sgrub bskor zhig 'dug kun shangs kyi phur 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco lnga nas gter ston/ gter kha mang*/ da lta ni rdor sems snying thig tsam dar/ rat+na gling dang dus 562)mtshungs/ dri med kun dga' grwa khang dmar du 'khrungs grwa phug pa ba'i slob ma yin/ thugs rje chen po 'od mchog gi rgyun yod/ so gsum la kong por gshegs/ mgon po rin chen ni/ yugs su shud bu'i rigs las 'khrungs/ bcu gsum pa la grub chen phyag rdor pa'i drung du chos sgor zhugs/ mon zangs yag nas gter bzhes/ rat+na gling pas kyang chos gsan/ gya bzhi pa chu rta la gshegs/ gu ru jo rtse dang*/ shud bu chos grags zhes pa mtshan gyi rnams grangs/ gter chos ni pad+ma snying thig sogs/ rat+na gling pa/ gro shul thang dkar du chu lug la 'khrungs/ nyer bdun pa la kha byang rnyed/ sum bcu pa la gter kha dang po nas khyon gter kha zhi shu rtsa lnga bton/ don bzhi pa la zhabs la 'tsher ma zug pa'i rkyen gyis gshegs/ pad+ma gling pa rta lo bum thang 563)du 'khrungs nyi shu rtsa bdun la sna rings brag nas klong gsal bton pa nas bzung*/ gter kha so gnyis bton/ gya bzhi pa chu sbrul hor zla dang po'i tshes gsum la gshegs/

karma gling po sger stod nyi zla sangs rgyas kyi sras su 'khrungs/ byar g.yag mgo'i bcu gcig zhal ni tsā ri nas bton/ thos grol sgam po bdar gyi mtsho nas bton/ bstan gnyis gling pa gtsang bya bzangs su 'khrungs/ chos lung pa'i jo stan skyid tshal du bslob sbyongs mdzad/ dus rtags ni/ yar 'brog mtsho gling dgu la dmag sgar 'cha'/ gter sangs rgyas dgongs 'dus sogs mang*/ mdo sngags ni mchog ldan mgon po ste/ ban pa snab mkhan pa lung nas gter gyi kha byang dang*/ stong ri nyi shar nas gter 'thon/ rdor gling gi gter byung du gter 564)ston rdor gling gis gter kha zhe gsum bton pa'i bcu gsum pa zangs mtsho'i gter ni sa spre zla ba bcu pa la gza' bdud kyis 'don par bskul ba las bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gnyis la gnam lcags kyi kha byang bzhin mtsho gnyis kyi bar brag bya khyung 'dra ba'i dkyil nas mi bdun bcu tsam gyi dbus su 'dom do tsam gyi brag bshags ma rnyed pa'i tshe gter bdag bud med gcig la babs nas lhor ltos nas brkos zer/ de bzhin byas pas la bse'i sgrom bu mtho skor ma gcig gza' bdud kyi sku khru gang khro chu las byas pa gcig po ste gcig shog dril gcig byung*/ der bzhugs nas nang par kha phye bas rdor sems snying thig dang 'bras mo gshongs kyi lam yig rnams spel/ ngan sngags skor gyi shog dril bdun bcu gza'i sku bcas brag rin chen 'dra ba la sbas 565)phyis gter bton gzhan gcig dbang gsung*/ gter kha dgu pa/ lug lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la zangs mtsho'i ri bltas la phyin/ mtsho 'gram nas nyams 'ur/ rgod tshang yod pa'i rtsa na brag lam gyi mtshams nas phug pa mi lnga tsam shong ba cig 'dug de'i nang nas rdo kha sbyar 'dra ba'i nang nas phug pa khru gang pa gcig nag hur re snang*/ de nas zangs kyi sbug ma gcig byung*/ mar lam ma thar bar 'phyongs pas rnying pa'i rjes gcig byung*/

mtshong 'gor zangs sbug de kha phye bas tshe sgrub 'od zer drwa ba dang*/ nyi zla ga'u ma gnyis cha lag bcas byung*/ grub thob me long rdo rjes lo dgu pa la/ grwa phu'i grub thob za lung pa dang*/ mkhan chen se lung pa gnyis las rab tu byung*/ zhing phyed phag mo ra lugs dang in+d+ra bho dhi'i thabs lam 566)zhus/ bcun yan zangs mtshor sgoms pas lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul cher byung*/ phyis chos thams cad stong nyid du rtogs/ bco lnga pa dkri zhal seṅge rgyab tu/ grub zhob za lung pas lung bstan pa bzhin byon/ zla ba bzhi brten/ zla ba gnyis snyung*/ drug lon pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la gshegs/ bco brgyad lon tshe sangs rgyas dbon po rgyal mtshan la snying thig gsan no/ chos 'byung bstan pa'i nyi ma las/ bod kyi skabs nyer gnyis pa'o/ da ni rigs pa nas rgyus cung zad zhig brjod pas bya ste/ de yang mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na/ 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs pa'i rig pa'i gnas smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa sgra dang tshad ma rig pa/ blo ldan rjes su 'dzin par rang nyid kun shes 567)par byar ba nang don rig pa sde lnga las/ de yang thog mar ni/ bzo rig pa 'chad pa skabs su babs te/ bzo rig pa'i yan lag tu rig gnas thams cad 'du ba'i phyir te/ yid dang 'brel ba'i lus kyis g.yo ba la lus bzo dang*/ dag gis brjod pa gtso bor gyur pa la ngag bzor bar te/ de gnyis gang rung dang ma 'brel bar yid kyis bsam pa tsam gyis dbang du byas pa la yid bzor grags shing*/ de gsum du ma 'dus pa'i bzo ni med par grags/ da lta spyi ming bye brag la btags nas bris 'bur ma bzo zhes grags te/ de la bris kyi rgyun 'jig rten du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ sngon mi'i rgyal po 'jigs thul gyis rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs pa las mi rnams tshe lo 'bum du 'phel ba'i dus su/

bram ze zhig gi bu dus min du shi bas/ rgyal pos bram ze 568)gshen rje'i rgyal po'i drung du 'khrid de 'di'i bu phyir gtod par gsol bas/ gshen rje na re/ rang gi las su zad pas bster bar mi nus/ zhes smras pa'i mthar phan tshun g.yul bshams te 'thabs pas 'jig rten thams cad bskrags par gyur pa na/ tshangs pas bar byas te bram ze'i baya ri mor bris pa gson po ji lta ba bzhin bslangs nas bram ze la gtad de 'thab mo bzlum par byas so/ slar rgyal pos tshangs pa'i drung du song nas ri mo 'bri tshul zhus pas/ ri yi mchog ni ri rab yin/ sgong nga la skyes rnams kyis ni/ gtso bo nam mkha' lding yin no/ mi yi gtso bo sa bdag ste/ de bzhin ri mo sgyu rtsal gtso/ zhes bsngags nas lha'i bzo so bi shwa karma lung bstan cing*/ des bzo'i gnas khyad par can bya zhes grags la/ spyir ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus bris kyi rgyun ston pa'i sku brnyan 569)gzugs can snying pos u dra yā na la skyes su bskur ba dang*/ bu mo me tog khri shing gi skyes lan du ras kyi gzhir ri mo ci thob pa'i 'thad du ston pa'i sku las 'od zer bkye ba'i steng ri mos mnan pa'i bris rgyun kha che dang yul dbus su dar bar bshad pa dang*/ byams pas sbyin bdag mdzad de lha'i gzo bos jo bo rin po che'i sku bzhengs pa dang*/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya tsam gyi bar du 'ang me'i bzo bo las kyi 'phrul dang ldan pas sku gzugs sogs kyis dngos su 'phrul pa skye nus pa'i bzo gnas ngo mtshar ba dag byed pa byung la/ de rnams rim gyis nub nas lha'i bzo bo mang po mer sprul nas byang chub chen po sogs ma gha dha'i rten ngo mtshar can brgyad sogs byung bar grags/ phyis rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs kyi dus bim+ba sa ra zhes pas 'bur dang ri mo'i 570)bkod pa lha'i bzo bo dang mthun par byas pa'i lag rgyun nub rnying mar grags pa dang*/

rgyal po dpal ldan chos skyong gi dus dhi mānra zhes pa dang*/ de'i bu bit+pā lo zhes pa gnyis kyis klu'i bzo bo dang mthun par byas pa'i lag rgyun gyi lugs ma rnams la shar gyi lha dang*/ ri mo ni pha'i lag rgyun la shar ris dang*/ bu'i ri mo las dbus kyi ri mor ngos 'dzin/ karmi ra'i yul du phyis ha pu rā dza zhes pas bris 'bur gnyis ka'i bsrol gtod pa la ding sang kha che mar zhes zer ro/ bod yul 'dir ni sngon chos rgyal mes dbon gyis dus bris 'bur gnyis ka rgya bal gyi lag rgyun shas che la/ phyis 'bur bal lha dang bris rgya nag gi ri mo shas che ba byung zhes zer ba ltar de dang de'i lugs bsrol 'dra rung du dar/ rjes su lha bzo la mkhas pa rdo pa bkra shis rgyal zhes pa byung ste/ de la rang las 571)mkhas pa'i slob ma gnyis byung bar/ lho brag sman thang du sman bla don 'grub pa zhes rang gi skye ba sngon ma rgya nag tu 'khrungs dus b.ris pa'i pi thang rgya mdzad chen mor grags pa de gzigs pa tsam gyis sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i skyes bu zhig dang*/ gong dkar dgar stod nas byung ba'i/ zhes pa ste/ snga mas mdo rgyud rnams dang bstun pa'i yig cha yang mdzad cing tshugs chen brgyad la sha tshugs re dang*/ na bza' rgyan sprod re bcas bcu drug gis gtan la phab pa'i sman lugs dang*/ de dang lugs bsrol mi 'dre tsam pa'i mkhyen lugs zhes so so'i bzhed pas lugs bsrol 'dzin pa ding sang gi bar dar rgyas su yod pa 'di yin cing*/ gzhan yang*/ yan lag tu sangs rgya cher rol 572)bzang lug phran tshogs kyi 'brel pa sogs las gsung ba'i sgyu rtsal drug bcu rtsa bzhi/ bye brag rtogs byas las 'byung ba'i bzor gtogs pa sum btsu/ rol mi'o bye brag bco brgyad/ glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/

gar gyi cha byad dgu/ mdo sde las bshad pa'i bzo sbyang bco brgyad brtag pa rnams pa brgyad rnams pas/ dang rtsal drug bcu rtsa bzhi ni/ slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa las/ rol mo'i mtshan nyid sgyu ma dang*/ 'gyed stobs dang ni me tog las/ g.yos su bya ba rnal 'byor nges/ tshong dang nor ni bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyan dang lag rtsis bcud kyi len/ 'phrul 'khor sbyor dang dri ba dang*/ 'phongs byad dang ni 'chi sbyor sgra/ yi ge dang ni kha skad dang*/ rang rang bzo dag mtshon rnams brtag gcod thabs dang ni sogs le dang*/ phub rnams bskor bar byed pa dang*/ song 573)dang 'ong ba shes pa dang*/ gzhi yi mtshan nyid shes pa dang*/ mdung dang rdo rje brtag pa dang*/ thangs kyi tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ zug tu 'byarin dang mig 'phrul dang*/ bha ra ta yi bstan bcos shes/ bcings dang khang pa brtsigs ma dang*/ de bzhin gso kyi 'phang ba dang*/ yan lag mnye dang mo 'debs dang*/ de bzhin chu yi kun 'dzin dang*/ dung gi sgra dang sdeb sbyor dang*/ grong brdal dang ni glegs 'dra dang*/ mtshan mo chom rkun shes pa dang*/ sgra dang sa rtog byer pa dang*/ skyes pa bud me rta dang ni glang po mtshan nyid gar slog dang*/ 'byung po dag ni gso ba dang*/ zangs ma mkhar ba gser dag dang*/ shing dang dung dang shes pa dang*/ ri mo mtshan dang gso dag ni/ las rnams de dag go rim bzhin/ skar ma'i gtan rtsis shes pa dang*/ mtshan ma shes 574)pa nyid dang yang*/ nges pa'i tshig gi gzhung rnams kyis/ sgyu rtsal drug bcu rtsa bzhi dran/ zhes bshad do/ gnyis pa bzo pa gsum ni/ bye brag rtogs byed las/ yi ge/ lag rtsis/ grangs/ rtsis chen/ thor tshugs/ goms stabs/ lcags kyus thabs/ ril gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdabs pa/ mda' bo che ba 'phen pa/ mdun du brdzur ba/ phyir brdzur ba/ bcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/ sgyang nas/ 'phogs pa/ gnad du 'phogs pa/

mi tshor bar 'phog pa/ tshabs che bar 'phog pa/ mchong ba/ gyad kyi 'dzin ltangs/ bang*/ rkyal brgal ba/ glang pa che'i gnyar zhon pa/ rta la zhon pa/ shing rta'i thabs/ mda'/ gzhu/ gyad stabs dang sum bcu'o/ gsum pa rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad ni gar gzhan dang*/ bro dang 575)dun+du bhi zhes pa rnga bo che dang*/ mṛ daṃl ga sde rdza rnga 'am rnga zlum mam yang na lpags pas kha g.yogs pa/ rnga pa ṭa ha'i rdza rnga chen por grags pa dang*/ rnga phran dang*/ dha mak+ka ni bhe ri ste rnga chen dang*/ pa ṇa wa ste mkhar rnga dang*/ pi waṃ rgyud gcig pa dang*/ dzha dzha ra ni sgra'i khyad par yongs su 'gyur ba byed pa rdza rnga kha gcig pa ste ka ra rnga ka zhes kyang zer ro/ lcags kyi sil khrol dang*/ pā mya ni zhes mkhar ba'i sil khrol dang*/ bal+la kī zhes pi waṃ rgyud gsum pa dang*/ rnga mu kun+da dang*/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa dang*/ tā la zhes pheg tog ste cha lang dang*/ gzhan yang tṛ ṇa tsa se ṭa dang go mu ṇa dang hu duk+kar la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra'i rigs dang*/ wi ṇa zhes pi waṃ spyi'i rigs sam mi'am ci'i sogs kyi sil snyan 576)rgyas pa'i pi waṃ dang*/ waṃ sha zhes gling bu dang bco brgyad do/ bzhi pa glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ 'dod 'jo las/ rgyud las byung ba dang mgrin pa las byung ba'i sgra ni 'khor nyan la sogs pa'i dbyangs mun te/ zhes pa'i don ni/ thub pa mis byin bus/ drug skyes rma bya'i sgra ltar sgrog khyu mchog ba lang skad kyis rtsoms/ dri 'dzin skyes ni ra yi skad/ bar ma khrung khrung sgra sgrogs bzhin lnga pa me tog rgyas dus su/ khu byug sgrogs pa lta bu ste/ blo gsal rta skad lta bur 'tsher/ 'khor nyan glang po sgrogs pa bzhin/ zhes 'byung*/ de rnams dus dang gang che blang ba ni/ sngon gyi gtsug lag las/ rtsed mo rlom par blang ba ni/ lnga pa dang ni bar ma'i dbyangs/ dpa' bo drag po ngo mtshar du/

drug skyes khyu mchog de bzhin no/ sa 'dzin pa dang 'khor nyan dbyangs/ snying 577)rje'i rol la blang bar bya/ 'thab mo 'jigs dang bcas pa la/ blo gsal dbyangs ni blang bar bya zhes slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes lang gshegs kyi gleng gzhi'i 'grel par drangs pa ltar/ gzhon nu ma'i tshogs dang rtse zhing rol ba dang rlom sems pa'i tshul dang mthun par bstan pa'i tshe lnga pa khu byug gi sgra lta bu dang bar pa khrung khrung gi skad ltar blang ngo*/ gzhan yang drag po'i tshul gyis gzhan tshar gcod pa dang ngo mtshar gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshe/ de dang mthun pa drug skyes rma bya'i skad lta bu dang khyu mchog ba glang gi skad ltar blang ngo*/ yang snying rje'i nyams dang ldan pa'i tshe de dang mthun par sa 'dzin nam dri 'dzin te ra'i skad lta bu dang 'khor nyan glang po'i sgra ltar blang ngo*/ rtsod pa'i 'khor lo shom pa lta bu 'thab mo 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i tshe/ de dang mthun pa'i glu 578)blo gsal zhes pa cang shes rta'i skad 'tsher ba ltar blang bar bya ba yin no/ de la sogs pa'i glu dbyangs kyi rnam pa mang po drang srong bha ra ta dang bi sha khi la'i gzhung las bshad ces 'byung zhing*/ gzhanu yang dbyangs bdun grong gsum dang*/ rgyal ba nyi shu rtsa gcig dang ta na bzhi bcu dgu rnams te/ dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor de tsam mo/ zhes kyang 'byung zhes bshad do/ lnga pa gar gyi byad shṛṅga ra zhes pa sgeg pa ni/ bud med dang bskyed tshal sogs la rtse zhing rol ba longs spyod kyi 'byor pa dang ngo mtshar ba'i lhad mo mthong bas dga' ba'i 'byor ba myongs ba'i 'chor sgeg ste/ mchog gi rang bzhin mang po can/ de ni skyes pa bud med rgyu/ longs spyod dang ni ltad mo ste/ sgeg pa rnams pa gnyis su 'dod/ ces 'dod 'jor drangs so/ wī ra zhes pa dpa' ba ni/ sbyin pa dang chos dang*/ 579)g.yul las dpa' ba ste spro ba'i bdag nyid can no/

ka ru ṇa zhes pa snying rje ni/ 'dod pa nyams pa dang nor nyams pa sogs sdug bsngal gyis nyer bar gdung pa la skyes pa'i nyams so/ ar+bhu ta zhes pa smad byung ngo rngam pa ni/ yul bzang po dang 'phrul pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs mthong bas snying la 'dod pa'i 'byor pa thob pa las byung ba'o/ hā pya zhes pa rgod pa ni sba bar bya ba'i gnas mthong ba'am tshogs su sgrogs par mi 'os pa thos pa sogs kyis rgod bro ba'i nyams so/ bhā ma na ga zhes pa 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams ni/ srin po dang stag gzig sogs mthong ba'am mi bzad pa'i sga thos pas skrag pa la sogs las skyes pa'i nyams so/ bī bhat+pa zhes mi sdug pa'i nyams ni/ gzugs ngan pa dang sha rul ba sogs smad pa'i gnas mthong thos pas skyug bro ba'i 580)nyams skyes pa'o/ ro ro dra zhes pa drag shul gyi nyams ni/ lus ngag gi spyod pa drag pos spyod cing brdeg pa sogs kharo ba nye bar sdud pa'i nyams so/ shān+ta zhes pa zhi ba'i nyams ni/ dka' thub dang brtul zhugs la sogs pa'i bdag nyid la phan pa'i rgyun byed pa ste/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyi rjes su 'jug go zhes 'byung ngo*/ de ltar yang rin chen mdzod las/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ drag shul rgod dag 'jigs su rung*/ snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ de rnams gar gyi nyams dgu'o zhes gsungs/ drug pa mdo sde la/ bshad pa'i bzo skyang bco brgyad ni/ tshogs pa dang*/ rdza mkhan dang*/ chang tshong dang*/ phyugs btso ba dang*/ 'dreg mkhan dang*/ 'bru mar 'tsher ba dang*/ mgar ba dang*/ shing mkhan dang phywa mkhan dang*/ tha ga pa dang*/ ko lpags mkhan dang*/ rkyal chen pa dang*/ btso lag mkhan dang*/ smyig ma mkhan dang*/ bshan 581)pa dang*/ gdol pa mkhan dang*/ shing rta mkhan te bco brgyad do/ bdun pa brtag pa rnam pa brgya ni/ rin po che brtag pa/ sa gzhi/ gos/ ljon shing*/ rta/ glang po/ skyes pa/ bud med brtag pa ste brgyad do/

gzhan yang nang gi sgyul rtsal bcu rtsa nas kyang sen mos 'brad dang pos 'debs dang*/ 'khyud pa dang ni thang sbyar dang*/ bya ba dang ni lag pas gdam/ sgra yi bye brag dang dang ni/ skyes pa'i steng du nyul dang brgyad/ re re la'ang brgyad brgyad de/ drug bcu rtsa bzhir shes par bya/ zhes bshad pa la sogs mtha' yas so/ ༈ gnyis pa pa bsad pa de yang legs par sbyar ba'i skad du/ ā yu sbad deḥ zhes tshe dang srog dang 'tsho ba rnams don gcig la ming gi rnams grangs yin pas/ 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi khams na drong dang rnam par shes 582)pa'i rten gnyis ka byed pa dang*/ gzugs med na rnams par shes pa'i rten kho na byed pas na tshe'i rig byed de/ bi tsi ka ni zhes pas gso ba'i dpyad ces bshad cing*/ de'ang khams kun gyi 'du ba mi snyoms pa gsal nas mnyam par bya ba'i phyir rnam dpyad yin pas gso dpyad ces bya ba dang*/ tsi kirba rgyā ste gso ba rig pa/ de la gso bya nad dang nad pa/ gso thabs sman dang dpyad/ gso ba po nad g.yog dang sman pa/ zhes don gsum du bsdu ba'am/ yang na sman pa dang nad pa/ nad g.yog dang sman te bzhi la skyon bzhi bzhi spangs pa'i yon tan bzhi bzhi ldan pa ste/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ gso ba dag tu bstan pa ni/ sman pa sman dang nad g.yog dang*/ nad pa yan lag rnam bzhi ste/ re re'ang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la gso ba'i rig pa 'di ji ltar 583)ba'i khung la bzhi ste/ dang po sangs kyis gsungs tshul ni/ bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo las/ chos 'khor gnas dang yangs pa can/ sa dkar can dang lha yi gnas/ byis pa gsod dang ko ko sham+bhi/ 'brog gnas mchod rten ri dang ni 'od ma'i grong dang sgrar bcas dang*/ ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer du/ 'di rnams su ni thub pa yi/ skyes mtshog lo re lo re bzhugs nyi shu rtsa gsum mnyan yod du/

sman gya nags su lo bzhi ste/ 'bar ba'i phub kyi gnas su gnyis/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du lnga/ dka' ba spyad pa lo drug ste/ nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu gnas/ rgyal ba de dag brgyad bcu la/ zhes pas sman gyi nags tshal gyi dbus rag pa'i zhing sprul pa'i grong khyer lta na sdug ces ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang du ston pa shākya'i 584)rgyal pos sman gyi bla be zur+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i skur bzhengs nas/ sku gsum thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rigs lnga 'i rang mdangs las shar ba'i drang srong lngas zhu ma zhu lan gyi tshul du thun mongs dang thun mongs ma yin pa'i 'khor rnams la rtsa rgyud gsungs pa drang srong yid las skyes pa'i gser gyis lnga shog la bai zur+ya zhun ma'i khu bas bris pa'i glegs bam 'di nyid gsang ba'i tshul gyis rgya gar du zab brgyud las byings la cher ma dar bar grags/ ston pas thor bur gsungs pa ni/ 'khor lo dang po'i dus su/ dge slong nad pa ni sman pa la bris te bya'o zhes sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mngon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs skabs/ dge slong rnams ston ka'i bro nad kyis mnar ba la/ kun dga' bo la rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong rnams kyis sman rnam pa bzhi dus su rung ba dang*/ 585)thun tshod du rung ba dang*/ zhag bdun pa dang*/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bzang ba sogs 'dul ba sman gyi gzhi gsung*/ 'khor lo bar pa'i skabs su lha chen po tshangs pa la/ gcer mthong rig pa'i rgyud chen po le'u sum stong lnga brgya pa'am/ gso dpyad 'bum par grags pa gsungs shing*/ 'khor lo tha ma'i skabs su tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bebs la mdo sde gser 'od dam pa bka' bstsal ba las/ zla gsum dbyar te zla gsum ston du shes/ zhes sogs gsung dus/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams su/ lus chags tshul dang*/ de'i khams 'khrugs pas nad bskyed tshul/

de la phan pa'i phyi nang gi dpyad rgyas par gsungs pa rnams so/ khyad par 'phags pa'i yul du shing rta'i bsrol 'byed slob po dpa' bsam yan lag brgyad pa chen po dang*/ de'i snying po bsdus pa sogs 586)mdzad/ de la kha che zla dgas 'grel pa zla zer mdzad ci dar ro/ gnyis pa lha las brgyud tshul ni/ ji skad du/ snyan tshig mchod sbyin srid srung dang*/ nges brjod yan lag bzhi zhes bya/ zhes pa mes po tshangs pa'i zhal bzhi las byung ba'i tshul te gang phyir tshangs pa yi ni zhal dbus ma nas ni tshe'i rig byed/ snyan tshig nges brjod mchod sbyin rnams/ zhal gzhan las ni gsung bar mdzad/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ sngon lha min stobs ldan gyis ri rab kyi bsrubs shing klu'i rgyal po gnyis kyis bsrubs thag byas nas phyi'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las zla nyi dug bdud rtsi sogs byung ba'i dus dbyugs gis bdud rtsi 'thung bas mgrin pa sngon por song*/ tshangs pas bdud rtsi khyer ba la sgra gcan gyis khyab mjug gi lag na zho 'thung gi rus pa las bi shwa karma 587)bzos pa'i nyi ma brdar ba'i 'khor lo yod pa de brjun pas dpral ba'am 'khur tshos snad pas yun ring du brgyal/ de las gsos te dran pa rnyed nas phan pa'i thabs bsam pas sngon sangs rgyas la sman gyi rgyud thos pa rnams dran cing rma nang nas tshe'i rig byed kyi thog mar/ oṃ a tha/ zhes 'thon pa la brten nas tshe'i rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa byung ste/ zla zer las/ yi ge oṃ dang a tha'i sgra/ gnyis po 'di dag sngon tshangs pa'i/ mkhur tshos brdol nas byung ba ste/ des na 'di dag bkris yin/ zhes so/ de ltar tshangs pas rang gi nad gsos shing*/ skye dgu'i bdag po la bstan/ des skar ma tha skar gyi bu ris med nga lhar bcas gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la brtan te lha'i drang 588)srong du ma la brgyud do/ gsum pa rgya gar du dar tshul ni/

ston pa bzhugs pa'i dus rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i zur bu chung bar rag gi phu bo gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis gsos pas/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos zhes/ mi'i drang srong rgyun shes kyi slob ma ste/ 'dul lung gi gso gzhi'i skabs las/ thub pa snyun gso'i sman gyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par 'byung zhing*/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ gso rig la sbyor ba brgya pa dang*/ 'tsho ba'i mdo tshigs su bcad pa rtswa a wa'i cho ga dngul chu'i sbyor ba rin chen 'phreng ba rnams mdzad cing*/ de'i slob ma dpa' bos gong du bshad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa dang de la kha chi zla dgas zla zer la sogs pa'i 'grel pa mdzad cing dar bar mdzad do/ pa gangs 589)can bod kyi yul 'dir ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ sngon chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis dam pa chos kyi bsrol gtod pa'i skabs/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mngon dga' dang*/ lo chen bai ro tsa nas bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud sogs bsgyur bshad mdzad ces 'byung zhing*/ gang ltar yang sangs rgyas byang sems dang lha mi'am drang srong rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sman gzhung rgya gar rgya nag hor ge sar gyi yul rnams nas lo chen bai ro tsā na la sogs pas bod du bsgyur ba dang*/ yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel rin chen bzang pos bsgyur bshad kyis gtan la phab cing*/ de la brten nas ston pa sman gyi bla dang dbyer ma mchis pa g.yu thog pa yon tan mgon pos/ nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i rgyud bzhi spel te dar ba 590)yin te/ sman gyi bla mas lung bstan par/ dang po'i dus su karma dri med dang*/ bar du gzhon nu 'jig med grags pa yin/ da lta g.yu thog yon tan mgon por grags/ 'di nas sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi tshog dbon byed/

de nas lnga brgya tha ma'i dus babs la/ nga yi gsung sprul skyes bu dam pa khyed/ yon tan mgon po zhes bya 'byug zhing 'byon/ zhes gsungs so/ ༈ rigs gnas gdum pa sgra'i rig pa ni/ ji skad du/ gang zhig shes na mkhas pa'i gnas thob cing*/ mthar thug kun mkhyen go 'phang bde blag bgrod/ rig gnas kun la togs med 'jug pa'i sgo/ brda sprod rig gnas/ zhes mngags pa ltar/ brjod bya'i don brjod byed sgra'i bstan bcos shes dgos te/ daṇ+ḍi'i tshig rgyan las/ skye bo bstan bcos mi shes pas 591)yon tan skyon dag ji ltar dbye/ gzugs kyi dbye ba mdigs pa'i skabs/ long ba dag la yod dam ci/ zhes gsungs/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ smra ba kun la 'jug par/ zin pa dang ni ma zin dang*/ gnyis ka dag las byung ba'i sgra/ sems can ston dang mi ston dag lung du ston dang mi ston pa'o/ zhes pas spyir sgra ni/ zin pa dang*/ ma zin pa dang gnyis ka las byung ba'am/ yag na sems can du mi ston pa dang ston pa gnyis la/ mi ston pa'i sgra rnams la yang*/ skad kyi byings dang*/ rig pa dang*/ dus dang*/ ming du gdags pa bzhi'i sgo nas brtags na sems can du ston par

'gyur ba'ang yod par bshad de/ smra ba kun la 'jug pa la/ 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu smin pa ni/ dri ma med pa'i chu la lhungs/ nya yis bza' ba'i phyir du ni/ 'gu lu 'gu lu zhes su smra/ zhes gsungs so 592)'dir ni zin pa sems can du ston cing tshig tu lhung ba'i sgo nas lung du ston pas na byā ka ṇa zhes lung du ston pa'am brda sprod pa zhes grags/ de'i brjod bya thun mongs pa ni tshogs pa gsum ldan te/ smra ba rgyan gyi me tog las/ ngo bo tsam dang khyad par ston/ de gnyis brten du gyur pa ni/ ming dang tshig dang yig ge yin/ zhes pas/ yi ge dang ming dang*/ tshig gi tshogs pa'o/ 'di gsum mngon pa'i lugs ltar na phan tshun 'gal ba can yin te/ slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mngon pa phung po lnga'i bshad par/ don gyi ngo bo brjod pa ming*/ de yi khyad par ston pa tshig gang yang mi ston yi ge'o/ zhes gsungs pas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa ming*/ de'i khyad par ston pa tshig gang yang mi ston pa'i 'bru ni yi ge'o/ sgra pa'i lugs la de gsum mi 'gal ba'i skabs srid de/ ni pā ta'i skabs 593)su a i u rnams yig ge yin te dbyangs yig yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ming yin te/ a khyab 'jug i bdud/ u dbang phyug rnams kyi ming yin pa'i phyir/ tshig yin te/ ming rnam dbye'i mtha' can yin pa'i phyir ro/ de la yi ge ni/ brjod 'dod kyis kun nas blangs pas/ gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams 'phrad pa las/ skyes pa'i skad gdangs 'ba' zhig pa ste/ dpang los/ brjod 'dod dbang gis rlung g.yos shing*/ de yi gnas dang byed pa dang*/ rtsol ba bskyed dang dbugs dbyungs dang*/ lhan cig yi ge'i gdangs rnams skyes/ zhes pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi ni/ ā li dang*/ kā li'i yi ge yin la de yang rgya nag gi yul dang*/ me nyag la sogs la yi ge'i tshogs pa med pas yig gzugs la thug pa med cing*/

rgya bal 594)dang bod yul sogs su yi ge dbyangs gsal gnyis su bsdus te bshad pas ming tshig gsar du byung kyang yi ge sbyor ba la dka' ba med do/ ming ni yi ge 'dus pa las byung ba'i brjod bya'i don gyi ngo bo tsam brjod par byed pa'i sgra spyir snang ba ste/ ka ba dang bum pa zhes pa lta bu'o/ de ltar yang*/ yi ge gnyis sam mang lus pas/ don gyi ngo bo brjod byed pa/ ming yin don la blo gzhol phyir/ zhes so/ dbye na/ dang por brda sbyar ba dngos ming dang*/ gra 'brel gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas byis brda sbyar ba brtags ming ngo*/ tshig ni/ ming du 'dus pa las byung ba/ don gyi khyad par ston pa'i sgra spyir snang ba ste/ tsan+dan gyi ka ba'am/ gser gyi bum pa zhes pa lta bu'o/ khyad par sgra pa'i lugs la/ a ma ra ko ṇa las/ brjod byed bstan bcos sgra la ni/ 595)pusta dang ting gi mtha' can tshig ces so/ yang brda sprod pa'i lugs kyi brjod bya thun mongs ma yin pa ni/ rang bzhin dang*/ rkyen dang*/ rnam 'gyur gsum gyis bsdus te/ brda sprod snying po gsal ba las/ rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur rnams/ brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ zhes so/ de la rang bzhin ni/ rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su sgrub par bya ba'i gzhir gyur pa ste/ rang bzhin bying dang mi de yang*/ thog ma'i rang bzhin bya ba'i don/ rtags gsum dbyangs dang gsal byed mtha'/ zhes pas thog ma'i rang bzhin ni byings te/ bya ba'i don zhes kyang bya zhing*/ dbye na gsum ste/ bh+yu yod pa la'o zhes byings mdo le'u dgu pa nas bshad pa rnams ni glegs bam las byung ba'i byings dang*/ kun bshad le'u 596)gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i san sogs bdun gyi mtha' can ni/ rkyen gyis bcos pa'i byings dang*/ dzū mdo'i byings sogs sgra mdo'i zur nas rnyed pa rnams la mdo'i byings zhes zer ro/ rang bzhin gnyis pa ming ni/

sgra pa'i lugs 'dir rtags su grags te byings dang rnam dbye bor ba'i don dang ldan pa ni rtags so/ zhes pas byings la kṛr rkyen byin zhing rnam dbye ma byin pa'i bar skabs kyi sgra'i yan lag zhig la ngos 'dzin zhing*/ dbye na/ pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum po so ba dang thun mongs pa ste ming gzhi zhes bya ste bṛk+ṣa lta bu dbyangs kyi mtha' dang*/ bidhur lta bu gsal byed kyi mtha' can gnyis su 'dus so/ gnyis pa rkyen ni/ sgra'i rang bzhin gnyis ming tshig byings gsum gang rung sgrub par byed pa'i sgra'i yan lag la rkyen zhes bya ste/ kun bshad las/ rkyen la mtshan nyid 597)rang bzhin rnam 'gyur du/ sgrub par byed pa sgram yi yan lag yin/ zhes so/ kṛta rkyen dang uṇa sogs byings rtags su sgrub pa'i rkyen/ ti sogs byings tshig tu sgrub pa'i rkyen/ yin dag a yi ma gtogs pa'i pan sogs byings byings su sgrub pa'i rkyen/ bud med las a las a'o/ zhes sogs rtags rgas su sgrub pa'i rkyen te/ ming las rang dang 'brel ba yi/ ming gzhan sgrub pa de phan te/ zhes ming ming du sgrub par byed pa de phan yin dang*/ ā yi sogs rtags byings su sgrub pa'i rkyen/ si sogs rgas tshig tu sgrub pa'i rkyen dang bdun yod la/ de las kyang si sogs dang ti sogs ni rkyen dang rnam dbye'i gzhi mthun te/ snga mas ming tshig tu sgrub pa'i sgo nas don rnams par 'byed pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi mas byings tshig tu sgrub pa'i sgo nas 598)dus dag don rnams par 'byed pa'i phyir ro/ gsum pa rnams 'gyur ni/ dpang pos/ rang bzhin rkyen dang 'brel ba'am/ yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba yi/ bsgyur dang dbye ba rnams 'gyur te/ zhes pas/ ming le/ kun bshad/ kṛta rnams su bshad pa'i bsgyur ba dang dbye ba rnams ni/ rang bzhin rkyen dang 'brel ba'i rnam 'gyur yin la/ mtshams sbyor las bshad pa'i bsgyur dbye rnams ni yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba'i rnam 'gyur ro/

de dag ston pa'i gzhung lugs kyang*/ in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa/ bi sha li byā ka ra ṇa/ sho ko da ya/ byā ka ra ṇa pā ṇi byā ka ṇa/ su man+ta bha dra byā ka ra ṇa/ pa rañdza li byā ka ra ṇa/ ma nu dzen+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa/ zhes pa ṇi pa'i 'grel bar grangs la/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa spyi la grags par/ pa ṇi byā ka ra ṇa/ 'jam dpal gyi byā ka ra ṇa/ ka lā ba dang*/ tsan+d+ra pa/ dbyangs 599)can byā ka ra ṇa rnams la in+d+ra/ byā ka ra ṇa ma gtogs bod du 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par ka tsan+dan gnyis ni gangs can gyi rmongs mun sel ba la nyi zla zung 'brel lta bu gyur pa yin ni/ de ltar sgra rig pa ji ltar byung ba'i khung la bzhi las/ so 'phags pas gsungs tshul ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis so sor yang dag rig pa bzhi'i nang nas gsum pa nges tshig 'chad pa'i dus dang*/ rnga bo che'i mdor/ rang bzhin rkyen rnam 'gyur rnams dang*/ de dag gi nyer mkho'i ming dang cha lag kyang mchon te gsungs shing*/ byang sems 'phags pas gsungs pa ni/ dus 'akaur 'brel chen las/ 'jam dpal gyis rang gi lung ston pa las bris pa zhes 'jam dpal byā ka ra ṇa bstan pa dang*/ pa ṇi pa dang dbyangs can ma gnis kyang byang 'phags kyis gsungs par 600)grangs na legs te/ snga ma ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bram ze pā ṇi pa la gsung pa yin la/ phyi ma 'phags ma dbyangs can mas a nu bhū ti la dngos su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ yul du dar tshul ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum du sarba dzñā zhes pa'i sgra mkhan mkhas pa zhig byung ste/ des sgra'i bstan bcos chen po byas pa lha'i yul du dar zhes grags/ de la brgya byin gyis bslab des sgra mkhan phur bu la bshad nas/ phur bu lha rnams kyi slob dpon du bskos te/ de'i tshe phur bu nga rgyal che bas lha rnams kyis brten dka' ba na/ brgya byin gyis chu bum las ku sha'i rtses thigs pa blangs te/ sgra yi bstan bcos rgya mtsho tsam kho bos shes pa bum pa gang tsam/

khyod kyis shes pa chu thigs tsam/ zhes smras pas phur bu yid chad de sgra mi ston dam bcas na/ dbang 601)pos/ rang gi ji tsam shes pa ston cig ces bsgos pas rang sbyong ba'i ched du dus gnyan bzhi bsrungs nas lha gzhan la bstan pas sgra mkhan nam lha'i bla ma zhes grags so/ gsum pa rgya gar du dar tshul ni/ pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa 'jig rten du ma phebs gong du sgra sbyor dum ka bsags nas sbyong ba las gcig tu bsdebs pa'i bstan bcos med par grags/ de nas bram ze pā ṇis sa stengs kyis sgra mkhan thams cad la tig pa bslab/ khyad par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sgrub pas 'grub ste/ 'phags pas yi ge bsdu ba gsungs pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gsum na yod pa'i sgra'i gnas thams cad khong du chud de/ pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa zhes sho lo ka nyis stong lnga brgya yod par grags/ de'i 'og tu gzhon nu kāt+ti kas bram ze pasta warma la bstan pa kā li pa dang*/ 602)slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis pā ṇi pa'i don 'grel du tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa mdzad/ de rjes mkhas pa sgo drug dang dus mtshungs par sgra dbyangs lha mos a nu bhū ti las dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa gsung pa yin no/ bzhi pa bod du 'gyur tshul ni/ shod dpang gnyis kyis ka tsan dang*/ chos skyong bzang pos 'jam dpal gyi byā ka ra ṇa/ jo nang lo tsā phyis mas dbyangs can ma 'dar los de la 'gyur bcos dang pā ṇi pa la gzhi 'gyur mdzad pa yin no/ rig gnas bzhi pa tshad ma rig pa ni/ kun las btus las/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed/ sgrub pa dag ni bsrun 'byin ngag ltar snang bcas pa gzhan rtogs byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad de/ mngon sum/ rjes dpag sgrub ngag thal 'gyur bzhi po re re la yang*/ yang dag dang ltar snang gnyis 603)gnyis su phye ba'i phyir ro/ de'ang bsdu na/ rang gis gzhal bya rtogs pa'i thabs dang*/

rtogs nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs te gnyis su 'du shing*/ de yang tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ zhes pas tshad ma'i don ni mi bslu ba ste/ rang gi gzhal bya la ma 'khrul ba'i 'jal byed zhig la 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na bre tshad dang srang tshad bzhin no/ gzhal bya la gsum ste/ mngon 'gyur/ lkog gyur/ shin tu lkog gyur ro/ de dag 'jal byed ni/ gzhal bya mngon gyur 'jal byed la mngon sum bzhi ste/ dbang po/ yid/ rang rig rnal 'byor mngon gsum dang bzhi'o/ lkog gyur mjal byed dang sgrub byed ni/ dngos stobs rjes dpag gi rten gtan tshig gsum ste/ chos bcu pa'i mdor/ du ba las ni mer shes dang*/ chu skyar las ni chur shes ltar/ thub sems dpa' 604)blo ldan gyis/ rigs ni tshad ma dag las shes/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bras bu'i gtan tshig dang*/ rnam 'grel du/ cung zad skye ba'i mtshan nyid can/ gang de thams cad dgag chos can/ zhes pa lta bu rang bzhin gyi gtan tshig dang*/ tshad ma rnams ni mi 'jug pa/ med la mi 'jug 'bras bu can/ gtan tshig bye brag la ltos nas/ 'ga' zhig mi shes 'bras bu can/ zhes pa lta bu ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshig rnams so/ gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur gyi gtan tshig ni/ mngon sum dang dngos stob kyi gtan tshigs gnyis kas mi 'grub pa'i phyir dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung nyid la rten nas rtogs dgos pa yin no/ de ltar tshad ma rig pa ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus ma gsum las dang pa sangs rgyas kyis gsung tshul ni/ dge slong dag mig gi rnam par shes pas sngon po shes kahayi sngon po'i snyam du ni ma yin no/ zhes pa'i 605)sngon po shes kyi zhes pas yan lag gis mang 'khrul ba'i rig pa de bstan/ sngon po'am snyam du na ma yin no zhes pas rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de bstan pas mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid gsal bar gsungs/ yang*/ dge slong dag gzugs shes pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/

mig dang yid la brten pa'o/ zhes pa'i mig dang zhes pas dbang mngon dang*/ yid la brten pa'o zhes pa yid mngon/ sems las sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ zhes pas rang rig mngon sum/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cig dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa/ ces pas rnal 'byor mngon sum ste/ de ltar mngon sum bzhi ka dang rjes dpag gi brten gtan tshig gsum ka mdo las gsungs tshul sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ gnyis 606)ston pa nas brgyud de dgra bcom pa chos skyobs/ des paṇa chen me waṃ ga des mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen la gsungs shing*/ des gzhon nu'i dus su rtso grub tu grags pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ dbyig gnyen la rang mkhas kyi slob ma bzhi byung ba'i tshad ma rang la mkhas pa ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ de la 'jam dpal gyis dngos su dbugs phyungs nas brtsams pa tshad ma mdo dang*/ de'i dgongs 'grel du phyogs glang gi slob ma dbang phyug sde la/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas gsan nas tshad ma sde bdun mdzad de/ rgyas pa rnam 'grel/ 'bring rnam nges/ bsdus pa rig thig ste gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang*/ de las 'phros pa bzhi ni/ rang don rjes dpag las 'phros pa gtan tshig thigs pa dang 'grel pa brtag pa/ gzhan don rjes dpag las 'phros pa 607)rgyud gzhan grub pa dang*/ rtsod rig ste yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi'o/ gsum pa bod du 'gyur tshul 'grel rnam nges 'grel chen dang bcas pa bsgyur cing*/ khyad par rngog lo chen pos gsar 'gyur bcos du ma mdzad nas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ bla ma 'grel ni rnam nges la rtsos nas rgyan ma nub tsas nas pa las/ phyis tshos rje paṇ+ḍi tas rtsal du bton nas bsgyur bshad kyis gtan 'phab/ 'phags pa rin chen gsang phur rnam 'grel gyi tshad rgyags sbyar ba sogs kyis shin tu dar rgyas su gyur pa yin no/

rig gnas nang rig thig pa gsum du grags shing grub/ ces pa ltar/ brjod bya'i dbang du byas na thag pa gsum mam dgu ste/ de la theg pa gsum ni/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems kyi theg pa dang gsum 608)mo/ yang na dgongs 'dus las/ don dam nges pa'i theg pa ni/ gsum du nges par bstan pa ste/ kun 'byung 'dren dang dka' thub rig dbang bsgyur thabs kyi thig pa'o/ zhes gsungs/ theg pa dgu ni/ gsum po de re re la'ang gsum gsum du dbye ba ste/ nyan rang byang sems gsum la mtshan nyid sde gsum mo kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa dang*/ kṛ ya/ u pa yo ga gsum la/ dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa zhes phyi rgyud sde gsum dang*/ ma hā yo ga a nu yo ga a ti yo ga gsum la dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa zhes nang rgyud gsum mo/ de thams cad kyang gzhi chos nyid ris med la/ so so'i dbang po'i rtogs tshul gyis lta ba la dmigs nas thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gsum la brtson pas/ rang rang gi 'dod pa'i grub 'bras rnam grol gyi rim pa mi bslu bar 609)thob pa zhig yin no/ brjod bu+ed kyi dbang du byas na theg dman dang theg chen gyi dbye bas gnyis so/ bslab pa gsum la ltos nas gsum ste/ lhag pa tshul khrim gyi bslab pa gtso bo ston pa 'dul ba'i sde snod/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mngon pa'i sde snod dang gsum ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ 'o na gsang sngags kyi rgyud de rnams sde snod gsum gang du bsdu zhe na/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi ma la sogs mngon pa'i sde snod du bzhed pa dang*/ shān+ti pa sogs zab mo'i don mdor bsdus te ston pas mdo sde'o zhes mdo sder bsdu ba sogs la'ang 'gal ba ma mchis 'dra yang mkhas pa spyi'i bzhed pa 610)ltar na sde snod bzhi'am rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces rkang thub gcig tu 'dren par mdzad de/

kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud thams cad 'dul ba'i snying por gsungs pa ni/ sde snod bzhi pa nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ zhes pa dang dgongs pa mthun no/ de la gyi sgra don ni/ mdo sde'i sde snod la sku zhes mgor smos par 'gyur te/ rgyal po'i khab na zhes pa lta bu gnas smos pa dang*/ sa'i mtshan nyid sra ba'o/ zhes pa lta bu mtshan nyid smos pa dang*/ chos kyi tshig dang don smos pas mdo sde ste/ ji skad du/ gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang*/ chos don smos phyir mdo yin no/ zhes gsungs/ mngon pa'i sde snod ni/ a bhi ṇi na zhes pas yang yang ste phung khams skyes mchid la sogs pa'i shes bya ji snyed pa'i chos rnams/ phra zhig nas ston pas gzhan zil gyis gnon pa ste/ mngon du'i 611)phyir dang yang yang phyir/ zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ zhes gsungs/ 'dul ba'i sde snod la bi na ya/ zhes pas/ ltung ba ston cing nges par byed pas na 'dul ba ste/ ltung dang 'byung dang ldang ba dang*/ nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang*/ bcas pa dag ni rab dbye ba/ rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ ces gsungs pas so/ de ltar nang rig pa ji ltar byung ba'i khungs la sogs pa ni gong du smos pa la 'dus pas ma spros so/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ de yang dpal sgang lo tsā bas/ skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang*/ mngon brjod zlos gar 'di dag la/ rig gnas lnga zhes 'phags yul na/ grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar sgrogs/ zhes gsungs par ltar/ snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan gal mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ 612) brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs/ rtsis rig shes na grangs kyi gnas la mi rmongs pa ste rig gnas lnga las/ snyan ngag ni/ sngon gyi snyan ngag mtha' dag las rmad du byung ba slob dpon dbyug pa can gyi ring lugs la 'jug dgos shing*/
