de la lus/ rgyan/ skyon sel gsum du bshad cing*/ lus ni/ de nyid las/ de yang tshig bcad lhug pa dang*/ spel ma rnam gsum nyid du gnas/ zhes so/ de yang lungs las byung ba dang*/ bstan bcos las byung ba gnyis shes dgos te/ lung ni mngon pa kun las btus las/ tshigs su bcad pa ni rkang pa gcig pa dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa'i bar du yang yod do/ de yang gcig pa ni/ bram zes chu la ji tsam zhig ces tshigs bcad gcig gis 613)dris pa las/ mi yi bdag po sus nub tsam/ zhes gcig gis lan btab pa lta bu sogs dang*/ bstan bcos las 'byung ba ni/ rkang pa bzhir nges pa ste/ ji skad du/ tshigs bcad rkang bzhi de yang ni/ bṛt+ta dzā ti rnam gnyis dbye/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ rgyan ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan gyi dbye ba dang*/ thun mongs kyi rgyan don rgya so lnga dang*/ sgran rgyan bya sla bya dka' la sogs pa dang*/ gab tshig gi rgyan dang*/ de dag gi rnam 'gyur rnams so/ rkyon sel ni/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ the tshom can dang rim pa rnams/ sgra dman bcod mtshams nyams pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral/ yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang*/ lung rig dag dang 'gal ba ste/ skyon bcu de dag snyan ngag la/ snyan 614)ngag mkhan gyis rnam par spangs/ zhes skyon sel rnams shes pas mi rmings par bya ba'o/ sdeb sbyor ni/ sngon gyi phyi rol pa'i drang srong ser skya'am dmar ser can du grags pas byas pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo dang*/ de'i dper brjod rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa sogs la yon tan brgyad kyis dben pas/ snying dus kyi slob dpon rat+na a ka ra shin+ta ste rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas/ mdor bsdus tshigs bcad gsal ba dang*/ mdo nid dper brjod gyur pa dang*/ ma 'dres rim can 'don sla dang*/ bstod dang tshogs dang yon tan brgyad/ ces pa'i yon tan gyis khyad du byas pa sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rang 'grel dang bcas pa las shes dgos te/

yi ge lce yang dang*/ mnyam pa dag*/ mi mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta ste zhugs pa'am 'phel ba/ 'phags ma dang*/ rong langs can gyi phyi mo mnyam pa dag gsum gyis dzā ti ste/ rigs sam bskyed pa'i khyad par dang rtogs 615)byed kyi sdeb sbyor gyi gnas ji snyed cig shes pa tshigs bcad brtsoms pa la mi rmongs par bya'o/ chos re re la ming gi rnam grangs du ma brjod pa ste/ slob dpon 'chi med seng ges a ma ra ki ṇa'am 'chi med mdzod mdzad/ de'i 'grel pa su bhu ri tsan+d+ras mdzad pa'i 'dod 'jo sogs shes dgos te/ dper na/ nyi ma lta bu'i don nyid la/ ming gi rnam grangs/ nam mkha'i nor bu dang*/ rta bdun rgyal po dang*/ rta ljang can dang*/ pad+ma'i gnyen dang */ 'od stong ldan pa dang*/ tsha zer can dang*/ nyin mor byed dang*/ ku mud dgra dang*/ bcu gnyis bdag po la sogs pa ming gi rnam grangs du ma yod pa dang*/ yang ming gcig nyid don mang po la 'jig pa dper na go sgra zhes pa'i sgra lta bu'i ming gcig nyid ngag la sogs pa'i don dgu la 'jug ste/ dpal mgon klu sgrub 616)kyis/ ngag phyogs pa dang 'od zer dang*/ phyugs dang mig dang rdo rje dang*/ mtho ris chu ste don dgu la/ mkhas pas go sgra nges par bzung*/ zhes gsungs pas/ de sogs ming gi mngon brjod la mkhas par byas pa mi rmongs pa'o/ zlos gar ni/ sngon byung gi gtam bzhin gyi gzugs byas te skad rigs so so'i gtam dang glu zlos shing gar byed pa la/ skyes bu'i lag pa dang*/ mgo bo'i bsgyur thabs gtso bor gyur pa yab lag lnga dang ldan pa'o/ yan lag lnga ni/ zlos gar/ mdo 'dzin pa/ rol mo ba/ chas su zhugs pa/ bzhad gad pa dang lnga'o/ de yang legs par sbyar ba sam skṛ ta'i skad glur blang ba dang*/ a wa sbṛ sha ste zur chag gi skad dang*/ pi sha tsi zhes sha za'i skad dang*/ rang bzhin gyi skad de/ de dag kyang rol mo dang sdebs nas bsgyur bar byed pa ste/

klu dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' sding dang*/ 617)gnod sbyin dang*/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin pa rnams kyis gar dang po'i skad kyi glu'i khyad par blo gsal ba sogs rnam pa bdun du len pas na skad rigs la mi rmong pa zhes bya'o/ de dag ston pa'i gzhung ni/ zlos gar gyi bstan bcos bha ra ta dang*/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes rgyal po'i sprin gyi gzhon pas klu'i stog skyabs pa'i skyes rabs dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gtsug gi nor bu'i bar btang nas bram ze'i dbul ba bsam phyir rang tshong du bcug ste dgra la ster du bcug pas thams cad btul ba'i skyes rabs tsanra go mis mdzad pa sogs zlos gar gyi bstan bcos rnams so/ ༈ la mi rmongs pa'am grangs kyi gnas gzhan la mi rmongs pa ni/ brtsi bya dus dang gzugs can/ rtsi byed grangs 618)gnas dngos ste gnyis su dang po la'ang dus kyi thog ma ngos bzung ba dang*/ dus kyi tshed ji ltar brtsi ba dang*/ gzugs can gyi tshad ji ltar gzhal ba dang gsum las/ dang po dus kyi thog ma ni/ lung dang*/ sngon byung dang*/ chos mngon pa las/ dang po ni/ shed bu dang*/ shed las skyes gnyis kyis dus du khams kyis zas lci ba zos pas lus kyi rang 'od nyams te mun par gyur pa na/ sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyi nyi zla byung ba tsam zhig gsungs shing*/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rang nyid 'od ldan sems can ni/ de yi dus su rdzogs ldan yin/ thams cad nam mkha' la 'gro zhing*/ rga dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs/ de yi dus su rgyu skar med/ nyi ma zla ba skar ma med/ lha dang lha min 'jig rten med/ dang po'i dus ni dus mchog yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ dus kyi tshad ji 619)ltar rtsi ba ni/ 'di la bshad tshul mang du byung ste/ sems kyi rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i skad cig ma gcig la dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig

de brgya nyi shu la bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gcig de drug bcu la thang gcig de sum cu la yud tsam gcig de sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba gnyis la dus gcig de gsum mam zla ba drug la bgrod pa gcig de gnyis sam zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig de las dus bzhi dang*/ dus bzhi chen po dang*/ bskal chung dang*/ bskal chen la sogs pa rnams kyi rnam bzhag 'jog par byed pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ mig gis 'byed 'jul bcu la ni/ skad cig tsam du rab tu bstag skad cig bcu shes bshad pa ni/ yud tsam du ni yongs su brtag yud tsam 620)bzhi la thun gcig ces/ sngags rig pa ni yongs su brtag ces dang*/ mngon mdzod las/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ de yi skad cig de dag kyang*/ drug bcu la ni thang gcig go yud tsam nyin zhag zla ba rnams/ gong nas gong du sum cu 'gyur/ zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ zla ba bcu gnyis la ni lo/ zhes dang*/ yang gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde las byung ba'i yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma zhes bya/ de'i skad cig ma gsum la dbugs 'byung 'jug rngab ces bya/ dbugs drug la chu srang*/ chu srang de drug bcu 'am dbug sum brgya drug bcu ni/ chu tshod de drug bcu la zhag gcig ste/ dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ zhag sum cu la ni zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis la ni lo 621)ste/ de brgya la skyes bu'i tshe mthar phyin pa zhes bya'o/ zhes pa ltar skyes bu nad med kyi dbugs drug la chu srang gcig de drug la chu tshod gcig de drug bcu la nyi zhag gcig dang*/ chos dang res gza' dang rgyu skra la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag 'jog pa byed do/ gzugs can gyi tshad ji ltar 'jal mngon pa mdzod las/ lcags chu ri bong lugs dang glang*/ nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang*/ sor tshig zhes bya gong bdun 'gyur/

sor mo nyi shu bzhi la 'khru/ 'khru bzhi la ni gzhung gang ngo*/ de babargyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni/ rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ ces bshad do/ yang dpang tshad 'jal bar byed pa la sor/ lci tshad 'jal byed la srang*/ bongs tshad 'jal byed la bre sogs gsungs te/ 'chi med mdzod las/ 'jal 622)byed srang dang sor dang bre/ ma ru lnga sogs ma sha kang*/ de dag drug bcu zho yin te/ zho bzhi la ni srang gang ngo*/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ dngos ni/ grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug bcu la sogs pa rnams te spros pas chog go gzhan yang rtsi las/ iṅka/ dbye ba/ bsnan pa/ bgod pa/ bsgyur ba ste yi ge'i yan lag lnga dang*/ gza'/ tshes/ skar ma/ sbyor ba/ byed pa ste rtsis kyi yan lag lnga dang*/ gza' so so'i myur ba dang*/ bul ba dang*/ rnga po dang*/ 'khyog pa'i rkang pa gnyis btsal ba dang*/ khyim dang/ de/dag gi dge legs kyi rtsis dang*/ sgra gcan dang*/ dus me dang*/ de dag gis nyi zla 'dzin pa'i rtsis dang*/ du ba 'jug ring 'char ba dang nub pa la sogs pa phyi'i las mtha'i rtsis dang*/ nang gi rtsa rlung dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ gza' dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ dus 623)sbyor dang*/ dbugs dang*/ chu srang dang*/ dbyu gu dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ thun tshad dang*/ nyin tshadad dang*/ de dag la brten nas ye shes 'acar ba dang nub pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang thun mongs ma yin pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas so/ ༈ da ni 'phros brjod par bya ste/ sku rten dang gsung rten sngar smos pa'i nang du tshang zhing*/ thugs rje spyi ming bye brag la btags pa mchod rten la bzhag ste/ de la dbye na rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i mchod rten/ bla na med pa'i mchod rten/ byin gyis brlab pa'i mchod rten/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten/ theg pa so so'i mchod rten bshad pa dang lnga yod pal/ dang po ni/ smṛ ri'i de kho na nyid grub par/

sa yi khri 'phang zur bcu gnyis/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad yin te/ bang rim bdun du brtsegs pa ni/ gser gyi 624)re bdun shes par bya/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ snod bcud kyi 'jir rten rang bzhin lhun grub kyi mchod rten du bzhag pa'o/ thig le dbang gi rgyud las/ tshad med bsam yas las byung 'bras/ shar du byams pa rdo rje brtsegs lho du snying rje rin chen brtsegs/ nub ru dga' ba pad+ma brtsegs/ byang du btang snyoms rgya gram brtsegs/ rang byung rin chen snang ba'o/ zhes so/ gsum pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten ni/ 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rgyud du grags pa las/ byin rlabs sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir snang*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shar lus 'phags na/ byin ldan snyoms gter dang*/ mthar legs g.yu drung tog gnyis lho 'dzam bu'i gling na thugs rje sprul pa dang*/ yid bzhin lhun grub gnyis/ nub ba longs spyod na dpe med bsam 'das dang*/ rmad 625)grags chos dbyings gnyis/ byang sgra mi snyan na yon tan rin chen brtsegs dang*/ khams gsum bed rgyas sgron me'i mchod rten gnyis rnams bzhugs par bshad do/ bzhi dngos grub bdud rtsi mchog gi rgyud las/ ro yi bsrung ma chen po ni/ ma mo chen mo brgyad bzhag go mchod rten brgyad du rnam par bzhag de dag rten gnas chen po yang*/ mchod rten brgyad du rnam par bzhag ces pa'i 'grel par/ sngon he ru kas drag po btul ba'i tshe yul brgyad kyis dur khrod brgyad du/ ma mo brgyad kyi rten dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad byung ba ni/ ma gha dhar bde byed/ seṅga lar ri bo ta la/ bal por bya khri kha shor/ seng ge'i gling du ge'u do na/ li yul du go ya la pā la ghan+dha kha cher ka na ka/ za hor du bde spyod gzhon 626)nu'i mchod rten no/ lnga pa theg pa so so'i ma chod rten bshad pa ma gsum ste/

dang po nyan thos kyi mchod rten ni/ chos gos bzhi ltab kyi steng du lhung bzed spub pa la mkhar gsil gtsugs pa lta bu'o/ gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi mchod rten ni/ rmang grub bzhi'i steng du ngos grub bzhi bang rim zlum po bang rim bcu gnyis pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa can no/ gsum pa byang sems mchod rten ni/ lhung bzid spub pa lta bu bim pa'i zlum po dang*/ khang bu lta bu dang*/ rgyal mtshan lta bu'i mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa lta bu'o/ 'dul ba lung las ni/ chos 'khor la gdugs dang*/ gdugs la char khebs su btags nas/ so skye'i gdugs med pa'i byi bo'o/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu'i grangs kyi gdugs/ rang rgyal gyi gdugs bdun/ sangs rgyas kyi gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas 627)pa rnam pa thams cad par gsungs so/ rgyud sde so so'i dbang du byas na/ bya spyod kyi mchod rten bang rim nang du bcag cing phyir 'bur ba'am/ dbus 'bur la mtha' gnyis nang du bcu gsum pa 'khor lo bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa'ang bshad par grags rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje brtsegs pa sogs dang*/ bla med kyi dus 'khor sogs nas gsungs pa rnams so/ khyad par las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/ sprul pa mdzad pa sngon bstan phyir/ mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag zhes bshad pa ltar dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis yongs grags dang mthun par ston pa 'di'i mdzad pa kyad par can la brten nas gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa yul ljongs de dang de'i skye bo spro ba bskyed re/ dus ston bya ba'i phyir du brtsegs pa 628)shākya thub pa'i mchod rten brgyad du grags pa ni/ de la mchod rten gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ dang po grong khyer ser skyar sku bltam tshe gter kha brgyad sogs dge mtshan du ma byung bkra shis 'byung ba'am zhabs kyi gom pa bdun bor bas pad+ma bdun byung ba sogs dang 'brel bar pad spungs dbyibs zlum po pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyi bamarim bzhi'am bdun du'ang bshad pa pad+ma dang 'khor los spras pa ser skyar lum bi'i tshul du zas gtsang sogs kyis bzhengs pa'i pad spungs mchod rten/

gnyis pa rgyal po'i khyab tu mngon par byang chub pa'i dus dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa gzugs can snying po sogs kyis bzhengs pa'i byang chen mchod rten/ wa ra ṇā bskor ba'i tshe/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa glo 'bur dang bcas pa sgo rab brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'bring nga drug 629)tha ma bcu drug par yongs grags bzhed kyang*/ phyogs rer sgo bzhi re byed pa bden pa bzhi/ brgyad re byed pa rnam thar brgyad/ bcu gnyis byed pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ bcu drug tu byed pa stong nyid bcu drug mtshon pa lnga sde bzag pos bzhengs pa'i bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten/ bzhi pa mnyan yod du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe grub bzhi bang rim bzhi pa phyogs rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa li tsa byi sogs kyis dze ta'i tshal du bzhengs pa'i mu stengs pham byed dam cho 'phrul mchod rten/ lnga pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su yum la chos gsungs bden pa la bkod nas nam mkha' las babs nas phebs dus bang rim bzhi pa'am brgyad pa ngos rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'i glo 'bur gyi dbus na thems skas yod pa gsal ldan dad pa can rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i lha babs sam 630)yang na sum bcu rtsa gsum lha'i mchod rten du grags pa'o/ drug pa rgyal po'i khan tu lha byin gyis dge 'dun dbyen byas pa mchog zung gis bsdums pa'i dus bang rim bzhi pa grub bzhi zur bzhi mnyam par bcad pa'o/ rgyal byed pa sogs ma gha dha pa rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i 'od zer can nam byams ngos kyang bya zhing dben bsdums mchod rten/ bdun pa yangs pa can du sku zhe zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i zlum po bang rim gsum pa de'i grong khyer pa rnams kyis brtsegs pa'am/ yang na 'ga' zhig tu lhas brtsigs par grags pa'i byin brlabs sam rnam rgyal mchod rten/ brgyad pa rtswa mchog tu mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe bang rim med pa gdan khri'i steng du bum rten yan dzad bzhugs pa rtswa can gyi gyad rnams kyis brtsigs pa'i myang 'das mchod rten/

gzhan yang sku 631)gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rtan chen po brgyad dang*/ ras tshig pa'i mchod rten/ ma tshig pa'i mchod rten/ sol ba'i macod rten te bcu gcig tshems se mche ba lha dang srin pos khyer ba'i mchod rten/ phyis chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa mchod rten bye ba dus gcig la bzhengs pa'i mchod rten sogs dang mya ngan las ma 'das gong du dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten sogs dpag tu med de/ gtso bo snga ma brgyad du ci ris par 'dus la/ ding sang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs na ni gang zag su'i ched du bzhengs kyang brgyad po gang rung gi rnam pa can rnam pa thams cad par bya dgos zhes bshad do/ zhar byung bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad pa ni/ 'dul ba phran tshe tshogs las bstan pa lo lnga stong du 632)bshad pa dang*/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad par bsran pa'i mdo las/ slad ma'i dus latha brgya tha ma la/ zhes pa'i 'grel par shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'bras bu thob pa dang*/ shin tu rgyas pa'i dus ni lo stong zhig 'dzam bu'i gling du gnas so/ de yang phyed du bgos te/ lnga brgya pa snga ma ni 'phel ba'i dus su bzhag la lnga brgya tha ma ni 'bri ba'i dus zhes bya'o/ zhes dang*/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong du dam pa'i chos gnas par gyur cig yang lo brgyar dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan gnas par gyur cig ces dang*/ zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan lo nyis stong du gnas par 'gyur ro/ zhes dang*/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las mi g.yo ba tha dad par snang ba'i mdor/ 'jam dpal 633)nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo lnga brgya dang*/ dgu brgya dang*/ so dgu brgya dang*/ nyis stong dang*/ nyis stong lnga mya'i bar du chos la brtag ba'i mtha' lnga po 'di dag la so sor rtog pa'i gang zag rim pas 'byung ngo*/

zhes dang*/ rdo rje bcod pa'i 'grel par/ lnga brgya tha ma la/ zhes bya ba la/ brgya phrag lnga'i tshogs ni lnga brgya ste bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa lnga brgya phrag lnga'i bar du gnas zhes grags pas/ de'i phyir tha ma zhes bye brag tu gsungs so/ zhes dang*/ bskal bzang las/ dam pa'i chos lnga brgya'i bar du gnas so/ lo lnga brgya'i bar du ni dam pa'i chos ltar snang ngo*/ zhes dang*/ daṃṣ+ṭa se na'i 'bum ṭīg tu/ phyi mi'i dus lnga brgya tha ma zhes pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa lo lnga stong du du gnas pa la stong phrag re re phyed phyed ru bcad pas/ lnga brgya phrag 634)bcu la le'u bcur 'gyur te/ de la lnga brgya pa dag po dag gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa rnams la rim pa ltar dgra bcom pa dang phyir mi 'ong ba dang rgyun du zhugs pa mang du byung bas de rnams kyi le'u zhes bya ste khong du tshul khrims dang ldan pa mang du byung bas de rnams kyi le'u zhes bya ste sgrub pa'i dus kyi le'u gsum dang*/ de nas lnga brgya bdun pa dang brgyad pa dang dgu pa rnams la rim pa bzhin mngon pa dang mdo sde dang 'dul ba ston pa mang du 'byung bas de rnams kyi le'u ste lung gi le'u gsum dang*/ lnga brgya pa bcu pa ni/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam las lta spyod rnam ma dang mi ldan pas rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u ste 'di la lnga brgya pa tha ma zhes bya'o zhes bshad do/ de ltar na mkhas pa phal 635)cher lo stong la sogs pa dgongs pa can dang*/ yang dag pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad lnga stong nyid zhal mthun pa shad che ba dang*/ lung dang yang mthun shas che bas re zhig 'dir yang lnga stong du gnas pa khas blang ngo*/ de ltar 'das lo phug lugs dang bstun nas brtsis na sngar phan 'bras bu'i dus gsum dang*/ sgrub pa'i dus las sher ting gnyis dang*/ tshul khrims las gya drug tsam 'das shing*/ da phyin tshul phrims lung gi dus gsum/

rtags tsam 'dzin pa ste/ lnga brgya phrag lngar nye ba tsam yod par gter chen bla ma nyid kyis gsungs so/ nges don thun mngos ba yin pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad ni/ gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ zhes dang*/ yid bzhin rnam par bkod pa'i rgyud las/ sems can kun gyi tshogs chen po/ ji srid rnam par gnas de srid/ sangs rgyas sprul pa rgyun mi chad grol ba'i chos kyang nub pa med/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ chos 'byung bstan pa'i nyi ma las/ rig gnas 636)tshad bshad skabs te gsum pa'o/ smras pa mtha' med 'khor ba'i 'jig rten 'dir/ mthas yas bshes gnyen tshul bzung ste/ mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam bstan nas/ mtha' dbus med pa chos kyi dbyings/ rtsol mdzad mkhas grub ma lus pa'i/ phul byung ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i gtam/ thos chung bdag 'dra'i blo'i mun sel/ chos 'byung bstan pa'i nyi ma 'di/ nyung gsal grong tshig brjod pas brtsams 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i phung po rnams/ bla ma lha dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ mkhas gnyan kun gyi spyan sngar bshags/ kye ma ding sang dus skabs 'dir/ lhag bzang pos bstan pa dang*/ sems can phan pa'i las byas na/ dkar po'i bya bzhin mi bder 'gyur/ kun dang bstun na bcos chung zer/ ma smras btang snyoms 'dug gyur na/ gyong po shing gi lag pa can/ rgyangs te phyin na drin bgrangs zer cer du bsdad na kun gyis dmod/ ji ltar byas kyang ma bde bas/ bsam gtan khang bur yibs nas su/ bsam gtan grogs kyi zol dag tu/ 637)bsam gtan thun gyi bar rnams su/ bsam gtan yid la 'di byas spel/ 'di las byung ba'i dge ba gang*/ lus bskyed pha mas thogs drangs pa'i/ sems can rnams dang thun mongs su/ byas te byang chen rgyud bsngo'o/ de ltar chos 'byung bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling yab sras kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i smin gling gra ba'i tha sham ba shākya'i dge slong o rgyan chos grags kyis/

sngon gyi yig rnying rnams dang gter chen bla ma dang yab sras kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi mang du thos pa la brten nas rang lo nga drug pa bsam gtan gyi thun bar rnams su bris te lcags phag mgo zla'i yar tshes la rdzogs par bgyis pa'o/ 'di kyang bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ sarba maṅga laṃ//
